publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This project, named “Tailor AIDE: A Regression Analysis-Based System for Predicting Cost Estimation in the Clothing Industry,” aims to create a system that allows garment business owners, pattern creators, and tailors to manage their enterprises more effectively. Allowing them to stay one step ahead of their designs, patterns, and cost management by providing them with an online workspace where they can access all three elements in one sitting. The system employs extensive material usage by feeding it patterns that are measured using smart pattern making and measuring software, Seamly2D and SeamlyME. Helping users optimize fabric efficiency, ensure accurate measurements, and save waste. Furthermore, the system provides a digital workspace in which individuals can completely express their creativity in design making. Using the drag and drop capability, there are various established patterns, as well as fully customizable shapes, shape colors, texts, and text colors. Furthermore, the adoption of Machine Learning enables business owners and aspiring entrepreneurs to forecast their cost breakdowns for each project, ensuring optimal financial allocations. The system conducts a survey using Google Forms, with the study's target respondents being IT professionals, garment business owners, fabric/textile manufacturers, tailors, and dressmakers. The results revealed that there is a market gap for business owners who concentrate on money management rather than patternmaking, and vice versa. And utilizing ISO/IEC 25010 as a model assessment for software quality, focusing on functional suitability, reliability, and performance efficiency. The results returned a satisfactory score, indicating that Tailor Aideis an effective online workplace for its users by offering smart pattern layouts, design workplace and cost predictions.

articleTitle: Leveraging Precision Agriculture and GGE Biplot Analysis to Improve Rice Yield in Diverse Agro-Climatic Conditions
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: GGE Biplot Analysis together with Precision Agriculture Practices is a useful tool for enhancing rice production under diverse environments. It utilizes modern agricultural data science tools for sustainability by addressing the emerging necessity of rice farming, to do so more efficiently and optimally regarding resource usage. The GGE biplot analysis looks into the interaction of crop genotypes with environmental variables that would indicate stable, high-yielding varieties. Precision agriculture techniques are driven by IoT and data analytics to optimize the use of such resources as water and fertilizers, minimizing environmental impact while maintaining productivity. Building on the challenges posed by climate variability and the demand for sustainable farming, the work herein introduces a data-centric framework integrating GGE biplot analysis with precision farming. The potential benefits include water savings of up to 20% and fertilizer application reductions to 15%, achieving those without yield losses. It shows that merging very advanced analytical tools, smart practices in farming, and activities to enhance productivity and sustainability in rice cultivation may indeed be on the right track.

articleTitle: Designing a Robust Software Bug Prediction Model Using Enhanced Learning Principles with Artificial Intelligence Assistance
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Software bug prediction is a critical task in software engineering, aimed at identifying bug-prone areas in the codebase before they cause significant issues. In this study, we propose a robust hybrid model that integrates Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks and eXtreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) to enhance bug prediction accuracy. The proposed model leverages the sequential learning capabilities of LSTM to capture temporal patterns in software development, while XGBoost handles high-dimensional feature spaces for accurate classification. The model was trained and tested using historical software bug data collected from open-source repositories, with features including source code metrics, code review history, and developer activity. The proposed model achieved a remarkable accuracy of 92.81 %, outperforming nine existing models, including Random Forest, Support Vector Machine (SVM), and Artificial Neural Networks (ANN). Additionally, the model demonstrated superior performance in recall (91.43%) and F1-score (0.915), indicating its effectiveness in both identifying bugs and minimizing false positives. These results suggest that the proposed hybrid model is a powerful tool for proactive bug detection, offering significant improvements over traditional methods.

articleTitle: Experimental Evaluation of Secure and Verifiable Data Control Access Over Cloud Storage Environment Using Dynamic Cryptographic Strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Cloud storage offers numerous advantages in terms of accessibility, scalability, and reliability, but it also poses significant security challenges. This study evaluates a secure and verifiable data control access mechanism over a cloud storage environment using a dynamic cryptographic strategy. Several cryptographic techniques were employed, including capability-based access control, multi-authority role-based access control (RBAC), Ciphertext Policy Attribute-Based Encryption (CP-ABE), deniable encryption, and the NTRU cryptosystem. The system's performance, security, scalability, and resilience were analyzed under various conditions. The results show that the NTRU cryptosystem outperformed other cryptographic methods with an average latency of 35ms and a success rate of 99%, compared to CP-ABE's 95% and deniable encryption's 92%. The system also demonstrated high resilience to brute force attacks with a 100% detection rate and minimal false positives at 1 %. In terms of scalability, the system maintained a high success rate of 90% even when scaled to 2000 users. Overall, the proposed cryptographic strategy effectively balanced security, performance, and scalability, making it highly suitable for dynamic cloud environments with varying user demands and data security requirements.

articleTitle: Robust Secret Image Exchange Resistant to JPEG Compression
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: For real-world Secret Information Sharing (SIS) applications, robust secret image sharing (ROSIS) which is developed for JPEG images and resistant to recompression is required because of the prevalence and regularity of JPEG recompression. The error-correcting codes (ECC)-based state-of-the-art ROSIS now in use is limited to JPEG compression having quality factors (QFs) around 99 and 100. Nevertheless, it produces shadow pictures that are limited within the spatial domain and resemble noise. The robustness of the scheme is significantly increased by using a stable block condition to ensure the constant existence of discrete cosine transform (DCT) coefficients during JPEG recompression. This novel ROSIS scheme, called SBCROSIS (Robust Secret Image Sharing Scheme Resistant to JPEG Recompression Based on Stable Block Condition), is presented in this paper. We create DCT blocks which either directly or by means of strategic global control comply to stable block conditions by using a secret sharing (SS) mechanism. We also take into account the degree to which the generated DCT blocks and the original cover DCT blocks are comparable. In addition, we developed a customized assessment process especially for ROSIS. Comprehensive test results show that SBC-ROSIS can process JPEG images efficiently, exhibiting strong performance in realistic recompression scenarios and striking a balance between privacy, reliability, hiding, and compliance to the (m, n) threshold without the need for data hiding, ECC, or pixel expansion.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Agriculture Empirical Impact of Intelligent Agri-Field Monitoring Systems Based on Internet of Things Association
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The term “smart farming” refers to a new trend in agricultural technology that places an emphasis on the use of ICT in the form of sensors, machines, and other tools linked to high-tech farm surveillance cycles that are based on networks. We may expect new technology, the IoT, and cloud computing to spur expansion and usher in AI and robotics in agricultural settings. Such revolutionary departures not only pose many problems, but they are also disturbing established methods of farming. This study presents the Intelligent Agri-Field Monitoring System (IAFMS), an architectural framework that combines IoT with crop production. It employs several cloud-based strategies for crop monitoring. This proposed logic is cross-validated with the conventional Agriculture Field Monitoring System (AFMS) to evaluate the efficiency of the proposed model. To save the farmer time and effort, the suggested method analyses data received from sensors installed in crops in real-time and sends the results back to the farmer. This allows for better crop growth monitoring. In order to automate processes through the integration of IoT devices, the data that is gathered from the fields is saved and analyzed in the cloud. Reducing resource wasting in agriculture areas is one way the paper's proposal may boost crop output. Data on the field's temperature, soil moisture, humidity, and water use, as well as a study of the farmer's decision-making process, are presented in the experimental findings.

articleTitle: FMICS: A Robust Learning Methodology to Predict Skin Cancer Disease Using Fused Melanoma Image Classification Scheme
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Skin cancer (SC), particularly melanoma, is a significant health issue due to its high mortality rate when not detected early. This study introduces a novel approach, FMICS: A Robust Learning Methodology (Hybrid ANN + XGBoost) for predicting SC through fused melanoma image classification. The methodology integrates Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) for feature extraction and XGBoost for classification, leveraging the strengths of both models. Preprocessing techniques such as image filtering, contrast enhancement, and hair removal were applied to improve image quality. The study utilized dermoscopic images from the PH2 and HAM10000 datasets, containing both benign and malignant lesions. The hybrid model achieved superior performance compared to individual models, with an accuracy of 94.80%, sensitivity of 94.90%, and specificity of 94.70%. Data augmentation techniques, including rotation, scaling, and flipping, were applied to enhance the model's robustness. Evaluation metrics such as the F1-score and ROC-AUC were used to assess the performance. The hybrid approach significantly reduced false negatives, making it highly reliable for melanoma detection. These results suggest that the FMICS methodology offers a promising solution for accurate and efficient SC diagnosis, with potential applications in clinical and mobile environments.

articleTitle: DeepFrame: A Scientific Framework for Advancing Ocean Cleanup through Underwater Debris Detection and Geospatial Mapping
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The escalating concern of underwater debris demands innovative approaches for effective ocean cleanup. This study presents a comprehensive framework utilizing deep learning methods to detect, categorize, track, and geospatially map un derwater debris. By amalgamating cutting-edge object detection models, the system extracts real-time insights from underwater sensor data, facilitating the identification and categorization of debris based on various attributes. The incorporation of advanced tracking algorithms enables the monitoring of debris dynamics, contributing to predictive capabilities. Furthermore, geospatial mapping techniques are employed to project identified debris onto world maps, using latitude and longitude coordinates. This mapping feature aids in locating debris accumulation areas, thereby enabling strategic and efficient cleanup efforts. Through meticulous experimentation on authentic underwater debris datasets, our framework demonstrates its potential in precisely detecting, tracking, and mapping debris. The proposed solution leverages robust extended dataset of augmented images with its benchmark and novel Geo-Spatial mapping framework, which revolutionizes ocean conservation endeavors by providing valuable insights and ecologically-aware of underwater debris removal. The source code and the dataset have been made publicly available on GitHubl.

articleTitle: A Novel Proxy Based Reencryption Scheme for Secured Data Communication by Using Internet of Things (IoT) and BlockChain Technologies
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel proxy-based re-encryption (PRE) scheme for secured data communication in the Internet of Things (IoT) environment, integrated with blockchain technology to enhance data privacy and security. The scheme employs identity-based encryption (IBE) to streamline key management and ensures efficient data sharing by leveraging blockchain for decentralized access control. Proxy servers, acting as intermediaries, handle resource-intensive computations, reducing the load on resource-constrained IoT devices. The system was evaluated across multiple parameters, including encryption, decryption, and re-encryption times, communication overhead, and computational cost. Results demonstrated that the system scales efficiently with data sizes, with encryption times increasing linearly from 5ms to 60ms for data sizes ranging from 10 KB to 100 KB. The re-encryption times followed a similar trend, ranging from 8ms to 60ms. Accuracy in maintaining secure data access control was recorded at 98.5%, ensuring that unauthorized access was effectively prevented. Communication overhead was minimal, with only a 3–12 KB increase across different data sizes due to the additional security features.

articleTitle: A Robust Fuzzy Based Multi-Keyword Similarity Search Model on Cloud Computing Platform Using Cipher Data Security Principles
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In the era of cloud computing, secure data storage and retrieval have emerged as critical challenges due to the need to protect sensitive information while maintaining efficient access. This paper presents a robust fuzzy-based multi-keyword similarity search model that operates on encrypted cloud data, enhancing both security and performance. By combining fuzzy logic, homomorphic encryption, and multi-keyword search, this model offers improved accuracy in retrieving relevant documents based on user queries. The model achieves a search accuracy of 85% with two keywords, which increases progressively to 96.5% when 11 keywords are used. Additionally, the system demonstrates low encryption overhead, with encryption time scaling linearly as data size increases. The search time also remains efficient, growing from 50 ms for two keywords to 400 ms for 11 keywords. The model further enhances query efficiency, achieving 96% efficiency after processing 500 queries. The proposed solution addresses the growing need for secure and efficient cloud storage systems while ensuring user privacy. The results indicate the model's scalability, making it suitable for large datasets and high-volume cloud environments.

articleTitle: Smart Electric Meter Using Lora
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In the modern world of abundant mechanism, power(Electricity) is the most crucial term to deal with any digital system to function. Therefore, it is equally LoRa allows long-range communication with low power, making it ideal for remote energy monitoring. The smart meter tracks energy consumption and sends data via LoRa-WAN, enabling real-time access from anywhere. This helps users manage their energy use, avoid excess consumption, and reduce costs. The low-power nature of LoRa ensures the system works efficiently in areas without strong Wi-Fi or cellular signals. In the IoT applications, the communication range is the most crucial component, since most Wi-Fi based systems in the IoT require multiple By installing the required software on your gadget, you may access all of the collected data from any location using a PC, smartphone, or other device by installing the Gateway and sending it to the cloud server.

articleTitle: Automated Document Processing: Combining OCR and Generative AI for Efficient Text Extraction and Summarization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Technological advancement including the use of new media formats in creating digital documents calls for the development of enhanced processing techniques and methods. Old school Optical Character Recognition (OCR) tools remain useful but are inadequate when faced with sophisticated documents or low-quality scans. Also, summarizing the textual content of such papers continues to be a manual process and adds inefficiency and potential errors in information gathering. Finally, an integrated approach to the automation of both text extraction and summarization based on improved OCR and Google Gemini's generative AI technique is presented in this paper. By using more precise OCR algorithms, the system greatly increases accurate text recognition from poorly quality scans or complex structures. At the same time, the employment of generative AI models contributes to the formulation of brief and relevant summaries and also improves document retrieval and handling. Its effectiveness has thus been confirmed by testing on a variety of documents, and it has increased both accuracy and utility compared to previous techniques.

articleTitle: Interactive Code Parsing and Expression Tree Visualization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Binary information trees are key visualization and evaluation tools, particularly during the passing of algorithms and synthesizing designs. This paper is an interactive tool for producing binary information trees over time. This tool will allow the user to input variables, selected, truncating and then show the same as a binary tree. Using Network X and Matplotlib for graphing, this presents the user with an interactive pie chart to enable operator control and variable assignment. Dynamic information evaluation and substitution is supported; this allows for an immediate view of change when variables and functions are altered. It is aimed at user interaction with a didactic value, and with this in mind, it contributes to easier understanding of the fundamental issues of distributed algorithms, clustering, and information evaluation. Though derived from such existing tools as VMEXT and PAVT, it offers a simple, and thus very practical approach, becoming suitable for educational environments where a visualization shows better understanding of the abstract computer concepts.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Under Water Level Maintaining and Automatic Controlling System for Industries Using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Industrial water consumption has been the target of conscious and reduction policies in order to avoid the waste of natural resources and financial resources. This is the biggest problem for governments. The notified draft rules said that even district magistrates have the power to grant NOC if the water withdrawal was 20–50 cubic meters per day depending on the type of area. This project describes the development of an android application for monitoring and automatic control using a flow sensor to measure water consumption for industries. The proposed system collects data from a flowmeter equipped with a borehole and sends this information via IOT (internet of things) to the server (municipality) and consumers, access records in the cloud at any time through platforms such as Thing Speak, issuing automatic flow readings water. This method enables live monitoring of water consumption and also provides identification of consumption patterns. Idea of using an ML model to gather and transmit real-time data to a licenced central command center regarding the water levels of various water bodies that supply the dams that evaluates the information gathered and chooses the appropriate course of action. The decision of whether to release the water can subsequently be made in accordance with the ML Model's recommendation. Where it reproduced the failure of the real environment. Wasting water is the biggest problem in households in developing countries like India,

Author Keywords: IOT(internet of things) and online think speak webpage

articleTitle: Deep Learning - Driven RPA Bot for Automated Evaluation of Handwritten Examination Papers Using Gen AI
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The incorporation of Robotic Process Automation (RPA) and deep learning in the educational evaluation system brings a strong, automated solution for assessing handwritten exam assessments. Educational institutions have exponentially started using RPA systems for monotonous activities like data storage and management, but the capacity extends far beyond these activities. This paper gives an automated solution for evaluating handwritten examination papers in educational institutions by combining advanced deep learning models and RPA (Robotic Process Automation). Using CNNs (Convolutional Neural Networks) and BiLSTM (Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory) networks, the system converts handwritten responses into machine-readable text, trained to various handwriting styles. For grading, a Gen-AI model is used to assess the answers recognized by CNN and BiLSTM. This provides precise grading that aligns closely with human correction. RPA does end-to-end automation, from scanning and processing papers through deep learning models for text recognition to grading and data management thus reducing human effort, enhancing consistency, saving time and improving efficiency in the evaluation process. This technique streamlines examination, allowing teachers and professors to focus more on personalized instruction and academic development.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of CUK Power Converter Topologies for SmartLighting Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The Light Emitting Diodes (LED), have seen tremendous achievement in the lighting trade Because of its better qualities over traditional lighting. These attributes are long lifespan, low maintenance, environmental responsiveness, high radiant effectiveness, controllability of colour and light, reliability, and high-power density. LED driver implementation is crucial in the lighting industry. Drivers protect the LED from variations in voltage and power. This research compares different types of LED drivers with a cuk converter which operates in discontinuous conduction mode (DCM). This research effort proposes a new innovative flicker free modified non-reversal DC-DC cuk LED driver. The performance features of the traditional cuk converter (C-CUK), interleaved positive output cuk converter(INRCC), CUK-SEPIC Integrated converter, non-reversal cuk converter (NRCC) and modified non-reversalCUK Converter (MNRCC) are briefly evaluated and compared. Regarding the suggested LED driver. The circuit setup for the suggested architecture is simulated using the MATLAB/SIMULINK. The outcomes are verified.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Algorithms for Detecting Phishing Websites
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Despite the quick growth of the digital world, phishing attempts still constitute a serious threat to the security of online banking transactions. The goal of this research project is to evaluate the usage of machine learning algorithms to detect websites that are used to spread phishing messages. This work specifically considers complex feature engineering and algorithm selection approaches. The detection method is enhanced by the application of optimal model, which is utilized to extract and evaluate text-based elements from phishing websites. It is done with optimal model. DNSPython and Python-Whois are the technologies utilized to finish gathering domain-related data. However, Scikit-learn makes the process of putting machine learning models into practice easier. The objectives that AutoML aids in achieving include efficient model selection and optimization. This has the important advantage of making it possible to automatically identify the algorithms with the highest performance levels. The objective of this research endeavour is to enhance the accuracy and robustness of phishing detection systems through the utilization of diverse methodologies and technologies. Additionally, the study makes an effort to clarify how machine learning would be able to successfully counteract the increasingly complex phishing methods. Through improving the automatic identification of phishing-related websites, our program seeks to contribute to the creation of safer online environments.

articleTitle: Neural Networks in Workforce Planning and Management
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The primary objective of this study is to examine the utilization of neural networks in workforce planning and management, with an emphasis on their capacity to enhance labor allocation, anticipate personnel requirements, and enhance overall organizational efficiency. Neural networks, a type of artificial intelligence, are extremely appropriate for managing the complexities of human management because of their robust capabilities in data processing and pattern detection. By examining historical data and current trends, these algorithms can identify areas where skills are lacking, forecast the need for workers, and suggest the optimal employment levels. By incorporating neural networks into workforce planning, we can achieve a workforce that is more adaptable and efficient, as well as improve employee satisfaction, reduce costs, and improve the precision of our decision-making.

articleTitle: An Experimental Evaluation of Learning Based Platform to Analyze Mechanical Engineering Students Performance
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The area of mechanical engineering requests a thorough comprehension of hypothetical ideas and functional applications. To meet this interest, there emerges a requirement for a learning platform customized explicitly for mechanical engineering students. The Learning Platform for Mechanical Engineering Students (LP-ME) is a powerful internet-based environment that coordinates different assets to take special care of the different necessities of students. It offers an organized educational program covering center points like thermodynamics, liquid mechanics, mechanics of materials, and machine plan, among others. Every subject is introduced through drawing in multimedia content, including intelligent reproductions, recordings, and movements, to work with better perception and maintenance. One of the vital elements of LP-ME is its versatile learning framework, which surveys the singular capability of students and gives customized recommendations to additional review. Through ordinary tests and assessments, students can keep tabs on their development and recognize regions for improvement. These intuitive encounters reinforce learning as well as develop critical thinking abilities fundamental for true engineering difficulties. Besides, LP-ME integrates industry-important substance and contextual analyses to overcome any barrier among the scholarly community and expert practice. Visitor addresses from industry specialists and potential open doors for entry level positions give students important bits of knowledge into latest things and advances in the field of mechanical engineering.

articleTitle: Deep Learning for Parkinson's Disease: Identification, Classification and Lifestyle Recommendations
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: One such degenerative ailment is Parkinson's disease (PD) which is a brain disorder that progresses as an individual ages and affects many across the globe. Hence, early diagnosis and detection of the condition are necessary to help in the management of its symptoms and the speed at which it advances. This project proposes the development of a system for diagnosing PD and analysis of its symptoms via the imaging techniques and other patient data bereft of the biological examination. The system first employs a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) algorithm to analyze certain brain images (MRI) for diagnosis of Parkinson's. Upon identification of the disease, the system also looks into the symptoms of the patient to grade the severity of the disease from early stages to more advanced cases. Moreover, it specifies peculiar types of parkinsonism, which can be characterized as a dominating tremor type, rigidity type, or mixed-parkinsonism. It also recommends treatment options and interventions, preventative measures, and other health professionals in order to help the health worker put together a total care package for the patient. This concept seeks to combine a typical imaging paradigm and symptom assessment so as to enhance the diagnosis and management of PD. Thus increasing the prognosis as well as the quality of life of patients.

articleTitle: Automated Road Damage Detection Framework Using Deep Learning Object Detection Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Detection of road damages is critical for road safety and efficient road maintenance. In this article, we present deep learning solution for image pothole detection with 3 popular object recognition algorithms: Faster R-CNN, RetinaNet, and SSD300 with VGG16. It is done through preprocessing a map of road images labeled with the location of potholes and data enhancement to strengthen the model. Each model is tuned for pothole detection using modified detection heads depending on our dataset class classes using classification loss function and localization loss function with adaptive learning rate scheduling and early stopping to optimize. The performance is calculated as Mean Average Precision (mAP) at various IoU thresholds, with the ResNet model giving higher detection rates. This evidence shows the models' potential to predict potholes in real-time, resulting in improved road safety and preventive maintenance.

articleTitle: Advanced Cybersecurity: A Comprehensive Overview of an Enhanced Cybersecurity Assisted Cryptography Strategy for Protected Image Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Some problems exist with the classic Elliptic Curve Cryptography (ECC) algorithm, which uses logistic maps as its foundation. We employ an upgraded ECC system to make things more secure. It relies on a location transform and a random sequence to change the pixel values. The Cybersecurity based Cryptography Strategy (CCS) is a new model that improves upon the previous approach in terms of security. It was introduced in this publication. By modifying the values of each pixel, the suggested algorithm shuffles the picture according to the protected sequence. The key uses a secret look-up matrix to generate 32 security key sequences from a given sequence. The encryption key works by operating on n sub-parts of the picture, which increases efficiency. An image encryption technique can be practically tested in Matlab. Histogram comparison, correlation coefficient, and secret key sensitivity are some of the ways the algorithm's security is examined. The suggested algorithm can withstand statistical, brute-force, and plain-text attacks with ease. This innovation provides a safer method of guaranteeing the safety of image data, which may be stored anywhere, even on the cloud. We have presented the final product after testing it on many types of photographs. Lastly, the results of the experiments demonstrate that the encryption is well-built and has protection capabilities; moreover, it is able to resist intense, statistical, and differential attacks.

articleTitle: Advanced Medical Report Interpretation Through OCR, Generative AI, and Rule-Based Doctor Recommendation System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Patient outcome and clinical decision-making are results of efficiently interpreting medical reports, leading to reliable doctor suggestions-a key component in healthcare. This paper proposes an automated system using Optical Character Recognition (OCR), a rule based framework and a Generative AI model to handle medical reports in PDF. The system captures patient data and applies rules for custom medical advice. This study examine text extraction performance and AI recommendations relevance, showing 97% accuracy 93% relevancy from expert reviews. Challenges including handling complex support formats ensuring complete rule coverage and improving healthcare delivery by reducing time spent evaluating reports. The findings suggest this system can enhance clinical workflow efficiency.

articleTitle: A Logical Development of Phishing Attack Detection Methodology by Using Cybersecurity Principles with Elevated Deep Learning Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Cybercriminals have taken advantage of phishing attacks to launch a variety of security breaches. In these attacks, bogus website Uniform Resource Locators (URLs) are sent out via email, messages, and other online mediums in an effort to trick users into giving over sensitive information. Various old methods for detecting phishing websites based on blacklists are used to forecast the phishing URLs. Nevertheless, since there are always new phishing websites popping up on the Internet, the old solutions that rely on blacklists cannot reliably forecast the majority of these sites. An improved method for detecting phishing attempts using deep learning has been suggested; it's dubbed Elevated Learning with Attack Detection Principle (ELADP). To test how well it works, ELADP is cross-validated with the traditional method known as Regression Network (RN). In this research, we provide a novel phishing detection system that uses a wide variety of deep learning approaches, including RN, attention networks, neural architecture, and recurrent neural networks, among others. Quick URL-based page classification is the system's main focus, which proves its effectiveness in real-time phishing assault detection. The usefulness of the suggested strategy is demonstrated by its evaluation using a huge dataset that contains approximately five million tagged URLs.

articleTitle: Grid Alert Fault Detection Using IOT – LoRa WAN
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The research paper presents an improved fault detection and monitoring system for power distribution systems, with a focus on enhancing reliability and efficiency. The system builds upon established principles in fault detection, as well as insights from recent advancements in IoT and LoRa WAN technology. Power distribution systems face challenges related to transient stability, supply disturbances, and fault detection, particularly in regions with infrastructure limitations. The study introduces a solution that leverages loT devices to enable real-time fault detection and location determination in medium and low-voltage distribution networks. The system's ability to rapidly generate alerts upon fault occurrence facilitates swift corrective actions, thereby minimizing downtime and enhancing the dependability of power delivery. Additionally, the proposed solution is designed to address cost constraints commonly encountered in developing countries, making it a practical and cost-effective option for modernizing existing power grids. The research represents a step towards improving power distribution management, offering network operators an effective means to monitor and manage distribution networks over extended distances, resulting in a more reliable electricity supply.

articleTitle: Blockchain-Enabled Quality Assurance and Traceability in the Indian Confectionery Market
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: India, whose population growth is its greatest asset cannot afford to let its people eat confectionery that is either tainted or somehow polluted, since this would lead to extensive malnutrition. Traditional food supply chains are characterized by centralization and the problems associated with it such as having a single point of failure and producing inconsistent products while compromising the quality, along with data loss. With the need for daily reports in all regions of India regarding food fraud, contamination, and adulteration, a clearly advanced decentralized model is sought after for the creation of a supply chain. This paper introduces the supply chain network for the Indian confectionery market based on blockchain to better address quality claims, contamination, and transparency. This enables real-time traceability within the ecosystem, by using IoT strategies along with the Ethereum blockchain leading to better product authentication and resulting in higher consumer confidence. Blockchain creates a secure data tracking function, while smart contracts can be used to define the process - such as IoT monitoring of temperature. The united method enables verified data to be available to the consumer, energy efficiency, and trust across the supply chain.

articleTitle: B2BIoT: Efficient and Secured Wireless Body-to-Body Data Communication by using Smart Wearable Sensors
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This research presents “B2BIoT,” an efficient and secure wireless body-to-body communication system using Human Body Communication (HBC) and smart wearable sensors. The proposed system employs the human body as a medium to transmit data between wearable devices through capacitive and galvanic coupling techniques. Extensive simulations and real-world tests were conducted to evaluate signal attenuation, transmission rates, power consumption, and security. Results showed that at a frequency of 10 MHz, the system achieved optimal signal strength with an attenuation of 4–7 dB across different body parts. The system recorded a data transmission rate of 55 Kbps with an error rate of 1.3% during indoor tests and 2.0% in outdoor conditions. The accuracy of the system was measured at 98% in controlled environments and 96% in dynamic real-world settings. Power consumption was efficient, with an average energy consumption of 60 mJ for a complete transmission session. Security tests confirmed minimal signal leakage, particularly at lower frequencies. The findings indicate that the B2BIoT system is a secure and energy-efficient solution for real-time data transmission between wearable devices in applications such as healthcare and fitness tracking.

articleTitle: A Logical Emotion Recognition System Based on Human Speech by Using Hybrid Deep Learning Procedures
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In the psychological life of a human being, emotions are crucial. A person's point of view or mental state can be conveyed to others through it. Emotion identification from speech signals has been a study issue in human-machine interaction applications for a long time. Many techniques have been developed to detect emotions in voice signals. A limited number of universal emotions may be taught to recognize or create by an intelligent system. These are neutral, anger, happiness, and sadness. Using voice signals, this study presents the Neuro Spectral Classification Model (NSCM), a logical emotion detection scheme that is cross-validated with the traditional Support Vector Machine (NSCM) learning scheme to assess its efficacy. In order to map emotions to speech patterns computationally, possible characteristics are retrieved from every syllable. Gender may be determined by detecting pitch from the traits that have been chosen. This work utilizes the Neuro Spectral Classification Model (NSCM) for gender classification. Utilizing the characteristics that were previously chosen, the suggested model was able to demonstrate that functional produce outperformed the state-of-the-art method, NSCM, in terms of emotion identification accuracy. Also included are the various classifiers' contributions to the performance and limitations of speech emotion recognition systems.

articleTitle: Enhancing Stock Market Prediction with an LSTM-Attention Model Integrating Macroeconomic and Sentiment Features
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The forecasting of stock price movements has remained an open issue for a long time because of the unpredictable and nonlinear patterns of the data. To improve the precision of time series models for stock market prediction, this paper presents a new LSTM -attention model. The proposed method is different from statistical and machine learning models as LSTM can model long-term dependencies in the temporal data and attention layer is used to handle with noise in stock price temporal data. Furthermore, this paper proposes an enhancement to feature engineering where the model has more contexts about the market through the use of macroeconomic indicators, sentiment analysis of financial news articles, and historical stock prices. Application of the model to historical data of major indices is shown in experiments that at an average of 89.7% prove the model to be a notable improvement over the baseline models. The methodology for time series forecasting is considered to be an improvement over current approaches for advancing accuracy of predictions in financial applications, especially stock markets, and is useful for investors and analysts in decision-making.

articleTitle: Stress Detection from Social Media Data by Graph Attention Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The changes in human body in both mentally or physical will be considered as stress. Stress can be positive or negative. Positive stress helps us to motivate, alert during critical situations. For example during exam, a positive stress can be help to stay awake longer and might help our body to work harder. But if person go continues stress without relaxation and relief then it lead to health issue such as hair loss, heart attack and physiological problem. Stress can be diagnosed through counselling or medical practice. But in restricted lab environment it is difficult to express and measure correctly. The process is complex and lab experiment is costly. Stress and physiological related clinical process required more privacy. In today world people share their thoughts, feeling, emotion, current life status through social media. Social media data reflects the particular human life status in real-time. There are lot of Deep Learning and Natural Language processing available for text processing and sentiment analysis. Most of the modelsare rules based on the positive and negative score assigned to the words or phrase. The association between the words and grammatical structure is not considered for the prediction. The main goal of this project is to identify stress detection based on the Graph Attention Networks and Relational Graph Attention Networks. The sentence is constructed as Graph with wordsas nodes and relation between the words as edges. Social media datasets(SAD and Dreaddit) are preprocessed, trained and tested by GAT and RGAT. The results are compared with SVM and Multinomial Naive Bayesian. The accuracy for SAD and Dreaddit is 95 % and 77 % respectively. The accuracy is relatively higher than the expected accuracy provided in the data set publication.

articleTitle: An Experimental Model to Predict Bone Cancer Disease by Using Hybrid Learning Principles with Image Processing Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Bone cancer is a rare but aggressive disease that requires early and accurate detection to ensure better outcomes for patients. This paper presents a novel approach for predicting bone cancer disease using hybrid learning principles integrated with advanced image processing techniques. The proposed model combines Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) for feature extraction with Random Forest for classification, utilizing AutoEncoders for dimensionality reduction to optimize performance. The methodology is applied to a comprehensive bone cancer dataset consisting of X-ray images collected from various public and medical sources. A robust preprocessing pipeline, including noise reduction, resizing, and segmentation, enhances image quality for precise feature extraction. The model was compared against nine existing models, including CNN, SVM, DenseNet, and VGG16. Performance evaluation using metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, F1-Score, and AUC demonstrates the superior performance of the proposed model. The model achieved an accuracy of 97.81%, significantly outperforming existing models like VGG16 and DenseNet. The hybrid model's ability to minimize both false positives and false negatives makes it highly effective for medical diagnosis applications.

articleTitle: Data Governance in the Big Data Era: A Scalable Framework for Effective Management and Regulatory Compliance
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: While big data enhances the capacity of organizations to make choices, the traditional data governance approaches are not productive enough to manage the explosion of volume, variety, and velocity of data. This inadequateness leads to loss of data integrity, inabilities to adhere to legal frameworks and poor use of available data. This study provides a solution by providing an easier way to apply data governance concepts using a framework that is elastic and scalable enough for today's data environment. In addition to this, study helps a firm maintain quality of data, compliance, and interactivity through the use of metadata strategies. This relatively new tool helps to manage data governance more effective and innovatively so that the organization can harness the business aspects within big data through the proper deployment of the data governance structure.

articleTitle: Integrating IoT for Enhanced Flood Monitoring: A Raspberry Pi Pico-based System with Real-time Data Visualization and Early Warning Alerts
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This paper outlines the development of an innovative flood monitoring system using IoT technology, Raspberry Pi Pico, and various sensors to track conditions near reservoirs. Placed in flood-prone areas, the hardware unit integrates a Wi-Fi module (ESP8266) for data transmission, while sensors measure critical parameters such as level, temperature, humidity, and flow. The collected data is displayed on an LCD screen and simultaneously transmitted to an IoT web application. The system employs the ThingSpeak web application to securely store data in a private channel. In the occurrence of a flood, the web application promptly alerts relevant authorities and the public. This comprehensive flood monitoring system aims to significantly improve early warning capabilities, providing timely information to enhance disaster preparedness and response strategies. The integration of IoT technology with real-time data visualization contributes to effective flood management and mitigation efforts.

articleTitle: A Novel Methodology Design to Predict Hate Speech on Social Media Using Machine Learning Principles
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Hate speech detection on social media platforms has become increasingly critical in maintaining a safe and inclusive online environment. This study proposes a novel methodology combining Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT) with Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) to improve the accuracy and robustness of hate speech detection models. The BERT-CNN hybrid model leverages BERT's contextual understanding of language and CNN's ability to capture local patterns in text data. The methodology involves comprehensive data collection from Twitter, including both labeled and unlabeled datasets, followed by rigorous data preprocessing, including text cleaning, tokenization, and feature extraction using Transformer-based embeddings. The proposed model was evaluated against nine existing models, including LR, SVM, RF, NB, DT, CNN, LSTM, BiLSTM, and BERT. The results demonstrate that the BERT-CNN hybrid model outperforms all other models, achieving an accuracy of 92.34 %, indicating its effectiveness in both precision and recall metrics. This study's findings highlight the potential of hybrid models in advancing hate speech detection technology on social media platforms.

articleTitle: IIALS: A Novel Methodology to Predict Lung Nodule Cancer on Earlier Stages by Using Integrated Image Assistive Learning Strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Lung cancer is one of the leading causes of cancer-related deaths globally, and early detection of malignant lung nodules is crucial for improving patient survival rates. This study presents a novel methodology, IIALS (Integrated Image Assistive Learning Strategy), which uses an ensemble of EfficientN et and Support Vector Machines (SVM) to enhance the prediction of lung nodule malignancy at early stages. The proposed model was tested on two widely used datasets, LUNA16 and LIDC-IDRI, and demonstrated superior performance compared to other state-of-the-art methods. The EfficientNet architecture was employed for robust feature extraction, while SVM was used for classification, ensuring a high level of precision. The model achieved an accuracy of 96.8% on the LUNA16 dataset and 95.4% on the LIDC-IDRI dataset, outperforming existing methods such as ResNet50 and Faster R-CNN. Key metrics such as sensitivity (97.2% on LUNA16), specificity (96.4% on LUNA16), and F1-Score (97.0% on LUNA16) further highlight the effectiveness of the proposed approach. The use of attention mechanisms, multi-scale feature extraction, and hybrid classification techniques contributed to these impressive results. This approach demonstrates the potential of advanced deep learning (DL) techniques in improving lung cancer detection, offering a reliable tool for clinical application.

articleTitle: A Robust Methodology for Fruit Quality Prediction and Estimation Using Intelligent Learning Based Image Processing Logic
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Fruit quality prediction plays a vital role in agricultural and food industries, ensuring that only high-quality produce reaches the consumer. Traditional methods of assessing fruit quality rely on manual inspection, which is both time-consuming and prone to human error. This paper presents a robust methodology for fruit quality prediction and estimation, utilizing a hybrid deep learning model that integrates DenseN et for feature extraction with LightGBM for efficient classification. The proposed model is designed to automate the process of fruit quality assessment by analyzing key attributes such as color, texture, and shape from high-resolution fruit images. The Fruit360 dataset was used for training and testing, with images classified into categories such as fresh, ripe, overripe, and damaged. A comprehensive comparison with nine existing models, including SVM, Random Forest, and XGBoost, was conducted using performance metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, and Fl-score. The proposed model achieved an accuracy of 96.78%, significantly outperforming all other models. Furthermore, the model's precision and recall reached 95.33% and 95.67%, respectively, demonstrating its reliability in distinguishing high-quality fruits from low-quality ones.

articleTitle: Yield Prediction with AIML and Digital Twin Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: With the increase in population across the globe, demand for food increases with it, putting extreme pressure on the agricultural sector to increase its production despite climate changes and natural disasters. To counter these challenges, we recommend a system that uses artificial intelligence and machine learning, coupled with Digital Twin technology, in making yield predictions. This project presentation discusses Agriculture 5.0 and how cutting-edge technologies can change the way farming is done conventionally. This can show how improvements in technology enhance productivity, sustainability, and efficiency based on yield prediction and digital twins. For example, with yield prediction analytics and IoT help farmers predict crop yields to help guide their decisions; with digital twins, for instance, we can create virtual representations of physical assets to monitor and analyze the operation enhancements that result in real time, close to it. We demonstrate, through case studies, the power of these innovations to potentially make a difference in significantly increasing output and efficiency of use in addressing global demand and sustainability challenges for food. This project underlines a high transforming potential in technology for modern agriculture.

articleTitle: FNOC: A Superficial Learning Methodology to Predict Digital Image Forgeries Using Fuzzy Enabled Neural Optimization Classifier
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: There has been an explosion in the production and dissemination of altered and false images in recent years, thanks to the widespread availability and user-friendliness of image editing programs. Many methods have been suggested for determining whether a image is genuine and, in certain instances, for identifying where the image has been changed or falsified. In order to assess the efficacy of the suggested system, this study introduces a novel deep learning model named Fuzzy enabled Neural Optimization Classifier (FNOC) and uses it in conjunction with the more traditional learning technique known as Support Vector Machine (SVM). In order to identify fakes, the suggested method employs a FNOC to glean characteristics based on residual noise from images. In order to differentiate between genuine and altered images, this method entails discovering the pattern of noise that the counterfeit process leaves behind. The capacity to handle undetected forgeries is a major advantage of employing a FNOC for image forgery detection. Traditional methods of detecting image forgeries can be challenged by more advanced technology. Yet, FNOCs can pick up on patterns that aren't established explicitly, so they can spot forgeries that weren't there before. The use of FNOCs to the identification of image forgeries has enormous promise in the fight against the issue of image manipulation. Digital images used in contexts ranging from medical reports to crime scene investigations might benefit from this technology's increased dependability and trustworthiness with more development.

articleTitle: Smart Street Post Enhancement for Sustainable Campuses and Cities
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The urban and rural landscapes are rapidly changing and the modification of the existing ordinary street posts presents an opportunity to create smarter, more sustainable localities and campuses. The proposed enhancements in this work include the integration of smart lighting systems, harnessing renewable energy from available resources, environmental sensors for monitoring air quality and environmental conditions. Furthermore, to enhance public safety and security, this work incorporates an emergency call service box on the street post. The monitored environmental data are displayed in real-time using the digital display. The provision of device charging ports is an added advantage. This work throws light on how ordinary street posts can be enhanced using Internet of Things (IoT)technology to create more sustainable living environments and campuses.

articleTitle: Integrated Wildlife Monitoring System for Real-Time Anti-Poaching and Conservation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: To develop a wildlife monitoring system for anti poaching and conservation using YOLOv8 (You Only Look Once) with CSPDarknet (Cross Stage Partial Darknet) Backbone for real time object detection to identify and classify humans, animals from live image feeds which helps in detecting poaching activities. The system integrates various environmental sensors that act as transmitter side includes temperature, flame and acoustic sensor to monitor key changes that indicate forest fire. These sensors are connected through the LoRa (Long Range) network (Up To 10kms areas with clear line of sight) which efficiently transmits data to the central monitoring unit(here CMU Central Monitoring Unit refers to the forest ranger) that refers to a receiver module. In addition, the system comprises DFRobot Mini Player to trigger natural warning calls (Vocalizations that are produced by animals to alert their group and coordinate groups that are essential part of animal communication and survival strategy) based on the detected data to prompt animals not to be driven out of forest. Thus contributing environmental sustainability and habitat suitability for many species.

articleTitle: A Novel Development of Virtual Wardrobe Design Based on Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Enabled Technologies
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Almost every day, every person encounters the dilemma of what to wear. The issue is not that the users lack access to a sufficient number of outfits to wear; rather, it is that they are unable to keep track of the clothing they keep donning and have not touched in a long time. Not only does a smart wardrobe assist the user in maintaining a record of their clothing, but it also provides recommendations for what to wear based on the user's calendar events. The system generates statistical reports that reflect the frequency of utilization of the clothing, enabling the user to determine which ones are suitable for donation or sale. Additionally, a mobile application enables users to manage their clothing from any location. In this study, a novel approach is introduced, the IoT Virtual Wardrobe (IoTVW), which is cross-validated against the conventional model Classical Controller-Assisted Wardrobe (CCW), with the assistance of the Internet of Things (IoT) and Artificial Intelligence (AI). The proposed scheme is evaluated for its efficiency. The primary objective is to integrate a collection of technologies into a system that can be utilized to assist the user in the planning of their clothing. To accomplish this objective, it is imperative that we are capable of distinguishing between garments that are frequently worn and those that are seldom worn. It is necessary to organize our clothing into categories such as casual, formal, and function wear. The application will furnish statistics that illustrate the garments that are frequently worn and those that have not been handled in an extended period.

articleTitle: Smart Vehicle Security System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The Smart Vehicle Security System is an innovative project designed to enhance the safety and access control of vehicles through advanced technologies. Leveraging facial recognition, the system captures and analyses images of individuals approaching the vehicle, comparing them against pre-registered profiles stored in a secure database. This technology guarantees that the car is only available to authorised drivers; any illegal attempts will be immediately reported to the owner via notifications on her mobile device. The system goes beyond conventional security measures by incorporating an in-built drowsiness detection mechanism, actively alerting drivers when signs of fatigue are detected to prevent potential accidents. By seamlessly integrating facial recognition and access control, coupled with proactive drowsiness detection, this project seeks to offer a whole solution for strong vehicle security and safety.

articleTitle: Low Power Optical and Gate for Photonic Integrated Circuits
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: A periodic nanostructure called a photonic crystal is utilized to create logic gates. In this paper, the AND gate is designed in the 2D photonic crystal. Defects in the Si rod-based square lattice have been created to actualize the two inputs. The AND gate's performance has been examined using the Finite Difference Time Domain (FDTD) approach. The AND gate has a minimum contrast ratio of 4.6dB and a maximum contrast ratio of 7.71dB. Also it offers bit rate of about 3.125Tbps. The logic gates performance is improved by the bit rate and contrast ratio. This device will have higher speed and low power consumption. It can be widely used in optical computing, optical devices, etc.

articleTitle: Dynamic Key Generationfor Secure File Sharing System Using Time Stamp
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Dynamic key generation for secure file sharing system using timestamp is a novel approach to military-based secure file sharing, which adds an additional layer of security to AES-2S6 which is prominently considered as the military-grade encryption. It is designed to enhance the confidentiality and integrity of transmitted files. When a Sender uploads a file, the system prompts for a character, converts it to its ASCII value, adds the current system time value to it and utilizes this aggregated value as a unique code to secure the uploaded file. To retrieve a file, the user must possess either the file key or initiate the retrieval process during the exact time of the original upload or in the next precise clock cycle. The combination of these factors provides an extra layer of security, making unauthorized access significantly more challenging.

articleTitle: A Robust Methodology to Detect Glaucoma Disease using Modified Deep Learning Principles with Image Processing Logics
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Glaucoma is a leading cause of irreversible blindness, requiring early and accurate diagnosis to prevent vision loss. This study proposes a robust methodology for detecting glaucoma using a hybrid approach that integrates deep learning (Autoencoder) with a machine learning classifier (Multi-Layer Perceptron). The methodology utilizes image processing techniques, including noise reduction and data augmentation, to enhance the quality of retinal fundus images. Feature extraction was performed using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Gabor filters, followed by dimensionality reduction through Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and wavelet decomposition. The model was tested on multiple publicly available datasets, including RIGA, HRF, ACRIMA, and Kaggle. The hybrid model achieved an accuracy of 97.1% on the RIGA dataset, 95.6% on the HRF dataset, and 96.3% on the ACRIMA dataset. The model outperformed traditional classifiers such as Support Vector Machine (SVM) and Random Forest, which achieved accuracies of 92.3% and 94.5% on the RIGA dataset, respectively. The study demonstrates that combining deep learning with machine learning classifiers, along with effective preprocessing, significantly improves glaucoma detection accuracy. Furthermore, explainable AI techniques were employed to enhance model interpretability, ensuring that clinical practitioners can trust and understand the model's decisions.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Switched Reluctance Motors with Different Slot Pole Combinations for Quadcopter Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This work focusses on the design of Switched Reluctance Motor (SRM) for drone application. The motor is designed to generate 2 kg of thrust with 0.8 Nm torque. A comparison of different slot and pole combination viz 12/8, 18/12 and 24/16 to is performed to assess their suitability. The basic performance parameter such as torque along with flux linkage and inductance are analysed. The simulation is performed using Finite Element Analysis (FEA) based software. The results indicate that the 24/16 SRM configuration outperforms the other configurations.

articleTitle: Sound Sight-A TTS and STT Integrated Model Using OCR and ASR
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This paper discusses the feasibility of using an automated pipeline that is text-to-speech and speech-to-text, which will be powered with the usage of Optical Character Recognition (OCR) that may be used for extracting text from images or documents and Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) which can be used for the benefit of using algorithms and machine learning techniques to give more accurate results. The paper also explores the system architecture, with also a look at the methodology as it implements the technologies.

articleTitle: NextGen Robot: An Efficient and Effortless Wall Painting Robot Design Based on Artificial Intelligence (AI) Principles
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: A fully autonomous wall-painting robot is the focus of this paper's development, expansion, and implementation efforts. Research efforts have not communicated much about interior wall painting. Painters’ eyes and respiratory systems are particularly vulnerable to the toxic chemicals used in the industry. Additionally, the monotony, time commitment, and physical exertion inherent in the painting process are hard to resist. The entire construction process may be enhanced and time and labor saved by using robots and human workers appropriately into building jobs. The Dynamic Smart Painting Robo Model (DSPRM) is a novel robot that this study introduces for intense wall painting. To test its efficacy, it is crossvalidated with the usual technique, the usual Painting Bot (CPB). Furthermore, it would provide an opportunity to lessen or eliminate human exposure to challenging and dangerous conditions, which would address most of the issues, provide protection, and make it happen more often. An autonomous robotic painting system is being developed as a result of the wall painting robot.

articleTitle: Apple Leaf Disease Identification Using Resnet50
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Apple leaf disease is a primary issue limiting apple yield and quality. The standard diagnostic approach requires considerable time for illness detection, causing farmers to frequently miss the optimal period for prevention and treatment. The detect of leaf diseases through leaf imagery is a vital study area in computer vision, with the primary objective being to devise an effective method for representing images of sick leaves. The efficient diagnosis and categorization of plant diseases constitutes a significant research aim in agriculture. This paper proposes a novel deep learning, ResNet. To evaluate the efficacy of the ResNet model, a number of comparative experiments were performed with leading transfer learning methodologies. This demonstrates that the proposed method is both possible and successful.

articleTitle: Experimental Procedure to Develop an IoT Based Smart Home Automation System Using Intelligent Sensors Association
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This paper presents the development and implementation of an IoT-based Smart Home Automation System using intelligent sensors. The system integrates various sensors, such as motion detectors, temperature, and gas sensors, along with microcontrollers (NodeMCU, Arduino) to automate household appliances. The objective was to enhance convenience, energy efficiency, and security by automating control based on real-time data. During the testing phase, the system demonstrated significant energy savings, with an average reduction of 15.8% in energy consumption. The response time of the system averaged 232 milliseconds across all sensors and actuators, ensuring quick response to changes in the environment. Sensor accuracy was measured, and the temperature sensor showed an average deviation of only 0.48%, while the light and gas sensors had deviations of 0.58% and 0.42%, respectively, indicating high reliability. User satisfaction surveys conducted over one month showed an overall satisfaction rate of 8.7/10. These results affirm that the system is effective in providing reliable home automation, reducing energy consumption, and offering users a responsive and easy-to-use interface. The system can be easily scaled and adapted to future smart home applications by integrating additional sensors and devices.

articleTitle: Blockchain-Based Framework for Secure IoT Data Transmission
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In response to the growing demand for security in IoT networks. Technology that is decentralized is used in this architecture. The suggested architecture includes blockchain oracles to securely connect blockchain with off-chain Internet of Things data. By using decentralized and secure Internet of Things oracles, this guarantees verifiable and trustworthy real-time data flow. Furthermore, artificial intelligence-powered Internet of Things security procedures are used to monitor and defend Internet of Things devices against emerging cyber threats. These techniques include threat intelligence solutions supported by blockchain technology and anomaly detection powered by AI. The IOTA Tangle architecture is utilized by the framework. This architecture provides scalable and fee-free data transfers, making it ideal for Internet of Things ecosystems. Strong, secure, and effective communication between Internet of Things devices is ensured by this method. Increased data integrity, privacy, and real-time threat detection from multiple devices are also made possible by it. This study presents a potential solution to the security issues that contemporary IoT systems are now facing, as well as an examination of the practical implementation of these technologies in protecting data transmission over the Internet of Things (IoT).

articleTitle: Early Detection of Glaucoma Utilizing Retinal Nerve Fiber Layer (RNFL) Investigation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Early detection of glaucoma is essential for preventing permanent vision loss. Glaucoma, a degenerative eye illness that affects the optic nerve, causing vision degeneration without any obvious symptoms in the early stages. One hopeful method for early glaucoma detection is Retinal Nerve Fiber Layer (RNFL) analysis, which assesses the chunkiness of the Nerve Fiber Layer (NFL) in the Retina. Changes in RNFL thickness, particularly thinning, are an early indicator of glaucoma and can be detected before substantial visual injury occurs. Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT) is universally used for RNFL analysis, offering high-resolution images of the retina and enabling precise measurements of RNFL thickness. Through RNFL analysis, clinicians can identify patterns of nerve fiber thinning that correspond to early glaucomatous injury, permitting for timely involvement and treatment. This method can help with glaucoma therapy by reducing disease development and preserving patient's quality of life. Nonstop advancements in imaging technology and automated RNFL assessment tools are further enhance the accuracy and availability of early glaucoma detection.

articleTitle: Electric Vehicle Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The performance of electric vehicle (EV) batteries is evaluated using Internet of Things (IoT) technologies, as discussed in this article. The article describes the development of a real-time “fuel gauge” for electric vehicle (EV) batteries and presents a scalable method for measuring the voltage of each battery cell during charging. Since EVs rely entirely on battery power, performance degradation over time is a significant concern for battery manufacturers. To overcome this issue, this paper suggests a direct monitoring system that makes use of IoT technology. The monitoring device and the user interface make up the two primary parts of the suggested Internet of Things- based battery monitoring system. According to experimental findings, the system is capable of identifying reduced battery performance and informing the user of the need for additional action. In additionally simulation of entire setup is done in proteus software tools.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence-Driven Predictive Analytics for Early Detection of Chronic Diseases in Primary Healthcare
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: To discover patterns and risk factors that are associated with chronic illnesses including diabetes, hypertension, and cardiovascular difficulties, the objective of this study is to investigate these connections. The usage of machine literacy algorithms and big datasets will be how this objective will be realized. To develop prophetic models that can relate early warning indicators, the procedure involves integrating patient data and electronic health records (EHRs). This is done to train the models. According to the findings, AI-driven approaches have the potential to greatly increase the delicacy and punctuality of judgments, which will finally result in the improvement of patient troubles and the reduction of expenses linked with healthcare. In addition to this, the paper includes a consideration of the ethical and practical challenges that are associated with the application of such technologies in the context of standard clinical practice. It places a focus on the significance of having robust data governance and continual model confirmation. This paper draws attention to the transformative potential of artificial intelligence in primary healthcare and urges for its abandonment to proactively treat chronic diseases and reduce the burden they place on society.

articleTitle: Experimental Evaluation of Artificial Intelligence Based Solar Air Heater Design and Performance Metrics Assesment
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The earth's most harmless easily obtainable renewable energy resource from the sun. a solar air heater (SAH) is a type of solar system which uses direct sunlight to lift the heat of the air. It is vital in everyday use like as heaters in homes and structures and industrial applications such as humidification and dehumidification and food processing industries.
