The drawback of traditional air heater is the poor convective coefficient of heat transfer with the air with its absorbing surface as a result of the air's low warmth ability, which reduces heat efficiency. Various authors have been described the functionality of solar-powered air heaters and its flow characteristics through experimental investigation and CFD simulations based on Reynolds numbers. Our aim is to improve its thermo physical properties so to optimize its performance, modify the material used and the shape of the heater with varying degrees of inclination.

articleTitle: Prediction of CKD Using Choas Based Particle Swarm Optimization (CBPSO) with Ensemble Method
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) is the high prevalence and incidence health issue which is frequently triggered by late diagnoses. It must be identified early in order to prevent expensive end-stage medications such as dialysis and kidney transplantation. A cost-efficient approach is to predicting complications of CKD and death rates which has been developing the effective risk prediction models. This paper focused in implementing modified Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) by introducing chaos based concept as a guide line for improving the optimization by logistic map search as Choas Based Particle Swarm Optimization (CBPSO). The CBPSO has assisted to improve the feature extraction for better prediction from the ensemble method. However, the ensemble method is implemented for assist in filtering and wrapping to choose the most significant feature based on weighted average concept in diagnosing CKD. Therefore, this research focused on CBPSO with ensemble method using three classification methods namely, Logistic Regression (LR), Random Forest (RF)and K-Nearest Neighborhood (KNN). In addition, the result outcome evaluates the performance of CBPSO with ensemble SVM method with 10-cross validation method generate better accuracy of 98.50% in predicting CKD from the obtained dataset.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of a Multi-Output DC-DC Converter for Automotive Applications with PI and FOPID Controllers
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This paper describes a dc to de converter with many outputs designed to provide various voltage levels required for different automotive equipment, such as lighting and wipers. The proposed architecture independently delivers outputs of 24V, 12V, and 6V without mutual interference among the loads. The circuit is simulated using Matlab/Simulink, and both Proportional-Integral (PI) and Fractional Order Proportional-Integral-Derivative (FOPID) controllers are employed for closed-loop analysis. The proposed system generates regulated output without affecting other loads during their operations. Additionally, hardware configurations were implemented to verify the simulated outputs for 60V/12V, 6V, and 24V conversions. The results demonstrate the effectiveness and reliability of the proposed converter design in practical applications.

articleTitle: MobileUNet Based Flood Region Segmentation in UAV Images for Developing Early Flood Warning and Disaster Management System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: To support people with information on natural disasters, numerous early warning systems have been developed. Most of these systems employ a suitable computer-algorithm to process the data received from various sensors and its outcome help to provide necessary alert when there is severe abnormality. This study aims to develop a deep-learning (DL) based automatic flood region segmentation system from the digital images collected using the unmanned-Areal-Vehicle (UAV). This process help to detect the severity of the flood level in a chosen location. To reduce the implementation complexity and to enhance the detection accuracy, this work considered the MobileUNet (MU) scheme. The different phases of this tool includes; image and mask collection and resizing, training the MU with image and mask, segmentation of the flood region, and executing the pixel wise comparison between segmented binary section and the mask to computer the necessary metrics. The outcome achieved with MU is compared with chosen UNet models and the overall result of this study confirms that the proposed MU helps to achieve a better Jaccard (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$94.41\pm 0.13$</tex>), Dice (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$98.11\pm 0.06$</tex>), and accuracy (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$98.49\pm 0.02$</tex>) compared to other chosen DL-methods. This confirms that the implemented technique provides better result on the chosen database.

articleTitle: Gain Enhancement of Dual-Band Patch Antenna using EBG Array
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In this paper, the analysis on the dual-band antenna deployed withelectromagnetic band gap (EBG) is proposed. The proposed EBG based dual-band antenna aims to maintain the S11 results below - 10 dB. Two rectangular patches were design and fed with a single port. With proper matching network using quarter wave length matching and power divider, these antennas are fed with electromagnetic (EM) wave. The proposeddesign operates at 2.4 and 3.3 GHz frequencies. Above the dual band antenna, an EBG surface is placed as superstrate to achieve gain enhancement. The EBG superstrate forms a gain enhancement two frequency bands. The gain is increased from 5.995 dBi to 6.466 dBiat 2.5 GHz band while from 3.195 dBi to 3.431 dBiat 3.3 GHz band.

articleTitle: Computer Vision Techniques for Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The objective of this work is to investigate the applications of computer vision techniques in the field of object identification, as well as the developments that have occurred in these techniques. The primary objective of this research is to investigate the most recent methods that have been developed to support the ability of machines to immediately detect and classify objects that are contained within images and video aqueducts. The utilization of deep literacy models and convolutional neural networks (CNNs) is utilizedto investigate these techniques. The inquiry focuses on infrastructures and algorithms, such as YOLO (which was originally known as You Only Look), SSD (which stands for Single Shot MultiBox Sensor), and Faster R- CNN, with an emphasis on their performance, delicacy, and computational efficiency. YOLO was once known as You Only Look. In addition to this, the research investigates the challenges that are experienced during the process of object detection. One of these challenges is dealing with occlusions, another is recognizing small objects, and yet another is coping with changing lighting conditions. To provide insight into the implicit advancements and new directions related to the enhancement of item-locating skills, the objective of this research is to provide information. Exhaustive testing and analysis are how this is accomplished. The findings of the investigation indicate that the contribution.

articleTitle: Early Detection and Classification of Type-2 Diabetes Using Stratified k-Fold Validation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: One of the diseases that spreads most rapidly in the globe is diabetes, that can lead to a number of serious complications, including as neuropathy, renal failure, diabetic retinopathy, and cardiovascular disease. Today, a large number of scientists and physicians have created machine learning Models. Even with the advancement of machine learning techniques, there are two major obstacles that researchers and physicians still need to overcome in order to create prediction models for type 2 diabetes. Stratified k-fold cross validation and a straightforward machine learning technique called logistic regression are used in this study to overcome all of these problems and increase the model's accuracy. Our model outperforms all other machine learning implemented model with higher accuarcy of 98.24% on Diabetes Dataset.

articleTitle: Enhanced Model for Brain Tumor Detection Accuracy Using Inceptionresnetv2 compared to VGG19 and MobileNet Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Brain tumors, arising from unregulated and accelerated cellular proliferation, provide considerable health hazards if not promptly addressed. Notwithstanding significant progress, precise segmentation and classification continue to pose difficulties. Artificial intelligence (AI) and medical imaging technologies have advanced recently, greatly improving illness analysis and prediction, particularly with regard to brain tumor (BT) identification. Precise classification and segmentation of tumors in the brain are essential for creating individualized treatment plans, and early detection of brain tumors is essential for improving patient prognosis and available treatments. Even with the increasing usage of Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) for brain imaging and the development of AI-based detection techniques, developing a reliable and effective model to identify and classify cancers from MRI images is still a difficult task. Brain tumor analysis is essential for timely diagnosis and effective patient management. Tumor morphology, encompassing features such as dimension, position, appearance, and heteromorphic shape in medical images, poses challenges for analysis. Advancements in DL approaches for the automatic identification of tumors present in the brain using MRI data have led to the utilization of numerous algorithms for this purpose. The InceptionResNetV2 model is employed due to its efficiency and efficacy; it is a simple deep learning architecture, rendering it a suitable candidate for medical image processing applications. The proposed model attains an accuracy rate of 100% at an epoch rate of 30 and surpasses the performance of both MobileNet and VGG19 models.

articleTitle: Data Privacy and Cybersecurity Law: Regulatory Challenges and Compliance Strategies
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: It is now more crucial than ever to safeguard sensitive information and prevent unauthorized access, given the rapid expansion of data collection, storage, and processing capabilities facilitated by modern technology. This essay investigates the obstacles associated with complying with regulations and implementing strategies to guarantee cybersecurity and data privacy. This study delves into the ever-evolving and dynamic realm of Regulations regarding the protection of personal information, with a particular emphasis on the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), GDPR, by examining the effects on both organizations and individuals. The essay emphasizes the importance of instituting comprehensive cybersecurity measures and discusses the escalating prevalence of cyberattacks. Risk assessments, data encryption, incident response strategies, and staff training are identified as essential components of compliance. The objective of this publication is to help enterprises navigate the complexities of data privacy and cybersecurity regulation by providing a comprehensive analysis of the current regulatory landscape and suggesting practical solutions for compliance.

articleTitle: Automatic Vehicle Speed Control System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The automatic vehicle speed control system (AVSCS) is a cutting-edge automotive innovation designed to enhance road safety and driving comfort. Integrating advanced sensor technology, AVSCS enables real-time monitoring of vehicle speed and distance from surrounding vehicles, automatically adjusting the throttle and brake to maintain a safe following distance. By leveraging intelligent algorithms and control mechanisms, [1] AVSCS optimizes driving efficiency and minimizes the risk of collisions, contributing significantly to accident prevention and overall road safety. This project aims to explore the potential of AVSCS in revolutionizing modern transportation, providing a foundation for the development of future intelligent driving systems.

articleTitle: Bridge the Generalization Gap: A Comprehensive Framework for Enhance Reliability and Robustness in Deep Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) has been successful in a wide range of domains but its broad acceptance is limited by the generalization gap, which measures the performance difference between an environment a model was trained with versus new, unseen environments. This gap implies a challenge that needs to be addressed for DRL models used in real-world adaptation. This paper considers a strategy whose methodology outlines combining domain randomization, multitask learning, and regularization techniques. The study trains the models on multiple tasks and diverse environments, thus generalizing the ability of models. Our regularization strategy keeps the model from over-specialization to the training data and ensures improved performance. Benchmark environments are evaluated based on our approach, reducing the generalization gap with improvement in average returns in unseen environments and increasing the resilience of DRL models. In this regard, our study opens up the avenue for a significant contribution to the generalization capacity of more robust DRL models for real-world applicability.

articleTitle: A Moderated Deep Learning Approach for Retinal Blood Vessel Segmentation Hybrid Neural Classification and Optimization Logic
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Retinal blood vessel segmentation (RBVS) is a crucial task in ophthalmic and cardiovascular disease diagnosis, particularly in conditions like diabetic retinopathy, glaucoma, and hypertensive retinopathy. This paper presents a deep learning (DL)-based hybrid approach combining Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and transformer models for accurate retinal vessel segmentation. The hybrid architecture integrates CNNs for local semantic feature extraction and transformers for capturing long-range spatial dependencies. Image quality was enhanced by the usage of pre processing techniques, like green channel extraction and histogram equalization. The model was trained and evaluated on three publicly available datasets: DRIVE, STARE, and CHASE_DB1. Hybrid CNN was proposed which attains state of the art performance with an accuracy of 96.05% on the DRIVE dataset, 96.20% on the STARE dataset and 95.85% on the CHASE_DB1 dataset. The model performed with sensitivity values of 78.20%, 79.00%, and 78.00% in the segmentation of the fine and delicate vessels. The results show that the hybrid CNN outperformed the traditional U-Net and other DL approaches in sensitivity, Dice coefficient, and F1 score. These results demonstrate the promise of the hybrid CNN-transformer approach for medical image segmentation, and also for improving early disease detection.

articleTitle: Wind and Solar Mobile Charging Station with IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Modern mobile charging stations that combine IOT technology with solar and wind energy provide effective and sustainable power solutions for public spaces. This cutting-edge system produces electricity for charging mobile devices by utilizing renewable resources like solar and wind power. Real-time monitoring, control, and optimization of energy production and consumption are ensured by IOT integration. Because of its mobility, the station can be placed in a variety of public settings with flexibility, providing convenient and environmentally beneficial charging options and serving as an example of how renewable energy can be used in public areas.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Approach for Securing Textual Data Using Hashing, Encryption, and Steganography
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In today's digital era information security has become a major challenge especially in communications where private data is transmitted. This paper introduces a new hybrid technique to protect data by combining various security mechanisms such as hashing, symmetric encryption, asymmetric encryption and steganography this method combines MD5 and SHA-256 hashes to verify data integrity uses AES encryption to ensure confidentiality uses RSA to protect encryption keys and uses steganography to hide encrypted information in images which increase security by making information difficult to detect, this comprehensive approach improves confidentiality integrity and overall data protection making it ideal for digital communications and secure data transfers.

articleTitle: DNTS: Experimental Evaluation of Underwater Image Quality Enhancement Scheme Based on Dense Neural Transformation Scheme
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Underwater image quality faces challenges such as light absorption, scattering, and color distortion. This paper proposes a new underwater image enhancement scheme. It is called Dense Neural Transformation Scheme, abbreviated as DNTS, which has been cross-validated with classical deep learning approach called Convolutional Neural Network, CNN, to assess the efficacy of the proposed model. The proposed method uses a dense neural network architecture tailored to overcome the characteristics of underwater imaging. This architecture has the capability to learn complex transformations that could correct color aberration, enhance contrast, and visually restore the quality of the image. The DNTS architecture is based on a densely connected layer which allows the model to accept quite high levels of image degradation. This makes it possible to perform efficient feature extraction and refinement at any depth in the network. That's why our approach is validated by improved visible detail and more accurate color representation of the restored images. This work presents a comprehensive description of DNTS capabilities and its potential applications in marine studies and underwater exploration. The proposed approach yields a robust solution toward improving the quality of underwater images and enhancing more discriminative visual observations in underwater scenarios.

articleTitle: CDNN: A Novel Methodology Development to Detect Online Social Network Cyberbullying Threats Using Convoluted Deep Neural Network Principle
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Advanced methods for effective detection and prevention are required due to the growing prevalence of cyberbullying on online social networks. The Convoluted Deep Neural Network Principle (CDNN) is employed in this research to introduce a novel method for identifying cyberbullying threats. In order to extract hierarchical features from a variety of data inputs, the CDNN framework incorporates multiple layers of convolutional networks. The proposed model is cross-validated with the conventional classifier called Support Vector Machine (SVM) to evaluate the efficiency of the proposed scheme. The model captures the complex structures typical of cyberbullying behavior by processing these inputs through a successive convolution and pooling layers. We have performed a series of in-depth experiments to test this model with the ability to identify or classify cyberbullying incidents using a dataset that contained all manner of social networking interactions. The results we get prove that the performance of the CDNN-based approach outperforms traditional methods and other related deep learning models, in which it shows the detection accuracy rate as high as 98.02% detected by our model. More importantly, the robustness of CDNN toward different types of contents provided for cyberbullying can be mainly enhanced by its ability to handle multimodal data sources. Results emphasize the effectiveness of CDNN in tackling very complex issues related to recognition of cyberbullying and the precise platform for monitoring online activities.

articleTitle: Advanced Autism Spectrum Disorder Detection with Hybrid Image Features and Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) is a neurodevelopmental condition that affects communication and social behavior. Early detection and timely intervention are critical for ASD detection. This work proposes an improved approach to ASD detection using a combination of state-of-the-art imaging features and state-of-the-art machine learning models. For feature extraction, manual methods such as SURF, Zernike Moments, Wavelet Transform and deep transfer learning models like EfficientNet and MobileNet are used. The extracted features are combined to form a hybrid feature set, which are then classified using advanced ML models including gradient Boosting, random forest, LightGBM and CatBoost. With the fusion approach, the performance is significantly improved for ASD detection. This work highlights the use of novel image features and ML classifiers in the context of ASD detection.

articleTitle: An Efficient Methodology to Audit Data in Cloud Storage to Ensure Reliability and Integrity Using Secured Crypto Schemes
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Cloud storage has revolutionized how organizations and individuals store and manage data by providing scalable and cost-effective solutions. However, the primary concern remains ensuring data integrity, reliability, and security. This paper explores an efficient methodology to audit cloud storage data, using a combination of secured cryptographic schemes. Techniques such as Third-Party Auditing (TPA), Dynamic Provable Data Possession (DPDP), Random Sampling, and Sentinel-based Proof of Retrievability (POR) are employed to guarantee data accuracy and integrity. The methods are evaluated based on audit time, integrity verification rates, and storage overhead. TPA achieved a near-perfect accuracy of 99-100% in data integrity verification but incurred higher audit times. Random Sampling, with a 92-96% accuracy rate, offered significantly reduced audit time while maintaining high integrity verification. Sentinel-based POR exhibited 98-100% accuracy and provided an excellent balance between security and audit performance. Overall, Random Sampling and POR were the most efficient techniques, making them suitable for large datasets. This methodology ensures robust cloud storage auditing, significantly improving performance, reducing overhead, and preserving user privacy.

articleTitle: MDISL: Experimental Evaluation of Learning Based Potato Plant Disease Detection Using Modified Deep Image Segmentation Logic
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Using a combination of AutoEncoder and the Xception model, this research proposes a unique method for the identification and classification of potato plant diseases, notably Early Blight and Late Blight. To effectively diagnose illnesses from potato leaf photos, a sophisticated deep learning (DL) technology is incorporated into the suggested methodology. Three thousand photos of healthy, Early Blight, and Late Blight leaves were included in the collection, which was taken from the Plant Village database. To guarantee consistent input data, preprocessing methods including picture scaling, normalization, and data augmentation were used. The AutoEncoder was utilized for feature extraction and dimensionality reduction, while the Xception model performed the classification task. The AutoEncoder-Xception model achieved a testing accuracy of 97.2%, outperforming traditional machine learning (ML) models such as Random Forest (RF) (91.5%), SVM (89.3%), and KNN (87.1%). The model demonstrated superior performance in terms of precision, recall, and F1-score, with values consistently above 95% across all classes. Confusion matrix analysis further confirmed the model's robustness, with minimal misclassifications observed.

articleTitle: Development of an IoT Enabled Smart Children Tracking and Monitoring System Using Map Location Services
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The development of an IoT-enabled Smart Children Tracking and Monitoring System using map location services was aimed at providing real-time monitoring and enhanced safety for children. This system incorporated GPS for location tracking, sensors for health monitoring, and an emergency alert mechanism. The hardware design featured microcontrollers such as Arduino and NodeMCU, while a mobile application provided a user-friendly interface for parents to track their children's location, set geofencing boundaries, and receive emergency alerts. Testing demonstrated that the GPS tracking accuracy in urban and suburban environments had an average error of less than 5 meters, while rural areas exhibited an average error of around 12 meters. The heart rate sensor showed an accuracy of 97.5%, with a maximum error margin of 2.5%. Emergency alert response times varied from 1.5 seconds in strong Wi-Fi conditions to 5 seconds in weak GSM areas. User feedback showed high satisfaction, with an overall rating of 4.7 out of 5 for usability and reliability. The system successfully integrated real-time monitoring, health tracking, and emergency alerts to offer a comprehensive solution for child safety.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Insights into Fetal Genomics for Predicting Developmental Anomalies
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This paper improves fetal health monitoring: The goal is to transform prenatal healthcare by developing a cutting-edge software platform for ongoing fetal health monitoring and analysis using a Django Server for Comprehensive Tracking and Analysis. This system handles and analyzes IoT sensor data on fetal health measures, including as heart rate, movement, and other critical indicators, using a robust, scalable backend server built with the Django web framework. Real-time data collection, storing, and analysis are done by Django's core server. The system uses machine learning and contemporary data processing techniques to identify health-related patterns. By giving physicians useful information, these tools help them identify fetal abnormalities early and improve outcomes. Expectant parents and medical professionals can view real-time health metrics on the website's user-friendly dashboards and graphs. The project's major component is its intuitive desktop and mobile web interface. Parents can track their unborn kid through this interface, and clinicians can view patient data in real time, analyze trends, and make informed decisions. Proper actions are taken on time through messages or alerts for abnormal readings with the help of the intelligent alert mechanism of the system. This real-world application of health care based on Django bridges with IoT data collection for an all-inclusive and effective fetal health monitoring program. Real-time monitoring, intelligent analytics, and easily available visualizations enhance prenatal care through providing early and accurate insights toward improving maternal and fetal outcomes.

articleTitle: Implementation of GSM Wireless Technology Based Remote Notice Board
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The goal of the “GSM-Integrated Remote Notice Board” project is to develop a cutting-edge communication system that uses GSM technology to enable remote alerts and announcements. It is frequently difficult for traditional notice boards to reach a larger audience or to update information quickly. Creating a wireless e-notice board that shows messages submitted from the user's mobile device is the primary goal of this project. A SIM card placed in a GSM modem at the receiving unit receives messages sent by users. The shift register IC on the microcontroller was interfaced with by the GSM modem. The microcontroller receives the message and forwards it to an electronic notice board that has a display unit interfaced with a microcontroller. One of the main advantages of the suggested system is that it may function in regions with GSM coverage, guaranteeing connectivity even in isolated or difficult-to-reach places. Because of the system's user-friendly architecture, administrators may simply change and manage the presented data by sending short text messages. The initiative also intends to optimize the system for dependability and reduce power usage. The remote notice board system may find use in a number of settings, including public transit, community centers, educational institutions, and businesses.

articleTitle: Diagnosis of Alzheimer Disease from Multi-Modal Data: Role of Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is another area of medical research concern mainly due to the current prognosis of the disease that is further impacting the patient and health care organizations. This paper aims at investigating the performance of the predictive model that employs artificial intelligence (AI) to forecast Alzheimer's disease based on clinical histories, neuro-images, and genomics. The CNN integrated with LSTM can allow for the analysis of such multifaceted data sources since it has outstanding performance in processing and interpreting the data. To understand Alzheimer's disease, we used a combination of CNNs and LSTMs. CNNs helped us identify patterns in brain scans, while LSTMs analyzed how clinical and genetic factors changed over time. The following model defines an enhanced decision-making approach that could prove useful in early diagnosis and treatment regimen planning compared to standard approaches. Based on the findings, multi-modal data contributes significantly to the identification of Alzheimer's disease prediction with high accuracy and less variability so that fruitful intervention trials and research would be well pioneered strategies.

articleTitle: Advanced Optimizing Network Security in Manets: A Comprehensive Multilevel-Optimization and Monitoring Mechanism (Multi-Omm)
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: With the proliferation of the Internet of Things (IoT), mobile ad hoc networks (MANET) have become an essential component of contemporary wireless communications. These networks, which rely on multi-hop data transmission, offer significant flexibility and adaptability. However, their open and dynamic nature makes them vulnerable to various internal and external security threats. Among these, Black hole attacks by malicious nodes present serious challenges. Traditional security measures, such as firewalls and encryption, often fall short in addressing these threats. Therefore, there is an urgent need for advanced intrusion detection systems tailored for these environments. Additionally, node selfishness-where nodes conserve their resources at the expense of others-further disrupts network performance and violates protocols. To address these issues, we propose the Multilevel Optimization and Monitoring Mechanism (Multi-OMM), a novel algorithm designed for real-time detection and prevention of malicious activities. Multi-OMM employs a multi-phase approach to enhance network security through traffic pattern analysis, dynamic topology inspection, and targeted attack detection. By implementing and evaluating Multi-OMM through comprehensive experiments, we aim to demonstrate its effectiveness in identifying and mitigating both selfish and malicious behaviors, thereby improving overall network security and performance.

articleTitle: Experimental Evaluation of a Novel Methodology to Predict Employee Attrition Using Elevated Deep Gradient Optimization Logic
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Employee attrition prediction is a critical challenge for organizations as it impacts productivity, continuity, and financial performance. This study proposes a novel cascaded methodology combining Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) and Support Vector Machine (SVM) models, enhanced by deep gradient optimization techniques, to predict employee attrition. The dataset, preprocessed through feature selection and synthetic oversampling (SMOTE), included key employee features such as monthly income, job satisfaction, and overtime. The proposed methodology was tested against other models, including Random Forest (RF) and Logistic Regression (LR). The cascaded MLP+SVM model achieved a training accuracy of 94.5% and a test accuracy of 92.1%, outperforming standalone MLP (89.7%) and SVM (86.5<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>). The model also showed minimal overfitting, with only a 2.4 % difference between training and test accuracy. Key performance metrics, including an F1 score of 0.83 and an AUC score of 0.91, confirmed the model's ability to classify employees likely to leave accurately. The model's ability to predict employee attrition helps organizations proactively retain critical talent by addressing factors like job dissatisfaction and high overtime.

articleTitle: An Efficient Model for Brain Tumor Classification Through Transfer Learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Brain tumor classification is a critical task in medical diagnostics, where early and accurate detection can significantly improve patient outcomes. This work proposes an efficient model for brain tumor classification using CNN and transfer learning techniques. Initially, a base model CNN applied to MRI images of human brains collected from Kaggle which is classified into four categories. To enhance classification performance, four transfer learning models-VGG19, ResNet50, InceptionV3, and EfficientNetB0-are utilized alongside CNN. Each transfer learning model is fine-tuned and optimized to extract relevant features, improving classification accuracy and robustness. Model performance is evaluated using accuracy. Experiments demonstrated that the proposed approach given high accuracy, when compared to traditional models.

articleTitle: A Real-Time Robotic Movement Control System Based on Hand Gesture Recognition Using Human Computer Interaction (HCI) Principles
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This paper presents a real-time robotic movement control system (RMCS) utilizing hand gesture recognition through a Cascaded CNN-SVM approach. The system was designed to enhance human-robot interaction by allowing users to control RMs seamlessly through gestures. Extensive testing was conducted on a dataset comprising various gestures, achieving an impressive overall recognition accuracy of 93.6%. Specific gestures, such as “Wave” and “Point,” demonstrated recognition accuracies of 95.2% and 93.8%, respectively. The system was also evaluated for response times, with an average response latency of 125 ms, ensuring efficient real-time operation. User feedback highlighted high levels of satisfaction, with average ratings of 4.4 for intuitiveness and 4.5 for the likelihood to recommend the system. These results indicate that the Cascaded CNN-SVM model is effective in recognizing gestures with high precision while maintaining low latency, making it suitable for practical applications in RMCS.

articleTitle: An Error-Free and Reliable Data Communication Between People Using Human Body as a Network Medium
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This study presents the development and validation of a reliable and error-free data communication system using the human body as a network medium. By leveraging capacitive coupling as the transmission method and optimizing signal frequency in the 5 MHz to 10 MHz range, we achieved a significant reduction in Bit Error Rate (BER), with values as low as 0.05% at 10 MHz for stable body parts such as the chest. Extensive impedance measurements revealed that the body's conductivity varied under different physiological conditions, affecting signal transmission. We implemented real-time error detection and correction using Cyclic Redundancy Check (CRC) and Reed-Solomon codes, reducing data loss to 0.2% and ensuring synchronization times as low as 5ms for two devices. Our Frequency Division Multiplexing (FDM) technique improved synchronization efficiency and minimized errors, making it feasible to manage communication among up to 10 devices. The system's performance is evaluated through a series of signal transmission experiments, demonstrating high reliability with a data transfer rate of 570 Kbps at the head and chest. Overall, our results confirm that the human body can serve as an effective medium for secure and reliable data communication, with minimal interference and high accuracy.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Impact of Artificial Intelligence Integration on Data Protection in Healthcare Sector
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The integration of Artificial Intelligence(AI) in the healthcare sector has revolutionized data operation and case care, presenting both significant benefits and substantial challenges. This exploration paper aims to dissect the impact of AI integration on data protection within the healthcare assiduity. By examining colorful AI operations similar to prophetic analytics, individual tools, and substantiated treatment plans, the study assesses the counteraccusations for patient sequestration and data security. crucial enterprises include the eventuality of data breaches, the acceptability of being legal fabrics, and the ethical considerations girding AI-driven decision-making processes. The paper also explores the measures espoused by healthcare associations to guard sensitive information and misbehave with data protection regulations. Through a comprehensive review of current practices and nonsupervisory norms, the study provides perceptivity into the balance between using AI advancements and icing robust data protection. This analysis is pivotal for guiding unborn programs and practices in healthcare data operation, aiming to enhance patient trust and secure the benefits of AI integration.

articleTitle: Predictive Analysis for Sales Forecasting Using Machine Learning: Leveraging Data-Driven Insights for Enhanced Business Planning and Decision-Making
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Within the modern trade scene, leveraging prescient investigation for deal estimating has developed as a basic procedure for organizations pointing to optimize their decision-making forms. This consideration centres on the application of the XG Boost calculation, a well-known machine learning method, to tackle data-driven experiences for upgraded deals determining, thus encouraging prevalent commerce arranging. Through an in-depth investigation of authentic deals information, the inquiry about illustrates the noteworthiness of consolidating machine learning strategies, especially the XG Boost calculation, for exact and solid deal forecasts. By leveraging a comprehensive dataset including different variables affecting deals, such as client socioeconomics, regular patterns, showcasing activities, and financial markets, this exhibits the algorithm's capability to capture complex connections inside the information and produce exact figures. Besides, the investigation emphasizes. interpretability of the XGBoost calculation, empowering partners to comprehend the fundamental components affecting deal expectations. This straightforwardness cultivates a more profound understanding of the driving powers behind deal patterns, encouraging educated decision-making and proactive commerce arranging.

articleTitle: INCS: A Novel Brain Tumor Detection Methodology Design Based on Deep Learning Assisted Intelligent Neural Classification Strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Brain tumors must be detected as soon as possible. Biopsies can only be taken after final brain surgery, which is the only way to classify brain tumors. Brain tumors can be better identified and classified with the use of computational intelligence-oriented approaches. In order to help doctors detect tumors early on with high accuracy, we presented two deep learning methods and multiple machine learning approaches for diagnosing three different types of brain tumors using magnetic resonance brain images: glioma, meningioma, and pituitary gland tumors. We also included healthy brains without tumors. By training on any dataset, deep learning algorithms may extract features. These methods are built on multi-layered neurons. One kind of deep learning technique is the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), which is designed to extract features from datasets with rich spatial information, like images. Using that reasoning as a foundation, this work introduces a novel model, the Intelligent Neural Classification Strategy (INCS), and tests its efficacy through cross-validation with the more traditional CNN model. When brain tissue grows abnormally and becomes malignant when left untreated, it is known as a brain tumor. An MRI scan is the first step in the diagnostic process, followed by a trained radiologist's visual examination. Computerizing the work of brain MRI categorization is an actively explored issue since it is tough to find trained professionals in poor countries. A customized INCS has been taught to detect tumors on MRI images in this research study. Researchers check the model's correctness by comparing it to other models they've developed.

articleTitle: A Logical Evaluation of Predicting Immune System Strength by using Enhanced Deep Learning Strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The immune system plays a crucial role in defending the body against diseases, making it vital to develop models that can accurately predict immune system strength. This study presents an Enhanced Deep Learning Strategy (EDLS) designed to predict immune system strength based on immune-related biomarkers such as White Blood Cell (WBC) count and Immunoglobulins. A dataset consisting of 23,654 records with 12 features was collected from clinical sources. The data underwent comprehensive preprocessing, including noise reduction using a Median Filter, feature selection with Random Forest, and data fusion using Kalman Filters. The EDLS model integrates AutoEncoder for dimensionality reduction and Cascaded Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) for capturing temporal dependencies. The proposed model outperforms nine traditional and advanced machine learning models, including Logistic Regression, Support Vector Machine (SVM), and Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), with an accuracy of 94.72%. Evaluation metrics such as Precision (92.01%), Recall (93.77<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>), and F1-Score (92.88<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>) highlight the model's effectiveness in predicting immune system strength. Feature importance analysis reveals that WBC count and Immunoglobulins are the most influential predictors. This study demonstrates the potential of EDLS for enhancing immune strength prediction, which can have significant implications for personalized healthcare and disease prevention.

articleTitle: Deep Learning for Multipurpose Plant Disease Detection and Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The objective of this work is to design a plant leaf disease detection system using deep learning models such as Mobilenet, ResNet50, and InceptionV3. This includes getting a tagged dataset of plant pictures, preprocessing the information, and then leveraging the benefits of transfer learning using the pre-trained weights of the models. The final layers of the models designs are modified considering the number of classes in the dataset. Models performance is evaluated after training by using test data. Implementation is based on Tensor Flow and Keras frameworks. Models produced have wide-variety-real applications, namely online as well as mobile platforms. The application was developed with Tensor Flow Lite and Flutter, considering the development of Android mobile applications, and it showed the flexibility of the models toward the mobile platform and transformed the study into a practical utility. This research highlights the importance of maintaining eyes on the system, which further calls for changes if necessary so that the associated performance can be maximized in the production environment. To put it shortly, work done in this paper describes some automated techniques used to identify plant diseases. Systems like these will be the effective and practical solution for early recognition and correction of diseases in the agricultural sector.

articleTitle: Machine Learning for Employee Turnover Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The main problem is that employees leaving the company has a big affect on its costs, efficiency, and effectiveness. By accurately estimating employee turnover, businesses can take proactive steps to keep good employees and lower the costs of hiring and teaching new ones. This research looks at how machine learning techniques can be used to predict staff turnover by looking at things like employee demographics, job satisfaction, success indicators, and engagement levels. Training and testing of the models were done with a dataset that included both old and new data from a big organisation. The results of this research are very helpful for human resource managers who are trying to fix problems with disengaged employees and make policies that keep employees. The research say that machine learning systems can accurately predict how many employees will leave a company.

articleTitle: Frequency Reconfigurable Wearable Antenna Using Varactor Diode
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In this work, a frequency reconfigurable wearable antenna incorporating a varactor diode is proposed. The antenna is designed using a Felt substrate, chosen for its lightweight, flexible, and low-loss properties, making it particularly suitable for wearable applications. The conductive element is fabricated using Shieldit Super™, a highly conductive material that ensures efficient RF performance while maintaining the mechanical flexibility required for integration with wearable devices. The antenna design includes a complete DC biasing circuitry to control the varactor diode's operation. The biasing network is carefully integrated to minimize interference with the antenna's RF performance. The design and simulation were carried out using CST Microwave Studio, an electromagnetic simulation tool widely used for antenna analysis. The proposed design achieves frequency tuning in the range of 2.38 GHz to 2.55 GHz by applying a reverse bias voltage between 0 V and 8 V to the varactor diode. This continuous tuning capability is critical for wearable applications requiring adaptability to changing environments or multiple communication standards. Additionally, the antenna achieves a bandwidth of 380 MHz, spanning from 2.27 GHz to 2.65 GHz, which further enhances its versatility for broadband applications. The gain of the antenna remains stable across the tuning range, which is an essential parameter for wearable antennas to maintain consistent performance. The results indicate that the proposed design effectively combines frequency reconfigurability with stable gain and bandwidth performance. This makes it a strong candidate for wearable applications, particularly in environments where frequency flexibility and compact, lightweight designs are critical. Future work could focus on optimizing the biasing circuitry for lower power consumption and exploring the integration of this antenna with textile-based systems for enhanced usability.

articleTitle: Developing an Electroencephalogram Based Robotic Motion Control System Using Brainwaves Enabled Signal Processing Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This work presents the development of an Electroencephalogram (EEG)-based robotic motion control system utilizing brainwave-enabled signal processing techniques. The system is designed to translate mental commands into real-time robotic actions, offering a non-invasive brain-computer interface (BCI) for users. The system involves EEG signal acquisition, preprocessing, feature extraction, and classification using machine learning algorithms, followed by robotic control via a real-time interface. Data was collected from 10 participants performing four mental tasks: move forward, turn left, turn right, and stop. The classification accuracy across these tasks ranged from 84% to 94%, with an average accuracy of 88%. Response times for translating mental commands into robotic actions varied between 205 milliseconds and 280 milliseconds, ensuring near real-time control. Testing under different environmental conditions (normal, noisy, fatigued) showed the system's robustness, although there was a slight drop in accuracy under noisy (80-85%) and fatigued (81-88%) conditions. User satisfaction scores indicated a positive overall experience with high ratings for ease of use and perceived accuracy. The results demonstrate the system's potential for applications in assistive technologies and rehabilitation robotics.

articleTitle: Exploring the Empirical Possibilities Soil Quality Assessment System using Internet of Things Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: What the doctor's pulse is to a doctor, soil is to a farmer. This information is useful for making decisions on watering schedules, seeding dates and types, fertilizer applications, and more. Soil analysis for total organic matter, pH, and accessible nutrients is a common practice among growers who send samples to academic or private labs. Determining if the soil is saline (excessive salt) or sodic (excessive sodium) is also prevalent in dry locations. Soil chemical health and any imbalances can be learned from this. To maximize the usefulness of soil testing, it is recommended to collect soil samples regularly (every two years is a minimum) and maintain detailed records. Before you go crazy applying fertilizer, check to see whether your soil test results are still within the ideal range. We suggested an AI-based soil health monitoring system to achieve this goal. Crop yields are reduced by climate change, scarce water supplies, and unfertile soil. Agricultural organizations are increasingly turning to the Internet of Things (IoT) and AI methods in an effort to address these issues. In order to assess the efficacy and performance of the suggested model, this study presented a new technology called IoT Soil Quality Assessment (IoTSQA), which is cross-validated with the traditional GSM based Soil Quality Assessment (GSMSQA).

articleTitle: Adaptive Fraud Detection in Digital Banking Using Deep Learning: A Hybrid CNN-RNN Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Financial fraud in digital banking has evolved to a point that is quite complex, meaning that there are greater needs for a more effective and efficient system for detection of financial fraud. The traditional rule-based system used to detect fraudulent use of financial instruments such as credit cards and banking systems experience quite high rates of false positive. Also, relatively low rate of effectiveness in detecting the fast-evolving fraud pattern. The result, of course, is that financial losses to both the institutions that maintain such systems and the clients themselves. This paper presents a model for detecting fraud in a digital banking system designed on deep learning approaches including a sequence of recurrent neural networks and a variety of convolutional neural networks for learning patterns on real-time transactions data. The model generates highly accurate values of 95.2%, as well as precisions and recalls of highly accurate values of 91.0% and 89.3%, respectively. Furthermore, the model generates better results in comparison to the systems used in existing applications, which produce the average accuracy of about %. The processing time of the model is relatively short, which takes about 15 ms, and in the meantime, the model generates low levels of false positives and relatively high rates of real fraud detection, which are assessed at 65%. Overall, the research topic presents an efficient and effective solution for fraud detection, which is highly adaptive and scalable to detect fraud in an environment where no weaknesses in the rule-based legacy systems are experienced.

articleTitle: Individual Privacy Protection in Cybersecurity Using Data Analytics and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Traditional cybersecurity addresses struggle to keep up with the ever-changing nature of cyber threats and usually fail to detect new privacy breaches. The paper proposes a proactive protection mechanism that employs data analytics and machine learning (ML) to promote individual privacy in the digital realm. The system analyzes several data sources, including system events, network traffic, and user activity logs, using advanced ML methods like Random Forests (RF), Support Vector Machines (SVM), and Neural Networks (NN), to detect and prevent privacy violations. Ensemble learning techniques, feature engineering, and real-time monitoring enable adaptability in the face of shifting threats. According to the results, the proposed system surpassed the existing system in terms of accuracy (0.92), recall (0.89), precision (0.91), and F1 score (0.90). Its ability to detect unlawful access, unusual logins, and irregular data requests is proved by anomaly detection rates utilizing One-Class SVMs (91%) and Isolation Forest (89%). The system's low false positive rate of 5% demonstrates how effectively it can detect privacy breaches, resulting in stronger cybersecurity and greater privacy protection for both individuals and enterprises.

articleTitle: Evaluating Retail Investor Responses to AI-Based Trading Tools in Chennai's Stock Market
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Stock dealers in Chennai use traditional trading systems. These systems require users to make decisions and use simple technological indications. It also results in up-and-down investing results influenced by emotions and personal beliefs. These systems attempt to make sense of complicated data and keep up with market sentiment in real time, limiting their effectiveness. To address these issues, the proposed system leverages advanced machine learning techniques such as reinforcement learning (RL) and natural language processing (NLP) to provide real-time, data-driven trading advise. The RL technique improves trading strategies by trial and error, whereas sentiment analysis assesses market mood using various text sources. The results reveal that the new system has a 20% ROI and a Sharpe ratio of 1.3, outperforming traditional methods. It also has lower maximum decreases, indicating that it manages risk better. The AI-driven strategy not only helps stock traders make more accurate decisions, but it also gives them tools to better manage their investments and assess risk in a volatile market.

articleTitle: Experimental Evaluation of Identifying Fraudulent Activities in E-Commerce to Protect Consumers by Using Intelligent Deep Learning Methodology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: To make use of and analyze the vast quantities of data produced by online transactions, advanced cyber-infrastructure and information technology approaches are required. In this research, we provide a big data platform that online stores may use to address a number of problems plaguing the e-commerce sector. Businesses and individuals alike are susceptible to fraud, a global issue. Deep Learning and AI have been tremendous assets in the fight against fraud in today's tech-driven world. Electronic wallets and credit cards were among the first digital payment options offered with the rise of online marketplaces. The goal of implementing a fraud detection system is to identify and prevent fraudulent transactions that involve stolen or unverified credit card information. With the use of a deep learning algorithm, this work intends to offer substantial assistance, leading to the creation of a new model known as the Deep Regression Classification Model (DRCM). To assess the efficacy of the suggested model, it is cross-validated with the typical learning method known as Naive Bayes (NB). Electronic commerce platforms may improve their security posture, increase user trust and confidence, and reduce financial losses by implementing AI-powered fraud protection methods. This groundbreaking method represents a sea change in the fight against online fraud and highlights the revolutionary power of AI to protect consumers and companies. A system that employs an effective deep learning technique for precise fraud detection will be conceptualized and developed based on the results of the experimental assessment.

articleTitle: Designing User-Friendly Interfaces with Human-Centered AI
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This research aims to explore the potential of using mortal-centric artificial intelligence in the process of creating interfaces that support the lifestyles of stoners. It emphasizes the importance of stoner experience and the practicality of the most advanced technologies now on the market. The goal of this research is to better understand the ideas behind mortal-centered design so that we can use AI to improve how stoners interact with digital interfaces. The goal of this investigation is to create user interfaces that can adapt to the unique requirements and tastes of each stoner. This is the inquiry's objective. To achieve this, the principles of intuitive design and adaptive literacy algorithms will be applied. To determine the effectiveness of these AI-powered interfaces, a mixed-style approach is required. This technique combines the qualitative input from stoners with the quantitative needs for usability. The idea of employing artificial intelligence focused on mortals to transform stoner interface design is being advanced, as the main findings show notable gains in stoner pleasure and engagement. The goal of this study is to contribute to the emerging field of human-computer commerce by providing insight into the creation of digital environments that are more user-friendly and accessible to stoners through the deployment of potent artificial intelligence techniques. By giving information regarding the creation of digital environments, this will be achieved.

articleTitle: Detection of Autism Spectrum Disorder Using Deep Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Autism, also referred to as autism spectrum disorder (ASD), affects behaviour, social interaction, and communication. While autism is not curable, early intervention and therapy can improve the social and communication abilities of individuals affected by it, leading to a better quality of life. Traditional methods for diagnosing ASD depend on professional clinical judgement, which is subjective and labor-intensive. Therefore, dependable and unbiased methods for the early identification of ASD are necessary. This work aims to develop a web application for detecting Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) by utilising deep learning and machine learning models that analyse several behavioural aspects associated with ASD.

articleTitle: An Experimental Evaluation of Flagging Sensitive Contents Over Social Networking Environment Using Elevated Classification Logic
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The amount of sensitive content blankets on social networking platforms is rising quickly, necessitating the necessity for swift identification and removal measures. In this paper, our focus is on the capacity of social network flagging systems to recognize and block offensive content. In the rapidly evolving landscape of social networking, the ability to effectively flag sensitive content is crucial for maintaining platform integrity and user safety. This paper introduces an advanced methodology for identifying and managing sensitive content through the Elevated Learning based Classification Logic (ELCL) framework, in which the work is cross-validated with the conventional learning algorithm called Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) to evaluate the efficiency of the proposed scheme. The proposed approach ELCL integrates sophisticated classification algorithms with contextual analysis to enhance the accuracy and efficiency of content moderation in social networking environments. By employing a multi-tiered approach that includes deep learning models and semantic analysis, ELCL can detect nuanced and context-dependent sensitive content that traditional systems often overlook. The framework utilizes a combination of supervised learning for training on labeled datasets and unsupervised learning to adapt to emerging content trends. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that ELCL significantly improves the precision of content flagging, reducing false positives and missed detections. This research highlights ELCL's potential to advance content moderation practices, offering a robust solution for safeguarding user experiences and ensuring compliance with community standards. The impact of user behavior, site affordances, and content type on flagging are also taken into account. This knowledge will help to design better content moderation systems which are both efficient and ethical, in order to make real benefits for the safety and well-being of users on online platforms.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Models for Climate Change Prediction on Winter Season and Impact Assessment in Tamil Nadu
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Global warming is still a massive problem for areas like Tamil Nadu, especially during the season beginning with the letter W which is winter. This work employs artificial neural networks and support vector machines to forecast winter climate shifts and analyze potential consequences for agriculture, road networking, and human health. These models were trained using historical climate data and it yielded low mean absolute errors of 0.85 °C for temperature, and 5.20mm for rainfall. The extreme weather events were identified with great efficiency and their classification was determined to be 89% accurate. Scientific forecasts for winter 2024 show the crop production cut by 14%, transportation disturbances by 53%, and the threat of epidemics by 30%. The findings indicate that system integration with machine learning can help in climate adaptation interventions in Tamil Nadu. Future work will have to involve real-time adaptation and inclusion of socio-economic features for better predictions.

articleTitle: An Improved Multiple Clustering Model for Infrastructures-Based Multi-Hop Vehicular Communications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: An IMCIV model is a novel approach to managing clustered vehicular and ad-hoc networks (VANETs) through Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) cellular connectivity over 5G LTE. Weighted cluster selection, a new clustering method that considers the model uses distance and reliability as well as travel speed to optimize network performance. The robust end-to-end communication IMCIV provides remains operational even during system failure or outages. An experimental setup implemented using ns-3 on Ubuntu OS with C++ for network construction and Python for analysis shows significant improvements over existing protocols, namely ABIC, PPMO, and UMMR. IMCIV's top performance is reflected in its key performance metrics, which include the highest network throughput of12 Kbps, the lowest network delay of 75.49 ms, the lowest number of inbounds per packet of 267.16, and the highest transmission accuracy of 96.58%. the protocol offers an exceptional energy efficiency of 268.49 joules, which is crucial for extending the life of vehicular networks. The selection of dual cluster heads enhances network flexibility by ensuring data transmission across the primary and secondary cluster heads, thus improving network adaptability. This comprehensive evaluation confirms that IMCIV not only addresses existing VANET challenges but also significantly improves network performance and reliability. The outcomes demonstrate the utility of IMCIV in modern vehicle networks, demonstrating its potential to enhance communication and data exchange under different scenarios.

Author Keywords: Multi-Hop Vehicular Communications and Weighted Cluster Selection

articleTitle: Detection of Neurocognitive Impairment in the Elderly Using TabNet Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: As the global population ages, neurocognitive disorders like the Alzheimer's disease which is a form of dementia, and several other forms of dementia are becoming more commonplace. These conditions significantly impair the quality of life for patients and present a growing challenge for healthcare systems worldwide. Early detection is critical to improving patient outcomes, yet traditional diagnostic methods often struggle to catch on to the very early and subtle signs of decline in cognitive function. In this paper, a deep learning algorithm, TabNet, is used on clinical data to detect neurocognitive impairment. Before applying the algorithm, Exploratory Data Analysis is also performed to get a better understanding of the dataset. This research is mainly focused on people with family history. The TabNet model, designed especially for tabular data easily and effectively learns the importance of each feature and their inter-dependencies. In future work, it is aimed to make this research more holistic by using Vision Transformer models to analyze MRI images. This study currently focuses on clinical data, which includes demographic, lifestyle, and cognitive assessments, and demonstrates how TabNet can be used to identify signs of cognitive impairment. Working with critical features, this study also focuses on data pre-processing and feature selection. This project's main aim is to utilize AI in healthcare to help with diagnoses that are otherwise somewhat difficult to make.

articleTitle: MobiGuard: An IoT-Based Monitoring System for Persons with Walking Disability at Home Integrating Computer Vision, Mobile Application, and Schedule Reminder
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Individuals with walking disabilities face heightened risks, particularly during sudden disasters like fires, as they are more likely to be left behind or abandoned. Reports of fire incidents involving such individuals highlight the need for better safety measures. Caregivers, often juggling multiple responsibilities, struggle to provide constant supervision, making it challenging to ensure a safe and comfortable environment for those under their care. Traditional care methods, including physical aids and manual monitoring, offer limited real-time support, especially during emergencies. This capstone project, titled MobiGuard, addresses these problems by developing an IoT-based monitoring system that integrates computer vision, a mobile application, and a schedule reminder to enhance care and safety for persons with walking disabilities. MobiGuard provides a solution through three main components: computer vision-based person tracking through the YOLOv8, allowing caregivers to monitor the individual remotely while tracking their movements and detecting potential fire hazards. A mobile application for assistive communication between the individual and the caregiver, ensuring assistance requests and emergency alerts are prioritized. Lastly, a task scheduling system with real-time reminders and audio alerts to help caregivers manage medication and daily activities efficiently. To ensure that the MobiGuard system met its specified requirements, the researchers conducted an evaluation based on the ISO 25010:2011 software quality model. The system was assessed in four key areas: Functional Suitability, Performance Efficiency, Reliability, and Usability. The evaluation revealed a mean score of 3.63 for Functional Suitability, rated as “Very High.” Performance Efficiency scored an average of 3.64, also classified as “Very High.” Reliability received a mean score of 3.52, similarly rated as “Very High,” and Usability was evaluated with a score of 3.63, likewise classified as “Very High.” These consistently high ratings across all categories indicate that the MobiGuard system performs both effectively and efficiently.

articleTitle: LUNA - A Bilingual Virtual Assistant for Windows with Voice Recognition Intelligence Using AI
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The study focuses on the LUNA paradigm, a smart personal assistant program specifically designed for Windows computers. LUNA provides an intuitive interface where users can communicate with their computers via both keyboard input and voice commands. This dual input method enhances accessibility and user convenience for performing a wide range of tasks. The assistant streamlines daily activities such as casual conversation, web searches using search engines like Bing, Google, or Yahoo, watching movies, checking the weather and setting reminders for events or tasks. A significant feature of LUNA is its potential to assist individuals with speech or visual impairments, as it employs Natural Language Processing (NLP) to comprehend and respond to natural voice commands. This makes it particularly useful for mute or visually impaired users, offering them greater independence in interacting with their computers. The assistant's ability to understand and process natural speech enhances the user experience, allowing for seamless task execution through voice searches, which are notable for their speed and efficiency. Additionally, LUNA supports multilingual input, making it adaptable to a variety of languages, thereby broadening its usability across different linguistic contexts.

articleTitle: Smart Agriculture: Leveraging IoT and Machine Learning in Wireless Sensor Networks for Precision Farming
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This research explores the challenge of incorporating IoT with Machine Learning (ML) applications to Precision Agriculture, particularly the use of wireless sensors for irrigation control. Information from sensors that monitor key parameters including temperature, humidity, moisture, and water levels are used to forecast water requirements and control pumps. Support vector machine (SVM), Decision tree (DT), Random Forest (RF) and Naïve Bayes (NB) techniques are adopted for the analysis to find out their accuracy levels. It is observed from all the above-performed models that among all, the SVM has the maximum prediction rate of the given dataset and is slightly outperformed by only the DT and RF. The confusion matrix which points to the misclassification patterns of each model gives an insight into identifying the best ML approach for use. The convergence of IoT and ML guarantees flexibility and responsiveness when controlling and designing agricultural systems. It is this approach that has the potential to enhance water resources management as well as address issues precipitated by climate change and growing worldwide food demand.

articleTitle: Fake Social Media Profile Detection Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The use of social media through Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, and LinkedIn sites in communicative purposes has become very common all over the world but is still challenged by an emerging fictitious profile established by humans, bots, and other automated systems. The spread of information by these accounts along with the issue of identity theft and phishing gives a great threat to security. It is an artificial neural network-based model on detecting fakes among authentic profiles, which are of user accounts of Twitter with high precision, and the basis for this profiling of authenticity lies in necessary calculations of metrics such as follower counts and friend counts plus status changes. It further tried to increase the precision with critical feature selection in the procedure, as well as the optimization of the structure of hyperparameters of the ANN model. Thus, it aims at ANN in this research study to come up with robust solutions regarding the improvement of integrity and security in social media.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence and Data Science Approaches to Analyzing Human Resource Management in Hybrid and Remote Work Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Fresh challenges and opportunities are emerging in the field of Human Resource Management (HRM) as a result of the implementation of hybrid and remote work modes. This investigation investigates the use of artificial intelligence and data science tools to evaluate HRM practices in dynamic work environments. The study employs AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics to investigate critical HRM characteristics, including engagement, productivity, and performance, in hybrid and remote environments. The study underscores the importance of data-driven methodologies for optimising HRM policies, incorporating sentiment analysis into workforce planning, and utilising predictive analytics in workforce planning. The research aims to provide practical insights to human resources professionals and corporate executives in order to improve management strategies and cultivate a remote workforce that is both efficient and inclusive.

articleTitle: Impact of Blockchain Technology on Digital Marketing Platforms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This exploration paperexploresthe transformative influence of blockchain technology on digital marketing platforms. It examines how blockchain's decentralized, transparent, and secure features address current issues in digital marketing, similar to fraud, data sequestration, and inefficiencies. By assaying case studies and assiduity operations, the paper highlights blockchain's implicit to revise advertising through enhanced data integrity, bettered consumer trust, and optimized targeting techniques. The study also discusses the challenges associated with blockchain relinquishment, including technological complexity and scalability enterprises. Through comprehensive results of current executions and theoretical perceptivity, the exploration provides a nuanced explanation of blockblockchain's part in reshaping digital marketing practices and its counteraccusations for unborn trends.
