The findings aim to offer precious perceptivity for marketers, technologists, and policymakers interested in using blockchain to enhance the effectiveness and translucency of digital marketing sweats.

articleTitle: Hybrid Models for Classifying Liver Cirrhosis with SVM and Xgboost Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Detecting and controlling cirrhosis that destroy liver tissue is major issue in liver part. More complex machine learning may better predict this complex disease. In this paper, a novel hybrid classification model combining SVM and XGBoost models is proposed to help improve the effectiveness of liver cirrhosis detection. This paper assesses multiple algorithms for liver disease classification using clinical and laboratory data as a large healthcare dataset. Using SVMs optimal hyperplanes for classification and XGBoost resilient gradient boosting framework to identify how your data is related itself A hybrid model. Model performance is improved during training where hyperparameters and feature selection are optimised. The hybrid model was compared with standalone SVM and XGBoost models based on accuracy, precision, recall and F1 score. In preliminary findings, the hybrid method classifies patients with liver cirrhosis more accurately and yields fewer false positives than individual algorithms. This suggests that clinical diagnostic tools could be improved using machine learning approaches. It means that hybrid models may help to improve medical diagnostic and decision-making for liver cirrhosis care.

articleTitle: A Supervised Learning Model for Wild Image Quality Enhancement Scheme Using Elevated Convolution and Contrast Enrichment Strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The rapid advancement of imaging technology and the proliferation of digital content have emphasised the importance of effective techniques for enhancing image quality, particularly in uncontrolled or challenging environments. This paper proposes a novel approach to improving the quality of “wild images”-images that are captured under unpredictable and diverse conditions-through the application of deep learning techniques. In order to evaluate the efficacy of the proposed scheme, we propose the Elevated Convolution and Contrast Enrichment Strategy (ECCES), a novel approach that is cross-validated with the conventional model, the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). The architecture that has been proposed is specifically designed to address common quality issues, such as distortion, noise, and low resolution. In order to enhance the clarity, detail, and overall visual allure of images, our methodology implements a combination of perceptual loss functions, sophisticated network layers, and data augmentation techniques. We use a wide-ranging set of untamed images to test our model and see the quality boosts that outperform more significant comparisons to traditional enhancement techniques. The results presented here would show superior performance in subjective visual assessments while robust performance over a wide range of real-world scenarios. It would thus present an all-rounded analysis of the effectiveness of the model in relation to uses in high-quality image processing applications for complex inputs in various disciplines.

articleTitle: ENCL: An Extensive Learning Based Methodology to Predict Liver Disease by Using Enhanced Neural Classification Logic
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Effective treatment and handling require precise forecasting and early diagnosis of liver diseases. This paper introduces the Enhanced Neural Classification Logic (ENCL), a novel deep learning framework that is intended to enhance the precision of liver disease predictions. The proposed model is cross-validated with the conventional learning approach, the Random Forest Classifier (RFC), to assess its efficiency. The proposed model ENCL utilizes advanced neural network architecture with optimizations a sequence, to fine-tune classification performance. Our approach includes a multi-layered neural network coupled with improved feature extraction, dynamic attention systems, and refined loss calculus for improving model sensitivity and specificity. We work on a substantially large dataset of the records pertinent to diseases of the liver, which contains both structured clinical data and unstructured imaging data for the assessment of ENCL. Results have indicated that ENCL is significantly better than traditional as well as state-of-the-art approaches regarding predictive reliability as well as classification accuracy. This paper is aimed at describing how the enhanced architecture of proposed Enhanced Neural Classification Logic can avail in order to address such complex issues of prediction within the medical domain towards effective care for the patients.

articleTitle: Smart Columbarium Navigation: Enhancing Grave Mapping with Geographical Information System (GIS) and Fuzzy Logic Algorithm for the Garden of the Divine Word Columbary
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This study explores the development and implementation of a Smart Columbarium Navigation system for The Garden of the Divine Word Columbary, integrating Geographical Information System (GIS) technology with Fuzzy Logic algorithms. The lack of a dedicated geolocation application creates substantial difficulties in navigating infrastructure. Currently, users depend on conventional wayfinding methods, which are often inefficient and time-consuming. The research addresses the growing challenges faced by visitors in navigating complex modern columbariums and locating specific niches. The system incorporates a user-friendly interface for appointment scheduling and management, enhancing the experience for both visitors and staff. Advanced data collection methods were employed to improve the precision and comprehensiveness of landscape assessment, ensuring accurate recording and analysis of spatial and environmental factors. GIS technology was leveraged to create detailed, accurate maps of the columbarium, integrating spatial data with niche information for improved navigation and operational efficiency. The system was evaluated using ISO 25010 criteria, focusing on functional suitability, performance efficiency, usability, reliability, and security. Feedback from columbarium staff and general public visitors (n=80) indicated generally positive results across these dimensions, with mean scores ranging from 3.85 to 4.46 on a 5-point Likert scale. While the system successfully met its primary objectives, the neutral responses in some areas suggest opportunities for further optimization. This study demonstrates the potential of integrating GIS and Fuzzy Logic in funerary contexts, paving the way for innovations in memorial space management and enhancing the overall visitor experience in columbariums.

articleTitle: AI Bot to Increase the Accuracy and Efficiency of Hiring Process of Business Organizations
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Recruitment in most organizations is normally a rather inefficient process where it takes quite a long time to match the right candidate to a given job. In this research, AI-based hiring system is recommended to improve the efficiency and accuracy of the hiring process with the help of NLP and machine learning algorithms. Employment enabling processes such as CV filtering, skill evaluation and personality profiling as well as job matching are achieved by the system. An NLP-based tool is used for short listing of CVs, assessment quizzes are used to evaluate different skills and qualifications of the candidates and chatbot enables communication between candidates and HRs, while an AI bot is used to complete different document verifications' processes. Recruitment operation is made easier and efficient, and matching of candidates to the available jobs is done better since it is less time-consuming and energy-demanding, giving a solution that may be implemented on a large scale. Further improvements are to be made in the fine tuning of algorithms, enlargement of comprehensiveness of systems and the implementation of actual sample cases before the introduction into the marketplace.

articleTitle: Cutting-Edge Solutions Exploring the Experimental Possibilities of Route Optimization with Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: One of the major developments in the field of wireless communication over the last several decades has been the rise of wireless sensor networks (WSN), which are networks of inexpensive, power-limited devices. Although they are essential for data transmission, sensor nodes have a finite quantity of power. Energy is lost while the transfer is happening. The primary difficulties of a WSN are, then, energy consumption and the longevity of the network. The ideal route between source and destination nodes, in which it will maximize energy saving in a network, has been the subject of much research in recent years as well as making a routing algorithm that accounts for the two main concerns reducing energy usage and increasing network lifetime is the real problem. There are a number of improvement methods that may be used to find a routing path from one node to another. Both the dynamically efficient routing method and power management techniques have attracted a lot of interest from researchers for their ability to lower the energy consumption of sensor nodes on an individual basis. In this research, a new approach is suggested called Novel Network Optimization Protocol (NNOP). Its purpose is to find and set up the shortest path between two sensor nodes, with the distance being the metric of evaluation. Compared to NNOP performance under the identical conditions as well as the conventional routing model called Dynamic Source Routing (DSR), the findings obtained from Matlab simulation demonstrated superior performance in energy conservation. This enhanced routing method has potential for usage in WSN-based industrial applications.

articleTitle: Assessing Wildlife Tourism's Role in Conservation Awareness Using Artificial Intelligence and Data Science for Sustainable Tourism Development
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The purpose of this exploration paper is to improve the development of sustainable tourism by examining the intersection of wildlife tourism and conservation consciousness through the perspective of artificial intelligence (AI) and data wisdom. Through the use of data analysis and tools driven by artificial intelligence, the project analyzes how wildlife tourism practices might be optimized to strengthen conservation efforts. Through the utilization of artificial intelligence methodology for caller shadowing, wildlife monitoring, and predictive analytics, the investigation investigates how these technologies can serve to mitigate adverse effects on wildlife while simultaneously fostering beneficial conservation concerns. Additionally, it investigates how tailored gestures and interactive instructional aids, powered by artificial intelligence, can help excursionists become more conscious. In addition to this, the paper discusses the difficulties that are related to ethical considerations, the sequestration of data, and the incorporation of unique information. This paper gives insight into how artificial intelligence (AI) and data wisdom can be effectively applied to support sustainable wildlife tourism and advance conservation pretensions. This insight is provided through case studies and tactics that are driven by data (data-driven). The purpose of the findings is to use them to inform policy and functional practices to further promote tourism that is both responsible and meaningful.

Author Keywords: lmpact of tourism on sustainable development

articleTitle: Applying Machine Learning to Predict Patient Readmission Rates in Healthcare
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The readmission rate in hospitals is the measure of efficiency of the treatment provided by them. The major challenge towards the improvement of health outcomes and proper resource utilization is patient readmission prediction. It is a traditional failure often from methods that do not give accurate identification of at-risk patients thus leading to ineffective therapy. Therefore, a machine learning technique was designed that predicts readmission by various attributes and the context of the hospital stay. This XGBoost implementation presented excellent performance in detecting high-risk people, with an accuracy level of 85% and a recall rate of 83%. These are some indicators that may demonstrate the potential of the proposed method to optimize health care resources, patient outcomes, and reduce readmissions. This paper establishes the groundwork for embedding advanced predictive analytics within the hospital management system.

articleTitle: Ensemble Based Deep Learning Model for Prediction of Oral Squamous Cell Carcinom
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The oral squamous cell carcinoma (OSCC) is an extremely difficult and fatal form of cancer. Deep learning algorithms can discover tiny buccal tissue patterns in massive datasets, making them promising mouth cancer predictors. This research shows a deep learning network that uses groups to help predict mouth cancer. The suggested method uses several deep learning algorithms, including RNN, Bi-LSTM, and Bi-GRU, to identify features. Merging RNN and bi-GRU features concatenates bi-LSTM output. The ensemble model uses a vote classifier that has four standard classifiers built into it. The logistic regression (LR), random forest (RF), k-means clustering, and multi-SVNN classifiers are all part of this baseline. Amazingly, the suggested ensemble-based classification model achieves 98.34% accuracy on the first dataset and 98.76% accuracy on the second, thanks to its effective use of deep features. This shows how well it can predict outcomes and how promising it is for accurate oral cancer prediction. The combination of deep learning algorithms and classical classifiers improves oral cancer prediction models, according to this study.

articleTitle: Predicting Student Dropout Using Educational Data with Temporal Convolutional Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Student dropout is a significant concern for educational institutions globally, leading to adverse social and economic impacts. Accurately predicting dropout rates allows for timely interventions, improving student retention and success rates. TCNs are chosen for their ability to handle sequential data and capture long-range dependencies, making them well-suited for the time-series nature of educational data. The model processes information from various sources such as academic performance records, attendance logs, and demographic details, ensuring a comprehensive analysis. The implementation involves a meticulous approach to data preprocessing, including cleaning, normalization, and feature engineering to create relevant features such as average grades and attendance rates. The TCN model is then designed with optimal hyperparameters, incorporating causal and dilated convolutions to respect the temporal order of data and capture long-term dependencies. Training the model on historical data, followed by rigorous validation using metrics like accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score, ensures its robustness and generalizability. The final model is integrated into existing student management systems to provide real-time predictions and alerts, enabling proactive identification of at-risk students. Future work aims to enhance the model's accuracy and applicability by incorporating additional data sources, such as behavioural data and socio-economic factors, and developing hybrid models that combine TCNs with LSTMs and GRUs. Efforts will also focus on improving the model's interpretability for educators and administrators, implementing real-time monitoring and adaptive learning techniques to keep the model updated with new data, and designing and testing intervention strategies based on the model's predictions to assess their effectiveness in improving student retention rates. The project aims to create a powerful tool for predicting student dropout rates, providing educational institutions with actionable insights to support student success and reduce dropout rates through timely and targeted interventions.

articleTitle: Convolutional Neural Network-Based Multi-Fruit Classification and Quality Grading with a Gradio Interface
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Agricultural products are experiencing significant losses, especially after the harvesting phase, which is the period from fruit storage to the product reaching the consumer's hands. A lack of human resources, time consumption, product handling, and human errors during the post-harvest stage of the fruit grading and sorting process result in huge losses. Deep learning (DL) offers an automated process for classifying and identifying fruits. Developing an architecture for a VGG16 convolutional neural network (CNN) within the Gradio user interface, utilizing five distinct fruit types as the model's dataset, such as apple, banana, guava, orange, apple, and pomegranate. For five different sets of fresh and defect fruits, the proposed model got 91.1% and 89.1% of test accuracy for multi-fruit clas- sification and fruit status prediction, respectively. This machine- based automated model has the potential to reduce losses and enhance fruit grading and sorting efficiency, thereby significantly impacting sustainable and productive agricultural industries through increased productivity.

articleTitle: Predictive Analytics for Human Resource Management: Enhancing Talent Acquisition and Retention Using Data analytics
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: HRM depends on the output of predictive analytics by which the input achieves accurate data on employee hiring and retention. For enhancing the decision-making in the HR domain, this research proposes a novel multi-modal logistic regression, XGBoost, and deep learning-based designated hybrid prediction model. Due to the integration of several more common and uncommon HR datasets and richer feature engineering techniques, the mentioned model eliminates the limitations of previous studies. These enhance the chances of applicant selection and consequently the chances of the applicants' retention. The proposed hybrid model achieved 91.4% accuracy for applicant selection and 89.7% for employee retention; the accuracy of the models developed in the years 2021, 2022 & 2023, was 82.3%, 84.9%, and 87.4% respectively. Its implementation using IBM Watson and Kafka will afford HR managers practical real-time information from the model. Lastly, the benefits of applying the model to enhance the HR procedures are highlighted and recommendations for further work to increase the model's applicability in other areas are made.

articleTitle: Adaptive Machine Learning-Driven Cybersecurity: Enhancing Real-Time Threat Detection and Response
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Traditional methods of sensitive data protection are static and reactive, which makes them often inadequate in the dynamic and always-shifting cyber threat environment of today. The paper proposes a dynamic and adaptable approach to combine machine learning (ML) at the intersection of cybersecurity and data engineering to address the limitations of conventional solutions. Using ML algorithms to continuously learn from data patterns, the proposed system ensures proactive security mechanisms and allows real-time adaptation to new threats. The proposed system uses supervised and unsupervised learning techniques to effectively distinguish between regular and suspicious activities, hence enhancing cyber resilience. Furthermore, the self-sufficient response to threats and mitigation measures of the proposed system streamlines incident response procedures, which results in faster reaction times and reduced false positive rates. Comparative performance metric results, which indicate reaction times of 5 seconds for low-severity threats, 10 seconds for medium-severity threats, and 15 seconds for high-severity threats, highlight the improved efficacy of the proposed system. At a false positive rate of 5% and a detection accuracy of 95%, the proposed system surpasses existing systems and shows its potential to significantly increase cybersecurity defences in the dynamic threat landscape of today.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Blockchain Consensus for Efficient Node Selection in Cluster-Based Vehicular Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In the context of blockchain technology, it Is crucial to address the issue of low stability among consensus nodes alongside performance and security. To mitigate the adverse effects of unstable nodes, we introduce a novel approach that leverages an intelligent algorithm to optimize the selection of Mobile Consensus Nodes (MCNs) based on various factors, including a metric we term Node Stability (SoN). Our findings indicate that the proposed protocol significantly decreases the average number of messages transmitted by 33.9%, while enhancing both the status and solidity of the average consensus node by 6.8% and 17.5%, respectively.

articleTitle: Advancing Air Quality Monitoring: A Comprehensive Approach to Combat Indoor Pollution and Cannabis Impact Using IoT and AWS
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This paper explores the essential aspects of user interfaces for teleoperating mining vehicles and systems. Current interfaces have evolved from basic line-of-sight remote control systems, incorporating video displays to enhance functionality. Despite their simplicity, these interfaces have proven to be effective and profitable for teleoperation. Ongoing research in Exploration and Mining emphasizes the integration of non-visual feedback for operators and the efficient presentation of such information. The primary goal of the user interface is to meet key client requirements for mining systems, focusing on robustness, reliability, and user-friendliness for on-site operational and sup- port personnel. The implementation involves a rover controlled via a mobile device, utilizing Arduino for robot control and an ESP32 cam for video capturing and live streaming. This project addresses the crucial aspects of remote mining operations, ensuring a reliable and user-friendly interface to enhance overall system performance.

articleTitle: LeNet – IoT Security Aware Intrusion Detection Framework Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The rising complexity of cyberthreats created the demand for compelling cybersecurity solutions that along with expanding Internet of Things (IoT) devices has made them indispensable. In the work our proposal is a Deep Learning-Assisted Intrusion Detection System (IDS), based on the LeNet architecture, that can be used for the identification and prevention of potential intrusions in Internet of Things environments. To increase the detection accuracy, we developed our method based on a properly structured preprocessing step comprising normalisation and data augmentation using image-based and QR-based datasets. We take a look at the architecture of LeNet including the pooling and convolutional layers that help to identify important features of the input dataset. The final parts of the model are fully linked layers and a Softmax classifier that predicts the type of anomaly. Performance metrics measure the efficacy of the IDS including precision, recall, accuracy, and F1 score that reveal our method surpass the classical methods with a high margin. We shall describe in this paper how one can train the LeNet model using IoT-specific attack data so that it could be used to detect intrusion in surrounding network space and inject the walled-off attack, thereby facilitating threat prevention. Since the model is GPU accelerated, it converged close to what was able to protect the IoT network effectively from the evolving cyber-attacks and was quite close to its high accuracy and real time efficient performance in terms of time.

articleTitle: Harnessing Deep Learning for Tomato Disease Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Crop health is one of the most important aspects when it comes to the agriculture industry because tomato crops are very susceptible to several kinds of diseases. Disease diagnosis needs to be thus done in time and with precision for optimal crop output and quality. It implies adopting a hybrid model combining both VGG-19 and ResNet-50 architectures in deep learning framework-based classification of tomato plant diseases. While conventional disease diagnostic methodologies are slow and require an expert, our approach employs residual learning capabilities of ResNet-50 and convolutional layers of VGG-19 in enhancing its robustness as well as accuracy of diagnosis. The first step involves preprocessing, which involves scaling and transformation of grayscale images. The next step involves feature extraction from the image using statistical measurements and texture analysis techniques such as Gray Level Co-Occurrence Matrix (GLCM). In addition, the suggested method uses fine-tuning and transfer learning, utilizing a dataset comprising images that are labeled as healthy and infected tomato leaves. The proposed work has an extended phase of performance evaluation which includes the use of a confusion matrix in order to present the classification outcomes and then applying evaluation metrics such as F1-score, accuracy error rate, precision, and recall. The hybrid model seeks to achieve an estimated accuracy of high precision in classifying photos of tomato leaves into different disease categories. The results demonstrate that deep learning models, particularly the hybrid VGG-19 and ResNet-50 model, can effectively identify subtle disease symptoms, providing a scalable and reliable tool for real-time disease detection in the agricultural sector.

articleTitle: A Superficial BigData Communication Model to Improve Energy Efficiency Over Wireless Networking Platform Using Deep Learning Strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Due to their limited energy capacity, wireless networks will have a difficult time handling the tremendous volume of data that comes with a big number of users. This data is also rapidly changing and diverse. Superficial BigData Communication (SDBC), a novel paradigm for data integrity and energy efficiency, is introduced in this paper. By using a deliberate deployment strategy that permits quick reaction times and significantly increases network uptime, SDBC offers a novel method of obtaining important raw data. Learning enabled Energy Optimization Protocol (LEOP), a novel proposed technique, reduces the efficiency of data aggregation while simultaneously increasing data gathering accuracy as compared to the current Energy aware Route Optimization (ERO) method. The protocol employs sophisticated algorithms to analyze large-scale energy consumption data, identify patterns, and predict future energy needs. By continuously learning from operational data and environmental factors, LEOP adapts its optimization strategies in real time, ensuring robust performance under varying conditions. The primary goal of LEOP is to send as much data as necessary across wireless networks while minimizing energy consumption. The proposed method subsumes optimal energy control by using intelligent routing algorithms along with new data compression techniques. Our experimental results indicate that SDBC consumes less energy compared with the state-of-the-art scheduling approaches while ensuring high data quality. A new class of wireless networks that are sustainable and suitable for the requirements placed upon service providers by BigData applications emerged. Experimental results demonstrate that LEOP significantly reduces energy consumption and operational costs compared to traditional optimization methods. This research underscores LEOP's potential to revolutionize energy management practices, offering a scalable and adaptable solution for addressing the complex challenges of modern energy systems.

articleTitle: TherapEase: Enhancing Remote Physical Therapy Using Pose Estimation, Emotion Recognition, and K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic has accelerated the adoption of telerehabilitation, revealing both opportunities and challenges in remote physical therapy. This study introduces TherapEase, a web-based application designed to enhance the quality of virtual rehabilitation care by addressing issues such as exercise performance accuracy and communication clarity. TherapEase aims to complement, rather than replace, on-site physical therapy. A notable feature of the system is its implementation of pain assessment during therapy sessions through emotion recognition, utilizing the You Only Look Once (YOLO) algorithm to evaluate patients' facial expressions. Developed using an agile methodology, the application underwent evaluation based on the ISO 25010:2011 software quality model, focusing on Functional Suitability, Performance Efficiency, Interaction Capability, and Reliability. Results indicate high satisfaction levels across all evaluated aspects, with mean scores ranging from 3.58 to 3.67 out of 4. These findings suggest that TherapEase effectively integrates various components to provide a coherent and efficient telerehabilitation solution, potentially improving the delivery of remote physical therapy services while supporting traditional in-person care. Further research is needed to improve the accuracy of the pain assessment feature.

articleTitle: Utilizing Big Data for Personalized Nutrition Interventions and Health Outcomes
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The use of big data in the context of proven nutrition interventions and their effects on health issues is examined in this exploratory work. We want to tailor dietary recommendations to individual needs by leveraging big databases, which include health records, hereditary information, and healthy behaviors. Big data analytics integration makes it possible to find distinctive health connections and beneficial patterns, which in turn makes it possible to express personalized dietary recommendations that can improve health problems. Our research shows how big data may change conventional nutritional knowledge and lead to a more individualized strategy that takes specific nature and life elements into account. The results show notable improvements in the treatment of habitual conditions, the enhancement of salutary recommendations, and the promotion of general well-being. To enhance proven nutrition, this study highlights the value of interdisciplinary collaboration by fusing data wisdom, nutrition, and healthcare moxie. Refining data integration techniques and investigating the long-term benefits of supported nutrition programs on various populations are examples of potential exploration directions.

articleTitle: Enhancing Preschool Literacy: A Machine Learning Approach to Sinhala Alphabet Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This paper proposes a new tool to help preschool children learn the Sinhala alphabet, as it employs the K-Nearest Neighbors algorithm for handwritten Sinhala character recognition and prediction. The interactive platform also addresses the challenges that arise from conventional classroom learning systems, such as the lack of quick feedback, one-off learning, and inflexibility for individual learners. A crucial aspect of the Sinhala script is that it contains fifty-six characters, making character recognition particularly tedious for preschool children. The K-Nearest Neighbors algorithm appears to fill that gap impressively, as it can determine the handwriting of individuals and convert it into usable pieces for students. Usability testing indicated that preschoolers achieved a defined accuracy threshold of 90%, while the model's accuracy was 87%. These indicators provide internal evidence of the tool's actual utility in classroom interactions. The present study highlights the cultural relevance of HCI applications for children in early years education and advances the fields of machine learning systems and the preservation of the Sinhala language. The outcomes of this research demonstrate the technical correctness of the solution and its potential usefulness in applying this method to other languages and educational systems.

articleTitle: A Novel Blockchain Enabled Methodology to Perform Secure Banking Transactions Using Cybersecurity Principles
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel blockchain-enabled methodology to enhance the security and efficiency of banking transactions by integrating advanced cybersecurity principles. The system utilizes a decentralized, immutable ledger to ensure the integrity of transaction data, alongside multi-factor authentication (MFA) and secure hashing algorithms for improved data protection. Through rigorous testing, the blockchain system demonstrated a significant improvement in transaction processing time, reducing the average transaction time by 70%, from 24.9 seconds to 7.5 seconds for 100 transactions. The accuracy of transaction validation improved from 85% in pre-blockchain systems to 98% in the blockchain system. Additionally, the system reduced transaction failure rates from 15% to 2%, highlighting the increased reliability of blockchain for secure banking. Resource utilization was optimized, with CPU usage dropping by 20% on average. A user satisfaction survey also indicated a 35% increase in satisfaction due to the improved speed and security. The results suggest that blockchain technology, when combined with cybersecurity protocols, provides a scalable and highly accurate solution for secure banking transactions.

articleTitle: Experimental Analysis of Artificial Intelligence Powered Adaptive Learning Methodology Using Enhanced Deep Learning Principle
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The rapid advancement of deep learning technologies and Artificial Intelligence (AI) has facilitated the development of sophisticated adaptive learning methodologies. The experimental analysis presented in this manuscript is of a novel adaptive learning methodology propelled by AI, known as the Learning Assisted Power Adaptive Strategy (LPAS). This approach optimizes the learning process in dynamic environments by combining adaptive learning techniques with sophisticated deep learning architectures. The accuracy levels of the proposed scheme are tested by cross-validating it with the traditional learning scheme called Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) so that complex and time-varying data patterns can be handled effectively. The Learning Assisted Power Adaptive Strategy is anticipated to enhance its fitness to make accurate predictions and encourage individual learning with adaptability over new and changing circumstances. The LPAS performance is assessed against a variety of benchmarks, such as precision, recall, specificity and sensitivity, through a succession of controlled experiments. The model's adaptive capabilities also enabled a more responsive response to data fluctuations, thereby improving its overall robustness. This research provides valuable insights for future advancements in the field and contributes to the continual growth of AI-driven educational resources and adaptive platforms.

articleTitle: IoT Applications in Smart Building Energy Management
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The technologies that are a part of the Internet of Things enable smart buildings to use energy more efficiently. The main focus of the research is on the use of internet-connected sensors and devices. Real-time monitoring, analysis, and management of energy consumption are the goals of this. Data is gathered from various sources, such as appliances, lighting, HVAC (heating, ventilation, and air conditioning), and other systems, employing networked systems. This offers the chance for a more effective distribution of energy. The goal of the project is to foresee energy patterns and automatically adjust settings by focussing on the integration of cloud computing, big data analytics, and machine learning algorithms. Furthermore, it highlights how the Internet of Things can help cut down on energy waste and improve sustainability by giving consumers advice and information on how to use less energy. Providing consumers with insights and recommendations helps achieve this. By promoting the adoption of more ecologically friendly energy practices, the implementation of these technologies not only reduces operating costs but also decreases the environmental impact that buildings have. The study's conclusions indicate that the field of smart buildings has advanced significantly, which may help to promote sustainability and higher energy efficiency.

articleTitle: Streamline Pro Next-Gen Recruitment Solution
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: An innovative full-stack project called “StreamlinePro Next-Gen Recruitment Solution” aimsto transform the hiring process. With its modern technologies, this fully inclusive platform enhances the hiring process to satisfy the demands of administrators, HR professionals, and job seekers. The Job Board Application is developed around a powerful system for posting jobs and accepting applications. Experts in human resources can readily post job openings, andneed to offer corporate papers to validate their skills. This ensures that reliable sources are used to publish job openings. Conversely, candidates can use the website to look for jobs that fit their qualifications and apply immediately. Posting resumes is required, and an applicant tracking system (ATS) reviews them after are uploaded. After reviewing the entries, the ATS rates the resumes according to theirquality and applicability. One of the primary aspects of the StreamlinePro Next-Gen Recruitment Solution is its exclusive referral mechanism. Employees in a company may indicate that are willing to suggest others. Job searchers can contact these references, and if accepted, both parties can communicate through an integrated chat system. This recommendation system encourages networking and enhances job-seeking opportunities by leveraging existing staff networks. The application also offers the capability of real-time job status tracking. Applicants can monitor the progress of their applications and receive alerts regarding their receipt, review, and acceptance by employers. This tool helps clarity and informs job seekers during the hiring process.

articleTitle: SMARTSURI: A Mobile-Based Item Recycling Classifier Application Utilizing Convolutional Neural Network with Event Notification and Recommendation System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The significant ecological issues raised by inappropriate waste management highlight the need for technical solutions to support effective recycling practices. This project aims to create SMARTSURI, a mobile-based item recycling classifier application which utilizes Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) technology to accurately classify recyclable, biodegradable, and residual materials. The system will increase user awareness by sending real-time updates about local recycling events and advising sustainable actions depending on the scanned item through OpenAI. SMARTSURI addresses three significant gaps: the absence of item classification capabilities in existing recycling programs, the lack of event notifications for local recycling activities, and the user's poor understanding of recyclable materials. SMARTSURI uses CNN s to improve recycling precision and encourage active participation in environmental sustainability. Initial evaluations of the prototype have shown excellent levels of user involvement and accuracy in identifying recyclable objects, which contributes to environmental awareness and efficiency in operation.

articleTitle: Automated Cloth Quality Grading for E-Commerce Platform Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In textile industry automation is very necessary for the better productivity and quality control of cloth inspection, especially in large manufacturing operations. The automated cloth quality detection and grading model that we propose in this research has low, medium, and high levels for cloth quality. It uses Python's ML libraries, and the classifiers used are random forest and logistic regression classifiers, along with the Adam optimizer for faster training. The data is labelled fabric image, pre-calibrated with label size and quality. Accuracy, precision, recall and F1 score are all measures by which we assess how good the model is at classification. The results have good accuracy and recall, which shows that the model does well at separating out different quality levels of fabric. The F1 score also confirms that the model is balanced in precision and recall, making it a good choice for field-based quality control applications. The automated system is sure to save you a lot of money and deliver better consistency and scalability, making it a great alternative to the manual inspections. In future updates, deep learning might be implemented to further optimize and upscale accuracy and scalability for larger textile datasets. Features such as high texture accuracy, medium colour detail, and thread densities of 52–299 are also used to distinguish between different quality states. There are tally and evaluate defects, from 0 to 9. Other key attributes are stretchability (low, medium, high), fabric thickness (thin to thick) and qualitative softness index (soft to rough). Moisture absorbency, pilling resistance and tear strength scores help narrow the classification; pilling resistance scores range from 9 to 10 and tear strength is between 5.0 and 49.4. This is evaluated by accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score of the model. They show excellent classification with 92%accuracy, 90% precision, 88% recall, and 89% F1 score — the model is a well-balanced model for applications in the real world of quality control. The system is able to save money, ensure consistency, and expand as compared to manual checks. Future projects include deep learning to improve accuracy and scalability across textile datasets.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Privacy-Preserving Framework for Geospatial Data: Enhancing Accuracy and Utility in Urban Planning and Catastrophe Management
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The growing need for geospatial data analysis highlight's location privacy issues. Although existing technologies such as differential privacy and location obfuscation can be relatively large, inaccurate, and difficult to handle in many applications like urban planning and disaster management, its privacy protection benefits make up for the defect. but in the research, a new privacy-preserving framework based on adaptive differential privacy model, k-anonymity and spatial cloaking is introduced. Based on geographic sensitivity, the system dynamically distributes privacy resources, thus ensuring accuracy in critical regions by choosing quality points from the data. It works to strike a balance between user privacy and system functionality by using genetic algorithm optimization and geographic analysis approaches like DBSCAN. As can be seen from the above comparisons with other systems, the experimental results show that it achieves higher levels of privacy protection than traditional methods with a lower differential privacy parameter (ε = 0.5) and larger k-anonymity k-values (k = 10). Also, the cluster quality improved phenomenally (silhouette coefficient = 0.75) and mean absolute error dropped significantly, both of which help with data utility improvement. The architecture offers a scalable, effective solution that ensures both high privacy protection and accurate representation of essential data.

articleTitle: Fraud Detection Using Machine Learning in Blockchain Stock Marketing Transactions
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: One of the main concerns relevant to blockchain-based stock market transactions is fraud detection, as it is vital to protect market integrity and investors‘ trust. The existing systems have many limitations, as these are usually focused on rule-based approaches and, as a result, false positives and false negatives are common. The study in question shows that a novel machine learning approach helps to address the problem. The proposed system utilizes various supervised, unsupervised, and ensemble learning techniques to ‘learn’ to evaluate the transactional data inside the blockchain networks. The methodology helps to ensure that detection fraud will be highly efficient, and it involves data preprocessing, algorithms selection for training, model tuning, and implementing real-time monitoring. The results indicate that the novel system outperforms many existing ones, as its accuracy is 92%, precision is 91%, recall is 94<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>, and F1-score is 0.92. Moreover, false positives and false negatives account for 5% and 6%, which is significantly better compared to existing solutions. As a result, fraud detection in the studied context is strongly impacted by the proposed solution.

articleTitle: Development of a Vulnerability Detection System Utilizing Pattern Matching Technology and Security
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The challenge of testing modern cybersecurity efficiency in a web application lies around developed systems of vulnerability detection. Precisely, the technologies discussed in combination pave the way toward a more efficient detection of security flaws in web applications. Usage-wise, it uses a templating framework for the methodological approach in sending HTTP requests and interpreting the feedback accorded for the particular rules that may relate to revealing vulnerabilities. It reduces false positives with the help of pattern clustering that rescan the information accessed from previously scanned. It gives live, real-time appraisals of web applications and is self-navigating through web pages. Data is to be preserved in its integrity and confidentiality, and such parts are always under risk. Many organizations rely on Vulnerability Assessments (VA) for such issues. VA is the approach which organizations rely on to assess security vulnerabilities in order to counter the security threats. This research has automatically and managed vulnerabilities using tailored YAML templates. Consequently, the designed automated scanner with tailored YAML templates was supposed to scan the working infrastructure application for Vulnerability Assessment. In this approach within the YAML templates of defined vulnerabilities, it enhances security testing. This research has a contribution to the field of security automation because this is the first work on a focus on tailored endpoints, avoiding pre-attacks to attack surfaces, and maintaining an active process of surveillance of vulnerabilities without risking false positives before any possible exploitation within both internal and external infrastructure applications.

articleTitle: Unraveling the Complexity: Empowering Decision-Making Through a Multi-Agent Decision Support System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Deciphering the intricate landscape of financial markets requires astute decision-making based on a myriad of factors. In this groundbreaking research, I introduce a pioneering solution: a cutting-edge decision support system tailored to empower users in their stock selection endeavors. Through the fusion of fuzzy inference systems, genetic programming, and a zero-sum multi-agent architecture, I revolutionize the way financial decisions are made. Within this innovative framework, each agent harnesses the power of fuzzy inference systems to make informed determinations regarding trading direction and optimal trading force. By unraveling the evolved membership functions embedded within the system, market participants gain profound insights into the dynamic nature of finance. Leveraging the power of regression analysis on stock time series data, our multi-agent system accurately predicts the future movements and strengths of various financial markets. Rigorous testing of our methodology showcases its prowess, as it outperforms a benchmark based on the illustrious Dow Jones Index. Armed with this comprehensive tool, investors are equipped to navigate the ever-shifting tides of the financial realm with confidence. Our research not only pioneers a new era in decision support systems but also unveils an indispensable resource that empowers individuals to make strategic, finance-savvy choices in their stock trading endeavors.

articleTitle: Student Interest Identification in Education Using Deep Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The rapid development of deep learning methods presents a potentially game-changing opportunity in the realm of education, particularly in the promotion of student involvement and the comprehension of the subject matter. To exemplify learning gestures and resolve educational challenges, this exploratory study investigates the operation of deep learning algorithms to determine the interests of students. Our deep learning model can provide direct predictions on the areas of interest for individual students by analyzing enormous volumes of educational data. These data include pupil relations, performance standards, and behavioral patterns of students. By aligning instructional tactics with the preferences of students, this strategy not only makes it easier for students to become accustomed to newly presented educational material, but it also encourages active learning. The research reveals that deep learninghelps capture the intricacies of student engagement. It also provides preceptors with valuable insights that may be used to cultivate a learning landscape that is more engaging and investigative. The results of our research highlight the possibility that deep learning will be used to change educational procedures to make them more adaptable and sensitive to the various needs of students. In this paper, the practice of using deep learning for interest identification in education is discussed, along with its methodology, perpetrators, and counteraccusations.

articleTitle: Advanced Diagnosis of Nephrolithiasis, Renal Tumors, and Cysts Using Machine Learning and Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Automated identification and categorization of renal pathologies, such as kidney cysts, nephrolithiasis and tumors, represents a significant step forward in the fields of medical imaging and diagnostic methods. An extensive dataset of 12,446 computed tomography (CT) images from various medical institutions in Dhaka, Bangladesh, including cyst (3,709), neoplasm (2,283), calculus (1,377), and normative (5,077) images is used in this investigation. The data was thoroughly assembled to retain data integrity and protect patient confidentiality by expunging all identifiable information. Data augmentation techniques were used on the dataset to mitigate class imbalance to 1,377 images per category in order to improve model's robustness and generalizability. We executed five distinct image classification algorithms: A hybrid CNN with Random Forest (RF), CNN, ResNet50, ResNet101, and VGG16 is used for the study. Each model underwent training utilizing an 80:20 splitting for training and testing. Normalization techniques are applied to promote effective convergence. We used ReLU activation for feature extraction and optimized the feature extraction with our CNN architecture, consisting of three convolutional layers followed by max pooling layers. The hybrid model combined CNN for high level feature extraction with a Random Forest classifier using the advantages that come with ensemble learning. Transfer learning was also used by using pre-trained ResNet and VGG models and fine tuning the terminal layers for specific classification goals. We find that the CNN and the hybrid CNN with RF achieved very high accuracy levels of 99.89%, while VGG16 achieved 99.0%. Accuracies of 93.93% and 93.56% were achieved with ResNet50 and ResNet101 respectively. The results of this research highlight the use of machine learning methodologies to improve diagnostic precision and the clinical workflow in medical imaging.

articleTitle: The Logical Development of Internet of Things Based Elderly and Disabled Peoples Monitoring System Using Smart Sensors
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: As populations’ age and the need for support for individuals with disabilities increases, there is a growing demand for innovative solutions that enhance independence and quality of life. The development of a smart IoT-based monitoring system to support the quality of life of the sick and old is presented in this study. The system continuously gathers data from various sources relevant for the healthcare system using endpoint devices like wearable sensors, environmental monitors, as well as smart home devices. In this paper, a new approach is introduced called IoT based Elder/Disabled Human Assistance (IoTEHA), in which it is compared with the current method, Elder People Monitoring System (EPMS), for human activity monitoring. The objective is to give special care people more protection and peace of mind. Diagnostics are derived using advanced data analytics in conjunction with machine learning algorithms, enabling anomaly detection as well as risk prediction. Caregivers receive alerts and can intervene in real time to prevent accidents from ever occurring. It also has privacy and security features as well to keep the user data secure. In order to demonstrate the system's efficacy in enhancing the lives of the elderly and crippled, it will be strictly evaluated if it meets that requirement. Advanced data analytics and the proposed learning algorithms called IoTEHA and EPMS are employed to interpret the collected data, enabling the system to offer predictive insights and alerts. This proactive approach supports caregivers and healthcare professionals in addressing issues before they escalate, improving overall care and safety.

articleTitle: An Advanced Logic to Optimize the Product Search Engines Based on Dynamic Facet Ordering Model to Support E-Commerce Industry
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This study presents an advanced logic for optimizing product search engines in the e-commerce industry using a dynamic facet ordering model. Traditional static facet-based systems often fail to adapt to real-time user behavior and product diversity, leading to inefficient search experiences. The dynamic facet ordering model introduced in this research utilizes metrics such as facet specificity and dispersion to rank product attributes in real-time, allowing for faster and more accurate product discovery. In a large-scale simulation involving consumer electronics, the dynamic facet system outperformed both expert-based static systems and entropy-based models, reducing the number of clicks by an average of 40%. User satisfaction increased by 25% on average, with satisfaction scores reaching 9.3 out of 10. The dynamic system also showed a facet selection efficiency of 82%, indicating its ability to prioritize the most relevant facets for users. With a system response time averaging 240 milliseconds, this dynamic model proved effective for enhancing both user experience and system performance. These results demonstrate the viability of dynamic facet ordering as a solution for improving e-commerce search engines.

articleTitle: INCL: An Effective Deep Learning Model to Identify Road Potholes by Using Image Based Neural Classification Logic
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This paper presents a deep learning-based approach for detecting road potholes using image-based neural classification logic. The methodology involves collecting road images from publicly available datasets, particularly from Kaggle, and augmenting the dataset to improve model performance. Preprocessing steps such as resizing, standardizing, and annotating the images were employed to ensure consistency. A pre-trained Faster R-CNN model was fine-tuned for pothole detection, using convolutional neural networks (CNNs) to extract features and classify the road images into pothole and non-pothole categories. The model was trained using transfer learning and tested under varying road and environmental conditions, including day, night, dry, and wet scenarios. The model achieved an accuracy of 96.5% in dry daylight conditions, with a slightly lower performance of 85.4% during wet nighttime conditions. Additionally, precision and recall were evaluated, with the model achieving a precision of 95.3% and a recall of 97.6% for daytime conditions. The system was implemented in a real-time environment, allowing for real-time pothole detection and reporting through a mobile or web application. Future work will aim to improve performance under challenging conditions and enhance real-time deployment efficiency.

articleTitle: Integrating Machine Learning in Finite Element Analysis for Structural Health Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The possibility of incorporating machine literacy techniques into finite element analysis (FEA) for structural health monitoring (SHM) activities. Monitoring the structural health of engineering structures, such as islands, structures, and aerospace elements, is an essential component in ensuring the safety, dependability, and longevity of these structures. When it comes to dealing with complicated and dynamic structural actions, traditional SHM methods that are based on drug-based models and detector data have limits. In the case of discrepancy, machine literacy algorithms provide the power to learn patterns and connections directly from data, which enables SHM systems to be more accurate and adaptable. The purpose of this research is to investigate the objectification of machine literacy models into FEA-based SHM fabrics. These models include supervised literacy, unsupervised literacy, and underlying literacy. The approach that has been developed has the objective of enhancing the prophetic powers of SHM systems by utilizing the complementary strengths of data-driven algorithms and drug-based modelling. The effectiveness and implicit benefits of incorporating machine literacy in finite element analysis (FEA) for structural health monitoring (SHM) are illustrated through case studies and performance evaluation. This sets the stage for the development of more advanced and intelligent structural monitoring systems.

articleTitle: A Superficial Learning Strategy to Identify Email Spams Based on Hybrid Data Filtration and Classification Methodology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Spam email detection is a critical task in improving email security, especially with the increasing volume of spam emails that threaten users' privacy and productivity. In this study, we propose a hybrid approach combining Gated Recurrent Units (GRU) and Support Vector Machine (SVM) to identify spam emails effectively. The GRU component captures temporal dependencies in the email text, while SVM classifies the extracted features into spam or non-spam categories. The model was evaluated using various performance metrics, including accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score, and compared with other models like standalone GRU, SVM, CNN, and Naive Bayes. The proposed hybrid GRU-SVM model achieved a superior accuracy of 96.8%, outperforming GRU (93.2%), SVM (91.5%), CNN (94.1%), and Naive Bayes (89.4%). Additionally, the model demonstrated a high true positive rate (98.2%) and a low false negative rate (1.8%) on a spam-heavy dataset, indicating its robustness in identifying spam emails. The results suggest that the hybrid model can significantly enhance spam email detection systems by improving classification accuracy and reducing false positives.

articleTitle: A Smart Vacuum Cleaning Bot - Clean Bot Xcelerate
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Article history: The CleanBotXcelerate introduces a cutting-edge cleaning method, enabling precise control through its integrated Arduino microcontroller. Its adaptable cleaning patterns ensure thorough cleaning in all areas. The intelligent cleaning system adjusts suction and energy usage based on dirt levels, maximizing efficiency. With its wireless connectivity, users can conveniently control it via a mobile app or web interface. Additional features include enhanced suction power utilizing the venturi and Bernoulli effects. With its innovative design and seamless integration of microcontrollers, the CleanBotXcelerate performs exceptionally well in various environments, demonstrating its commitment to innovation and effectiveness. It achieves an impressive efficiency rating of approximately 37.6%. Additionally, the versatility extends to its ability to handle different floor types and surfaces with ease, ensuring a consistent cleaning experience throughout the home.

articleTitle: A Smart Home Design with Intelligent Patient Monitoring Features by Using Internet of Things (IoT) Enabled Communication Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The integration of Internet of Things (IoT) technology into smart home systems has revolutionized patient monitoring by providing real-time health insights and automated environmental adjustments. This study focuses on designing and evaluating a smart home system with intelligent patient monitoring features, aimed at enhancing patient safety, comfort, and healthcare delivery. The system employs a network of IoT-enabled devices, including wearable health sensors, environmental monitors, and smart cameras, to track vital signs such as ECG, SPO2, and body temperature, along with environmental parameters like air quality, humidity, and temperature. The system achieved a high accuracy rate, with vital sign sensors demonstrating over 98% reliability across various metrics. A communication framework using Wi-Fi and MQTT protocols ensures seamless data transfer and real-time responsiveness. Edge computing enables low-latency data processing, while cloud analytics provide predictive insights for early health issue detection. Key findings demonstrate the system's efficiency in emergency response, with an average detection-to-alert time of 1.4 seconds, and its ability to adapt the environment based on health conditions with over 95% precision. Automated features such as temperature control, fall detection, and personalized lighting enhance patient care and well-being. This work underscores the transformative potential of smart home technologies in healthcare, paving the way for future advancements in personalized health monitoring systems.

articleTitle: An Improved Neural Network Logic for Identifying Cerebral Palsy Disease to Assist Healthcare Field Using Artificial Intelligence Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: When brain development is disrupted or damaged, it can lead to a group of conditions collectively known as cerebral palsy (CP). The child's movement, stability, and posture are all impacted. When it comes to childhood motor disabilities, CP is by far the most prevalent culprit. The development of early treatments for cerebral palsy depends on its early discovery in children, when they are still in the early stages of the disorder. To aid in the diagnosis of brain pathologies, several medical imaging techniques are at one's disposal. The high resolution of magnetic resonance imaging makes it a popular choice for medical imaging. Better prediction accuracy, quicker progress in brain illness identification from MRI, and generalized acknowledgment of deep learning as a subset of AI are all outcomes of deep learning's growing profile in medical diagnostics. We present Improved Learning with Neural Classification Principle (ILNCP), a new deep learning strategy for intense CP identification, and we cross-validate it with the traditional Naive Bayes (NB) method to measure its efficacy. Finding a way to detect cerebral palsy that combines an ILNCP model with a data augmentation technique is the goal of this research. To that end, we propose a computerized automated diagnostic model that makes use of deep learning to aid in early identification of cerebral palsy in infants and to assist doctors in identifying the limitations caused by these disabilities.

articleTitle: Enhancing Financial Fraud Detection with LSTM and Attention Mechanisms: A Real-Time, Big Data Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Electronic checks and consequent fraud cases increase as internet activity increases. In real-time, it uses deep learning based on LSTM networks and the attention processes to detect fraud. Big and continuous datasets assist the model in identifying unusual behavior. Thus, the performance of the proposed approach was examined using 1,000,000 financial transactions. For precision, it yielded 96.7 percent, recall achievement was 97.4 percent, accuracy setting was 98.2 percent, and F1 score was 97.0 percent. Overall accuracy classification of 98.5% and false positive of 1.8%. The model was computationally efficient since it only took five hours to train and only 2 milliseconds to test every transaction. From the following findings, it is clear that the illustrated system deletes possibilities of financial fraud, and offers efficient, real-time, and extendable banking solutions. Future work will enhance the generalizability and the interpretability of the model.

articleTitle: Weapon Detection Using Genai and Yolo
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In order to improve real-time weapon identification, we recommend integrating the You Only Look Once (YOLO) series algorithms with Generative AI (GenAl). It uses the capabilities of GenAl to generate and improve image datasets, which are necessary for training comparable, precise models. Because of these progressive principles, YOLO can quickly and accurately identify weapons in these environments. Since the method combines the global generation features of GenAl with the regional detection efficacy in YOLO, it improves detection rates and reduces false discoveries. Also, enhancing the dependability of monitoring systems in the most susceptible areas (e.g., airports, schools, public areas), this collaboration facilitates the faster assessment and management of the threat level. The integration of both technologies would be a significant and forward-thinking step in public safety and security.

articleTitle: ANN-Based Classification of Skin Cancer Lesions in Dermatological Imaging
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Early detection of skin cancer, especially melanoma, is one of the major steps toward lowering the mortality rate. However, the existing method often employs subjective human judgment to diagnose; therefore, it contains its own set of limitations. This research presents a novel technique to auto-identify lesions in the images of dermatology skin cancer using the ANN system. The proposed solution will address the problem of data imbalance by resizing, normalizing, and augmenting images as part of its comprehensive preparation infrastructure. Optimization techniques, such as dropout and L2 regularization, are applied to prevent overfitting in a custom-designed ANN architecture with multiple concealed layers. The Adam optimizer is used for training and cross-validation purposes on the ISIC 2020 Skin Cancer Dataset. This classifier, following the ANN architecture, was able to surpass the traditional machine learning methods and CNN about accuracy of 94.5%, recall, precision, and F1-score by consuming fewer CPU resources, as shown in the experimental results. The authors hope that this technology can be a boost to the current methods of diagnosing skin cancer, which is quite crucial to clinical practice.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Approach for Automated GUI Testing Using Quasi-Oppositional Genetic Sparrow Search Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Testing of GUI is crucial for assessing software reliability, usability, and functionality; however, classical approaches are not sustainable in contemporary applications. It proposes the Quasi-Oppositional Genetic Sparrow Search Algorithm (OOGSSA) to auto-generate efficient GUI test cases. It combines genetic algorithms, sparrow search dynamics, and quasi-oppositional learning to optimize test suites, minimize redundant test cases, and improve the testing fault. The result obtained for the model OOGSSA is 95.8 % in test coverage, 85.3 % in redundancy, and 92.6 % in fault detection. Furthermore, test generation time was minimized to forty minutes and the overall testing time to seventy-five minutes, which is more efficient than conventional genetic or model-based testing. The outcomes presented above show that OOGSSA is highly efficient and effective in solving the issues of the current GUI testing and improving the overall quality and reliability of software. More enhancements to the algorithm will be done in future work as well as leveraging the algorithm to cover a wider GUI space including mobile and web.

articleTitle: Leveraging NVIDIA Clara for Real-Time Cardiac Image Segmentation and Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Medical imaging is crucial for heart diagnosis, but outdated algorithms and hardware result in delayed processing and low accuracy. Using NVIDIA Clara, a GPU-accelerated platform, the study proposes real-time cardiac picture segmentation and diagnosis. The proposed system uses advanced DL algorithms built for cardiac imaging to enhance processing speed and accuracy. Employing rigorous data preprocessing and deep learning model able to perform precise partitioning of cardiac structures and positioning defects that lead to quick heart arrhythmia diagnose in a timely manner. It also substantially reduces processing times compared to older systems while improving the contour quality and diagnosability. The system achieves the following DSC values: 0.93 for the left ventricle; 0.92 for right; 0.90 for left atrium; 0.89 for right ventricle and 0.91 for the major blood vessels. With diagnostic accuracy scores higher than the current system Sensitivity 94.2%, Specificity 92.8%, and Accuracy 93.5%. The method has potential to enhance cardiac care by facilitating earlier interventions leading better patient outcomes.

articleTitle: An AI-Driven Approach to Real-Time Sports Analytics and Performance Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: With outdated technology, the majority of sports analytics systems just can't meet the needs of real-time analyzing data. Worse still, these systems tend to have data latency due to manual input and rudimentary statistical models means that performance evaluations are inaccurate and delayed. The suggestion is an AI-based sports analytics system utilizing cutting-edge machine learning (ML) models and natural language processing (NLP) techniques. It combines deep learning architectures such as CNNs (Convolutional Neural Networks) and RNNs (Recurrent Neural Networks to examine a variety of datasets provides accurate insights and performance ratings in real time. The plan on the table demonstrates significant advantages over traditional approaches, with 10,000 records processed per hour an 85% forecast accuracy and 80% reduction in analysis time. The technology combines structured and unstructured data sources to enable coaches and analysts make better judgments. These provides tailor-made insights that give sports organizations an edge up and help ensure future-proof analytics capabilities.

articleTitle: Shetigram - Building a Digital Bridge Between Farmers and Consumers
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Transparency, cutting out middlemen, and fair trade have become essential focuses in agriculture. This paper proposes an innovative e-commerce platform that facilitates direct trans- actions between farmers and end-consumers using Ethereum blockchain smart contracts, leveraging the Elliptic Curve Dig- ital Signature Algorithm (ECDSA) for secure and transparent transactions. ECDSA enhances security by providing robust authentication, ensuring that all transactions are irrefutable and trustworthy. The platform has a hybrid recommendation system, which uses the Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT) algorithm for delivering personalized product recommendations that fit each customer's personalized settings. This enables the software to work on natural language processing and this technique captures subtle feelings and contexts, thereby enhancing recommendation accuracy and diversification. Besides ARIMA, XGBoost algorithm, one of the machine learning methods, is applied to predict agricultural commodity prices and the demand, in this way by considering the internal, external, and seasonal factors that can create credit for each commodity provides much more accurate predictions and decision-making insights. XGBoost is a non-linear algorithm that wins in the comparison of MAE, RMSE, and MAPE as it continued to improve by capturing more factors and patterns associated with changes in the models. The platform aims to solve the problem of farmers being disadvantaged due to the lack of access to smartphones and internet connectivity. It will be done by integration of USSD-based interface that enables wide participation with basic mobile devices.

Author Keywords: Extreme Gra- dient Boosting(XGBoost) Unstructured Supplementary Service Data(USSD) Interface

articleTitle: Establishing Ensemble Learning Models for Daily Rainfall Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The socio-agricultural landscape of a country is greatly influenced by heavy rainfall and precipitation. Forecasting future rainfall is a gift of estimating with many useful applications; it is a major indication of regional topology, climate change, and natural calamities. Prediction and estimation of rainfall are greatly aided by machine learning's remarkable toolbox.
