This paper's overarching goal is to determine how a subset of machine learning called ensemble learning influences a dataset used for rainfall prediction in order to make the models more accurate. Using an Australian rainfall dataset, the classification techniques presented in this work were first evaluated independently, and subsequently with pragmatic ensemble strategies such as bagging and boosting. In this study, we will examine the rise or fall of the aforementioned measures and show how ensemble learning techniques can reduce bias and variation. Boosting reduced variance by 13.6% on average and bias by 6% overall, according to the study. A generalization of the model's performance was noted, with a false negative rate reduction of over 20% on average. Further optimization of the model's performance can be achieved by applying the methods discussed in this work to the process of hyper-parameter tuning.

articleTitle: ProxiSense: IoT Smart Blind Stick with Voice Alerts for Obstacle and Water Hazard Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Visually impaired individuals often face challenges or difficulties when navigating unfamiliar environments or settings. These difficulties often stem from the fact that their ability to rely on visual cues is limited, making tasks such as detecting obstacles in front of them, identifying the presence of water, and knowing whether it's safe to cross the road or not, and navigating unfamiliar routes much more difficult. To address said issues, the researchers of the study developed ProxiSense, an Arduino-powered smart blind stick capable of detecting obstacles, the presence of water and its depth, and the state of the traffic light signals along with their countdown timer. The system leverages three different sensors: a color sensor for identifying the traffic light states, an ultrasonic sensor for obstacle detection, and a water sensor for water hazard detection. Furthermore, the system incorporates three different algorithms: the Traffic Light Crossing (TLC) Algorithm, the Sliding Window Algorithm, and the A * Algorithm. The TLC algorithm is used to assist the users, alerting them whether it's safe or not to cross the road. Meanwhile, the sliding window algorithm is utilized to forecast current weather conditions, and the a* algorithm is used to identify points of interest (POIs), providing users with directions and guiding them to their preferred locations. To further increase its reliability, the smart blind stick features voice alerts, sound alarms, and vibration motors for real-time feedback and interaction. Additionally, the system is also supported by a mobile application, allowing users or caregivers to view trip history, check today's weather condition, and set up new trips. To ensure that ProxiSense meets its specified requirements and objectives, the researchers conducted an evaluation using the ISO 25010:2011 software quality model. Functional Suitability had a mean of 3.50, classified as “Very High” Reliability had a mean of 3.48, rated as “Very High” Safety displayed a mean of 3.46, rated as “Very High”. Lastly, Interaction Capability showed a mean of 3.54, also rated as “Very High” The results of the evaluation across all criteria imply that the smart blind stick is functional and can be used for everyday navigation.

articleTitle: EDNCL: An Efficient Deep Learning Approach to Identify Cardiovascular Diseases Based on Enhanced Deep Neural Classifier Logic
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In light of the detrimental consequences of heart disease on society, there has been a concerted effort to improve its diagnosis and treatment. Data mining and the storage of medical information can enhance patient management opportunities as technology and medical diagnostics become more synergistic. Consequently, it is imperative to investigate the interdependence of the risk factors in patients' medical histories and to understand their respective contributions to the prognosis of cardiac disease. The objective of this research is to conduct an analysis of the numerous components in patient data in order to accurately predict cardiac disease. The proposed model, which is referred to as Enhanced Deep Neural Classifier Logic (EDNCL), has been employed to identify the most critical attributes for the prediction of heart disease. This model is designed to accurately predict cardiovascular disease using deep learning principles. It is necessary to cross-validate the suggested scheme with the more traditional Random Forest Classifier (RFC) learning strategy in order to determine its effectiveness. The efficacy of vision transformer models is contrasted to the state-of-the-art methodology RFC in order to illustrate the framework's contribution. The proposed framework demonstrates notable classification results, as evidenced by the experiment results. The potential of this methodology to accurately detect cardiac disease from acoustic signals is illustrated in this study. These discoveries offer promising prospects for improving patient care and medical diagnosis.

articleTitle: A Convoluted Learning and Classification Methodology to Predict Wheat Crop Disease Detection Using Artificial Intelligence Logic
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Wheat is one of the most vital crops globally, and detecting diseases early is crucial for maintaining crop yield and quality. Traditional methods of identifying wheat diseases are time-consuming and labor-intensive, prompting the need for automated solutions. This study presents a deep learning-based approach for wheat crop disease detection using artificial intelligence (AI) logic, focusing on architectures like ResNet152, VGG19, MobileNetV3, and EfficientNetB0. The dataset comprised images of healthy and diseased wheat plants, with data preprocessing and augmentation applied to enhance the model's robustness. ResNet152 achieved the highest classification accuracy of 98.84%, followed by EfficientNetB0 (95.80%) and VGG19 (96.78%). Data augmentation improved the model's performance across all classes, with class-wise accuracies improving by 3% to 4%. The models were evaluated based on precision, recall, F1-score, and inference time. The results demonstrate that ResNet152 offers the best balance between accuracy and efficiency for wheat disease classification, while MobileNetV3 is optimal for real-time deployment on edge devices due to its lightweight design. This model provides an effective, automated method for detecting wheat diseases, aiding in crop management and disease prevention.

articleTitle: Empirical Assessment of Identifying Human Blood Group Based on Image Processing Assisted Deep Learning Principles
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This study presents an empirical assessment of identifying human blood groups using image processing assisted by deep learning principles, specifically employing a cascaded Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Light Gradient Boosting Machine (LightGBM). Traditional methods of blood group identification are time-consuming and prone to errors, prompting the need for automated, more efficient systems. In this work, a CNN model was initially used to extract deep features from blood sample images, followed by a LightGBM classifier for final blood group classification. A comprehensive dataset, representing all major blood groups (A, B, AB, O, and Rh types), was collected and preprocessed for training and testing. The cascaded CNN-LightGBM approach achieved an accuracy of 92.4%, significantly outperforming baseline models, including standalone CNN (88.2%) and Random Forest (83.5%). The model also demonstrated high precision (92.1%), recall (92.0%), and F1-score (92.1%). Real-world testing was conducted to validate its robustness in clinical settings. The results indicate that the proposed model is well-suited for accurate and efficient blood group identification, with low inference time, making it ideal for real-time applications. This approach has the potential to transform blood diagnostics by providing an automated, scalable, and accurate solution.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Health Status of People in Rural Areas Using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This approach presents an overview of how AI is revolutionizing public health, creating opportunities for those from a low-income status to acquire healthcare that will be better, faster, and fairer. This article will address grave health disparities in neglected areas by using machine learning algorithms to investigate the health status of rural communities. The most efficacious method of anticipating health results was determined through a comparison of four different models: logistic regression, random forest, support vector machines, and gradient boosting. Gradient Boosting is an excellent competitor for health assessments as its AUC-ROC score is significantly higher than the other models. This proposed method will aid in the improvement of health interventions in the underprivileged rural areas by estimating the crucial health indicators and thus is a precious resource for early detection and monitoring. These results indicate that machine learning can contribute to improving public health infrastructure and healthcare service delivery.

articleTitle: AI-Driven HR Optimization Strategies in Finance and Marketing: Methodological Framework and Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The proposed systems that include AI and the IoT present innovative financial and marketing opportunities. AI analytics capabilities and networked devices with the capability to provide real-time data mean the possibility to significantly improve recruitment, employee engagement, performance management, and retention. It combines natural language processing and machine learning algorithms, offering personalized recommendations, and in the vision insights, and in the case of environmental sensors, smart devices, and wearable health monitors, it facilitates accumulation of significant data. This framework will integrate IoT with AI to enhance HR procedures: more engaging, efficient, and enjoyable work environment. Apart from better decision-making and automated occupations, it also advocates for a data-driven approach to HRM. Further, it can result in the formation of intelligent and responsive HR systems that have the potential of improving organizational effectiveness and work productivity.

articleTitle: Analysis and Comparison of Dimensionality Reduction Techniques for News Blog Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: News Blog Text-based Classification often relies on using deep learning and other complicated techniques, which are computationally expensive. In this paper, we try to analyze dimensionality techniques applied on Supervised Learning-based classifiers. This approach introduces supplementary-low-cost precursor techniques for getting a rough idea of news-reader trends and headline preferences of writers. These have potential applications in Search Engine Optimization for writers, News Advertising, Fake News detection, and many others.

articleTitle: Optimizing Tuberculosis Detection Through DenseNet Architecture and Ensemble Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Tuberculosis (TB) continues to be a major world-wide health concern. Immediate and accurate diagnosis is essential for both improving patient outcomes and controlling the illness. Sputum tests and chest X-rays are two examples of traditional diagnostic techniques that frequently depend on expert understanding and which can cause delays and irreg ularities. We describe an automated TB diagnosis method in this work that uses both machine learning and deep learning approaches to integrate clinical symptom analysis with advanced image processing. Our method combines lung X-ray pictures with patient symptoms which includes fever, cough, and weight loss. X-ray image and Symptoms is considered as two important data sources. We use a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) that has been trained using pretrained models such as ResNet and EfficientNet, and optimized to perform medical imaging. We then enhance the CNN by applying transfer learning. In order to determine the probability of tuberculosis infection, we constantly evaluate the symptoms using ensemble machine learning models like Random Forests and Gradient Boosting Machines (GBM). Diagnostic accuracy has been enhanced by combining the results of the symptom and image analysis into a single predictive model. Our model was trained and validated on a wide range of X-ray images and corresponding symptoms, generating more than 96 percent accuracy in early tuberculosis detection. This approach appears to be very promising and demonstrates the advantages of combining diverse data sources for improved medical diagnosis, especially in settings where access to trained radiologists is minimal. The efficiency of this methodology highlights the importance of multimodal analysis in growing AI- powered healthcare solutions.

articleTitle: Robust Sensor Fusion Algorithms for IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Sensor fusion is a critical component of the IoT ecosystem, as it combines a variety of data streams from multiple sensors to enhance the accuracy, reliability, and real-time decision-making. This research concentrates on the development of robust sensor fusion algorithms that are capable of effectively managing the heterogeneity, noise, and uncertainty that are inherent in data from Internet of Things (IoT) sensors. Our primary focus is on the ability of these algorithmic methodologies to manage data from multi-modal sensors. We investigate algorithms that are based on deep learning, Bayesian inference, and Kalman filtering. The proposed solutions aim to improve the performance of systems in sectors that are influenced by the Internet of Things (IoT), including healthcare, smart cities, industrial automation, and autonomous cars. This investigation investigates the scalability, energy efficiency, and computational burden of the Internet of Things (IoT) in the context of limited resources. Through simulations and practical applications, we demonstrate the enhancement of data precision, defect tolerance, and overall system dependability by these robust sensor fusion techniques.

articleTitle: A Robust Development of IoT Powered Smart Women Tracking System to Protect from Harrasments Using Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This paper presents the development of an IoT-powered smart women tracking system designed to enhance personal safety by leveraging artificial intelligence (AI) for real-time monitoring and emergency response. The system integrates a GPS module, GSM module, multiple sensors (heartbeat, temperature, and GSR), and emergency activation mechanisms, including an SOS button, voice activation, and fingerprint sensor. Field testing showed an average response time of 6.5 seconds across various scenarios, with the SOS button providing the fastest response at 5 seconds. GPS accuracy varied based on location, with an average deviation of 5 meters in urban areas and up to 20 meters in rural or underground environments. The system achieved a 92% success rate for GPS updates in optimal conditions, though this dropped to 70% in challenging conditions such as underground stations. Power consumption was optimized, allowing the device to last several hours in active mode. User feedback rated the system highly for ease of use, with an overall satisfaction rate of 90%, particularly for the SOS button and electric shock unit. While the system performed well, further improvements in voice recognition and GPS accuracy are needed. This research demonstrates the potential of IoT and AI in enhancing personal security, particularly for vulnerable groups like women.

articleTitle: Application of Machine Learning in Credit Scoring for Loan Approval Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Credit scoring forms a crucial part of loan approval systems, and it will evaluate the creditworthiness of applicants. Traditional methods sometimes make wrong judgments, for example, letting risky customers into the system and rejecting creditworthy ones, since this follow fixed, rule-based approaches. Machine learning will provide an evidence-based solution to these problems because, above all, it is adaptive. This paper develops a new hybrid ensemble model that integrates Gradient Boosting and Random Forest techniques to enhance the accuracy of lending approval systems based on credit scores. The proposed methodology enhances forecast accuracy by capturing complex relationships between financial attributes in addition to handling imbalanced information. The hybrid model is demonstrated to be better than standalone models of RF and GB in terms of precision, recall, accuracy, and AUC with experimental results on real-world loan datasets. Therefore, financial organizations are likely to minimize credit risks while simultaneously streamlining the efficiency and equity of the loan approval processes by implementing this integrated and scalable approach. The hybrid model achieved a accuracy of 92.3 % and performs better than RF and GB.

articleTitle: Secure Communication Protocols for IoT-Enabled Smart Grids
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The integration of the Internet of Things (IoT) into smart grids has changed energy management and distribution, and among its benefits are enhanced operational efficiency and real-time monitoring. However, there are significant security dangers associated with this growing interconnectedness, especially about the communication protocols. The goal of this project is to safeguard Internet of Things (IoT)-enabled smart grids from data breaches and cyberattacks by looking at secure communication methods. We provide a study of the available data integrity checks, authentication methods, and encryption technologies to suit the unique requirements of smart grid infrastructure. Furthermore, we assess how well different protocols mitigate common security threats including denial-of-service attacks, man-in-the-middle attacks, and unauthorized data access assaults. The study's conclusions highlight the importance of lightweight security solutions that can maintain high-performance levels and offer reliable protection at the same time. Advanced secure communication protocols can be implemented to increase the resilience of IoT-enabled devices.

articleTitle: EROP: A Logical 5G Enabled Data Communication with Improved Packet Delivery Ratio Using Enhanced Route Optimization Protocol over WSN Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Due to their instability, mobile nodes in a network cannot be reliably served by single-path communication. Under the enormous load, communication becomes extremely challenging on the alternate single way. There is no way to know for sure how much data will be lost due to packet loss in this network because of the shaky connections between mobile nodes. To accomplish legitimate packet transfer, the communication expense is furthermore concentrated. Reason being, communication becomes prohibitively expensive when a long-distance route is chosen for packet delivery. Both the energy usage and the rate of packet loss are increased. In order to find the optimal minimal distance routing path, the Enhanced Route Optimization Protocol (EROP) is built. This approach uses queue variation to manage data packet maintenance when the time slot surpasses its limit. Message Queuing Telemetry Transport (MQTT), a traditional model, is cross-validated using this suggested approach to assess the proposed scheme's efficiency. The effectiveness of packet broadcasting is enhanced by keeping packets waiting. A link-based route packet overload detection technique is built into the multipath jamming detection algorithm to identify packet overload. To prevent overload, user should also segment the route according to its properties and lowers the rate of packet loss and energy usage.

articleTitle: Internet of Things (IoT) Powered Child Rescue System from Open Borewells by Using WiFi Integrated ESP32 Controller and Smart Sensors Association
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Currently, the negligence of individuals in society is the reason why children are falling into the Bore well. The current systems available to protect the child are both less effective and more expensive. Consequently, the society requires a novel approach that is both more effective and efficient. In the majority of cases that have been reported thus far, a parallel opening is excavated, and subsequently a horizontal path is established to access the infant. Not only is it a time-consuming procedure, but it also carries a variety of risks. The Borewells rescue system is capable of performing a variety of actions to rescue the child by moving within the same Borewells where the child has been confined. The purpose of this paper is to rescue children who have fallen into a bore well. It appears that abandoned bore wells are mortality traps for minors. The primary water framework requirements of cultivators in India are met by groundwater, as the country is primarily known for agriculture. The very significant requirement of bore wells is typically tunneled for the groundwater exploration requirement due to the increasing population, diminishing land assets, and the advancement of urbanization. In turn, these borewell have begun to claim the lives of numerous innocent individuals. The Dynamic Child Rescue Model (DCRM) is a novel rescue system that has been developed in this research. It is designed to easily protect children from the borewell and is cross-validated with the conventional approach, the Pipeline Navigation Model (PNM), to assess the efficacy of the proposed scheme. The system is supported by the Internet of Things (IoT). This work suggests a novel design that incorporates a sensor located at the top of the borewell opening to detect the presence of a child if they fall inside.

articleTitle: Location Based Recommendation System Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In the rapidly growing tourism industry, the demand for personalized and contextually relevant recommendations is more significant than ever. This paper presents a new approach to a location-based recommendation system designed to give Points of Interest (POIs) to enhance tourism sector. We leverage the advance deep learning techniques including Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks. The system processes vast dataset which consists of attributes such as location of POIs, Latitude, Longitude, user rating and many more to deliver personalized recommendations. Utilizing CNNs for their capability of feature extraction and LSTMs for their ability to retain sequential patterns, this system adapts dynamically to evolving user interests. The scope this research includes development, implementation and continuous evaluation of the proposed method using primary data. Additionally, the study explores the commericial possibility of this approach, offering insights on how to enhance the customer experience while recommending POIs of user's preference. The system improves recommendation accuracy as well as identifies local attractions, contributing to a more tailored travel experience for users.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Insights for Predicting Customer Behavior in Online Retail
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The research work reports a comprehensive analysis of predictive analytics of customer behavior on e-commerce based on high-end data science and artificial intelligence techniques. The sourced information for customer demographics, transaction details, and purchase history was extracted from Kaggle. Machine learning models' applications were utilized to predict the attrition of the customers, which indicated that the accuracy of Random Forest was 87%, while that of XGBoost was 89%. The performance of the model was tested in terms of precision, recall, and F1-score. Precisely and recall for XGBoost were both 0.88. Additionally, different consumer types were identified by applying K-Means clustering to classify customers into different kinds based on their attributes of Recency, Frequency, and Monetary. Its findings indicate that predictive analytics can play a very significant input in making advertisements very effective and in keeping clients in this very dynamic world of e-commerce. In the last few years, there has been an impressive rise in online shopping due to more and more people gaining access to the internet, a growing preference for convenience, and technology's ever-changing nature of digital platforms.

articleTitle: CFOL: A Superficial Machine Learning Methodology to Identify Malwares by Using Convolutional Fuzzy Optimization Logic
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Malware poses a significant threat to the security and integrity of modern computer systems. Traditional malware detection methods, such as signature-based approaches, struggle to keep pace with the rapid evolution of malware. This paper presents Convolutional Fuzzy Optimization Logic (CFOL), a novel machine learning-based methodology for malware detection that leverages Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) enhanced with an Attention Mechanism. Data was collected from Kaggle's malware dataset, which was preprocessed to extract key features like file headers, API calls, and metadata. The CNN with Attention Mechanism demonstrated an accuracy of 97.80%, outperforming traditional models such as Random Forest and Support Vector Machines (SVM), which achieved accuracies of 91.3% and 89.6%, respectively. The Attention Mechanism allowed the model to prioritize the most critical malware features, significantly reducing the false positive rate (FPR) to 2.2%, one of the lowest among the tested models. Additionally, the system achieved high precision (98.2%), recall (97.1%), and F1 score (97.35%). The integration of fuzzy logic optimization further enhanced the decision-making process in cases of ambiguous classifications. The results validate the effectiveness of CFOL in detecting complex and evolving malware with high precision and minimal false positives.

articleTitle: Stock Price Forecasting by Time Series Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The technological advancement and mountains of financial data now available, more than ever it is crucial for investors, financial institutions, and decision-makers to make an informed choice by obtaining accurate stock price forecasting. Traditional techniques of forecasting often fail in today's complex market dynamics. This paper reveals a number of techniques of machine learning that can be applied to the field of stock price forecasting, de-emphasizing building up the accuracy and relia- bility of such predictions.[2] The main key algorithms presented are ElasticNet for feature selection and XGBoost, CatBoost, and an ensemble Voting Regressor. Its ability to analyze series data and identify strong, non-trivial patterns from the time series of stock price data made this model the best choice. Results show a performance that indicates just how well the ensemble Voting Regressor performed over the rest, with accuracy 99.6% far beyond any model from the bunch, promising much sharper resolution in financial forecasting. XGBoost and CatBoost also had very comparable accuracy that assured the productive use of machine learning in applying it for financial analytics. The research is not only a glorification of benefits from application of developed models of machine learning for predicting stock prices but also introduces points for further refinement of methods of prediction[4].

Author Keywords: Prediction of Stock Price using Machine Learning
It needs ElasticNet, XGBoost, CatBoost and Voting Regressor

articleTitle: Real-Time Energy Management in Buildings Using Reinforcement Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: While simultaneously maintaining the level of comfort and reducing the costs associated with functionality, the primary objective is to reduce the quantity of energy that is spent as much as possible. During the investigation, a framework that is anchored on RL is developed. By learning from literal and real-time data, reacting to varied environmental circumstances, and taking into account the actions of inhabitants, this system can make substantial alterations to the amount of energy that is currently being used. To anticipate and adjust to the requirements for energy, the system that has been shown makes use of complex algorithms. This ultimately leads to an increase in efficiency being achieved by the system. The results of the simulation indicate that there have been significant improvements in terms of both the amount of energy that has been saved and the functional performance that has been achieved in contrast to more conventional control strategies. Furthermore, the findings shed light on the probable role that RL will play in the accomplishment of sustainable energy operations in smart structures. This is in addition to the fact that they contribute to the broader pretensions of energy efficiency and environmental sustainability.

articleTitle: Brain Graph Super-Resolution for Enhanced Neurological Disorder Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Functional brain data analysis is important in diagnosing neurological disorders, yet constructing high-resolution (HR) brain graphs from low-resolution (LR) although the data presents some computational challenges. This paper introduces the Brain Graph Super-Resolution (BGSR) method that leverages generative adversarial networks (GANs) to directly generate HR graphs from LR data. By bypassing complex image processes, BGSR enhances diagnostic accuracy efficiently while retaining the features. This paper explains BGSR’ s methodology, detailing its implementation steps and emphasizing its potential to revolutionize neurological disorder diagnosis. Experimental results demonstrate BGSR's effectiveness in improving diagnostic precision compared to traditional methods. Furthermore, itdiscusses the broader implications of BGSR in advancing functional brain data analysis and suggests future research directions for further works and application in the field of medicine. BGSR is a promising tool for researchers and clinicians alike, offering insights into the minute workings of the brain and facilitating more accurate diagnosis and treatment of neurological disorders. Through its innovative approach, BGSR contributes to the ongoing efforts to unravel the complexities of the human brain and offers new avenues for understanding and addressing neurological disorders. Its streamlined methodology and enhanced diagnostic capabilities hold promise for improving patient outcomes and advancing the field of neuroscience. In the realm of neurological disorder analysis, conventional methods often grapple with issues of precision and struggle to cope with the brain data due to its complexity. This paper introduces a novel paradigm known as Brain Graph Super-Resolution (BGSR), a pioneering technique leveraging the potential of Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) to synthesize high-resolution brain graphs directly from low-resolution data, by circumventing convoluted image processing workflows, BGSR provides an efficient and interpretable avenue for comprehending minute brain networks. This study showcases BGSR's success in outperforming traditional methodologies, unveiling significant enhancements in diagnostic accuracy. However, BGSR's impact transcends mere clinical utility, heralding a new era of personalized medicine where early disease detection becomes feasible, and novel diagnostic instruments emerge. Future research endeavors will delve into integrating prior knowledge, addressing potential constraints, and conducting thorough clinical validations.

articleTitle: Detection of Facemask and Social Distance Using Deep Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The Middle East Respiratory Syndrome and Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome are examples of illnesses linked to respiration that affect birds and animals. Coronaviruses are a category of related viruses. The coronavirus pandemic of 2019 has had a significant influence on everyone's lives. Worldwide, millions of people have contracted the disease. The recent shutdowns implemented to contain the virus have also had a significant impact on the nation's economy. As the lockdown has ended, an in-depth investigation has revealed that the virus is pathogenic and may be spread by air or by coming into close contact with an infected individual. The World Health Organisation advises everyone to take particular precautions to prevent the transmission of this virus, such as maintaining a social distance or a sufficient physical space between individuals and wearing a face mask to prevent the droplets from spreading through the air. Currently, there are fewer limitations, and institutions that are more educational are opening. Thus, pupils hardly ever adhere to these safety precautions. We employed a deep learning technique in this paper. Therefore, spotting social exclusion and the prevalence of face mask infractions aids in protecting the security of human health. The approach suggested here saves time and slows the coronavirus's transmission. This technique may be used in areas with large populations, such as malls, stations, workplaces, and streets.

articleTitle: CardioSense-A Deep Learning Enhanced Early Heart Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Heart disease continues to be a significant reason for death globally, our project highlights the importance of efficient methods for detecting and intervening in the early stages. We use an assortment of cutting-edge bio-sensor technology with deep learning techniques to introduce a new system that predicts heart diseases at early stages. The suggested framework continually tracks the heart rate and sounds through a machine provided with advanced biosensors. These include Random Forest classifiers and Deformable Attention Transformers as well as Vision Transformers that process data collected by the sensors. The LSTM model recognizes temporal patterns in the physiological signals whereas the Random Forest classifier helps to choose reliable features for classification. This is enhanced by Deformable Attention Transformer which improves capability of this model to concentrate on important segments of data increasing its predictive accuracy. Our research findings suggest that this combined system provides an accurate and reliable way to detect heart diseases at earlier stages, which can be very useful in health care sector. The potential of integrating biological data with advanced machine learning algorithms for medical diagnoses is shown by the efficacy of our proposed method.

articleTitle: Advancements in CNN-Based Iris Recognition: Enhancing Biometric Security and Authentication Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: To improve biometric security and authentication, this study explores developments in CNN-based iris recognition systems. Using CNN architectures and sophisticated feature extraction, the research assesses the CNN-based system developed by IrisGuard. The system's 99.5% identification accuracy beats conventional approaches' 95% to 98% recognition accuracy, according to the results. The 150-millisecond authentication speed is optimized, which is faster than the 200–300 millisecond rates of earlier systems. Deployment expenses have been lowered to $400,000 from their previous range of $500,000 to $700,000. Furthermore, the system exhibits 98% accuracy resilience under a range of environmental circumstances and 95% regulatory compliance. The aforementioned outcomes highlight the system's exceptional capabilities in terms of precision, velocity, and economy, demonstrating its progress over traditional techniques and their usefulness in high-risk settings such as banking and healthcare.

articleTitle: An Improved Clone Node Detection System Based on Enhanced Neural Optimization Strategy Over Wireless Sensor Network Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) are widely used in diverse applications, including environmental monitoring and military surveillance. However, their open and distributed nature makes them vulnerable to clone node attacks, where an adversary replicates legitimate nodes to compromise network integrity. This paper presents an improved clone node detection system based on enhanced neural optimization strategies, utilizing various detection protocols such as Energy-efficient Ring-based Clone Detection (ERCD), Distributed Hash Table (DHT), Randomly Directed Exploration (RDE), Random Multicast (RM), and Randomized, Efficient, and Distributed (RED) methods. The performance of these protocols was evaluated based on detection accuracy, energy consumption, communication overhead, and memory usage across different network sizes. Results showed that the RED method achieved the highest detection accuracy of 99.3% in large networks (1000 nodes), followed closely by ERCD with 96.7%. The DHT and RDE protocols demonstrated lower energy consumption, making them suitable for large-scale, resource-constrained WSNs. The RM method had the lowest detection accuracy (94.3%) and the highest communication overhead. Overall, the proposed neural optimization strategy effectively balances accuracy and resource efficiency, enhancing the robustness of WSNs against clone node attacks. Future work will focus on integrating machine learning models to further optimize detection performance and minimize resource consumption.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Customer Experience with AI-Powered Chat bots and Virtual Assistants
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Customer service has historically been plagued with issues such as long call wait times, unavailability for real-time queries, inconsistent responses, poor engagement, and lack of coordination between multiple queries. However, an AI-powered chatbot and virtual assistant-based customer service has the potential to overcome these challenges and drive better performance. The proposed system uses advanced Natural Language Processing (NLP) with Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT) and Reinforcement Learning (RL) to deliver real-time and personalized interactions with human level accuracy. The system is available 24/7, ensures reduced wait times, and learns from continuous data inputs. As performance evaluation indicates, human accuracy increased by 76.8%, which also led to better customer satisfaction scores. These serves as a significant driver of improved operational performance of using a machine-learning based AI system versus human service while also improving customer loyalty and retention rates.

articleTitle: Smart Healthcare: A Logical Development of Medical Image Processing Based Sleep Apnea Disease Detection Using Elevated Neural Classification Principle
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Entirely common sleep disorder is the dangerous wakefulness (Apnea) of breathing during snoring. In this study, we explore the possibility of how medical image processing can be useful and accurate method for sleep disordered breathing detection. The new approach named as Sleep Apnea Analyzing Strategy (SAAS) is firstly tested with the help of existing method namely Image base Sleep Apnea Analyzer (ISAA) that use less number or data to be processed and hence running on portable device delivering results much faster than other available methods, both being cross-validated against each other. Sleep Apnea Image-based Detector using Ephysiology - A new Algorithm (SAAS) We rely on sophisticated image processing techniques to extract relevant characteristics from medical images (such as x-rays, CT scans or MRIs) which are indicative of patterns typically associated with sleep apnea. The proposed methodology includes image preprocessing to improve the quality of images, feature extraction for quantification and characterization of all relevant information during OSA trials in GUI interface through well-known classification algorithms to classify patients with at least 20 de-saturations without sleep apnea. Our research aims to help in the creation of automatic diagnostic methods that will lead to early detection and treatment for sleep apnea. Our objective with this work is to provide a fair evaluation of the proposed technique in terms of sensitivity, specificity and accuracy through using a large dataset.

articleTitle: ODLCP: A Novel Methodology to Predict Immune System Strength by Using Optimized Deep Learning and Classification Principle
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Immune responses that are mediated by antibodies are essential to the functioning of the immune system in vertebrates. Due to the fact that antibodies have the ability to connect to antigens, they are employed widely in the treatment of cancer as well as other dangerous ailments. The process of experimentally finding antibody-antigen interactions is an essential stage in antibody therapy. This process is typically laborious, costly, and time-consuming. Because of the continued reliance on multidimensional structures, the deployment of computational methodologies that have been recommended for screening potential antibodies continues to be restricted. We introduce a unique deep learning strategy called Optimized Deep Learning and Classification Principle (ODLCP) for accurate immune strength prediction in this paper. In order to evaluate the effectiveness of this method, we cross-validate it with a more conventional learning method known as Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). By incorporating a wide range of clinical and immunological data, our goal is to develop a prediction model that is capable of accurately determining the strength of an individual's immune system. It is possible that the proposed paradigm would revolutionize healthcare since it will make it possible to develop individualized treatments that will improve immune health and allow for the early detection of disorders connected to immunological processes.

articleTitle: A Novel Geometric Evaluation of Building Crack Detection and Reporting System Using Improved Learning Strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The ability to identify cracks is crucial for determining the safety of building structures during inspections. Consequently, it is crucial to have professionals conduct building inspections on a regular basis to guarantee the dependability and durability of buildings. Traditional building inspection methods have relied on human visual examination with AI approaches that have achieved remarkable achievement in computer vision in the past several years. It is currently impossible to guarantee that the quality of the detection is up to standard and accurate when engineering personnel primarily use simple mechanical monitoring instruments to monitor concrete cracks. Human inspection is bound to be impacted by psychological, physical, and external factors, as well as by emotions. An intelligent system for detecting cracks in building structures may be built using the new approach known as Improved Learning Strategy for Building Crack Detection (ILSBCD), which is a combination of digital image processing and deep learning techniques. In addition, this work suggests a method to improve the known partly entangled states of constructing micro-particles by using the entanglement exchange mechanism that is based on the deep learning methods between two of these particles. Based on computational picture processing techniques and multi-scale evaluation of features, the testing findings demonstrate that the automatic crack detection approach works well. Initiating the device, seeing real-time photos, taking pictures of a crack, measuring its breadth, and evaluating its safety are all done using the system's graphical user interface. In order to improve the image's contrast using binarization techniques, the photos and their findings are saved for reference and then used to execute contrast enhancement. Lastly, the picture is segmented using the Improved Learning Strategy for Building Crack Detection (ILSBCD) method, which allows for more accurate crack detection. In order to determine how effective the suggested model is, this method is cross-validated using a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN).

articleTitle: Intelligent Transportation Systems IoT Solutions for Traffic Optimization and Autonomous Vehicle Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Many existing frameworks to support Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) lean on static infrastructure and sparse real-time data, which have inefficiencies that may exacerbate safety concerns such as are manifested with the emergence of autonomous vehicles. In the paper, a novel IoT-enabled system combining vehicle-to-infrastructure (V2I) communication with complex machine Learning (ML) models is presented to develop an intelligent adaptive traffic control approach. The use of IoT sensors for collecting real-time data to predict traffic flow and improve road safety. Advances between 20 and up to for average travel time, and up-to-32 % reduction in the Traffic Congestion Index were reported from existing methods. Furthermore, accident levels have fallen by 33%, indicating increased safety. Overall, the proposed ITS architecture provides a robust solution for contemporary urban transportation with several fundamental differences from traditional systems without hindering or impeding autonomous vehicles to be integrated in a ubiquitous manner.

articleTitle: An Effective Cluster Based Energy and Power Optimization Routing Protocol Design over Wireless Sensor Network Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Environmental monitoring, industrial automation, and smart communities are among the numerous applications in which Wireless Sensor Networks (WSN) are essential. Nevertheless, the effective management of energy and power resources continues to be a substantial obstacle, as sensor nodes are frequently deployed in large quantities and are battery-powered. This paper introduces the Power Optimized Routing Protocol (PORP), a novel cluster-based routing protocol that is intended to optimize energy and power consumption in WSN. The proposed scheme's efficacy is evaluated by cross-validating it with the conventional routing protocol, Dynamic Source Routing (DSR). The dynamic clustering mechanism that has been proposed in our protocol, PORP, minimizes energy consumption through intelligent methods of cluster formation and data aggregation. In this way, it further extends the network's lifecycle and reduces its average energy usage through energy-efficient and power-aware algorithms. We evaluated the effectiveness of our protocol through comprehensive simulation and compared our protocol with existing ones regarding energy efficiency, network lifetime, and data transmission reliability. The study proved to be very in-depth and comprehensive regarding the efficiency of the protocol, which highlighted the possibilities of the protocol's implementation with real-world WSN applications to ensure proper functioning of even more sustainable and efficient wireless sensor networks.

articleTitle: Experimental Analysis of an IoT Based Secured Data Communication between Social Communities Over Wireless Sensor Network Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: With respect to the expertise, background, and information that the communities of a social affair with a wireless sensor network (WSN) have contributed the purpose of this study is to offer an updated data communication technique under the heading of Secure Communication for Data Centric Social Affair in IoT powered Wireless Sensor Network. The system creates a decentralized and resilient network for the exchange of data using IOT devices. The proposed technique, IoT based Secured Data Exchange Protocol (IoTSDEP), is a new strategy for enriched data sharing across communities. The cross-validated results with the existing method called Network Data Sharing Protocol (NDSP), and the counterpart highlight its significant contributions towards efficient exchange as well as flow of information from one community to another. An IoT-based data sharing protocol is essentially the rules or standards that govern how different “things” transfer and exchange digital information between them. This protocol is devised to ensure crossfunctionality, reliability and scalability within an IoT-based environment. It utilizes advanced cryptographic techniques, like lightweight encryption algorithms and secures data confidentiality, integrity as well authentication. The framework further includes secure routing protocols and intrusion detection mechanisms to defend against likely threats. The system enhances privacy, trust and collaboration among the members of the community with the provision for secure information flow in WSN.

articleTitle: AI-Powered Cryptocurrency Trading Enhancing Decision-Making and Market Predictions
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Cryptocurrency trading has become sophisticated by the day as market volatility and information are continuously enhanced. The reliance of traditional trading systems on historical data and human prediction result in inefficiency and risk for both investors and stockbrokers. The paper provides Imagine using Artificial Intelligence for trading cryptocurrency, which can provide better results than human trading. The machine learning-based approach uses real-time information, whether it be a buy or sell action, while considering real-time information such as social media for sentiment analysis, and adapting trading to achieve better results. The model will use advanced machine learning models including supervised, unsupervised learning, exploratory models, and reinforcement learning to provide tangible results such as improved accuracy in predicting price and sentiment analysis. The results show that the model has significantly improved its efficiency and performance, yielding a Root Mean Squared Error of 0.032 and a Sharpe Ratio of 2.1. These means that it has demonstrated the capability to yield superior risk-adjusted returns and higher reliability, making it a perfect alternative for investors.

articleTitle: Streamlining Intelligence Design and Fabrication of Artificial Intelligence Based Robotic PVC Pipe Cutting Machine
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The traditional power hacksaw machine is going to be automated in order to attain a higher level of work-piece productivity than the power cutting machine. This is the goal of this endeavour. The number of pieces that need to be cut and the length of each piece that needs to be cut are both inputs that are provided to the automated machine. With the assistance of a battery, the inputs are provided and received. It is not necessary for the operator to take measurements of the length of the work-piece that is going to be cut, nor is it necessary for the operator to load and unload the work-piece from the chuck each time after a piece has been cut. Until the specified numbers of work pieces have been cut, the machine will automatically feed the specified length of the work piece into a chuck and begin cutting for the specified amount of time. a device that is powered by a direct current (DC) motor and an infrared (IR) sensor assures that the feeding will cease once the length that was defined has been achieved. The reciprocating motion that is necessary for cutting the work parts must be brought about. The reciprocating mechanism is equipped with an electromagnetic self-weight that is attached to it. This self-weight is responsible for providing the necessary downward force that is required for the hacksaw blade to penetrate the work-piece. When it comes to cutting any form of product, even circular, the machine that we created and fabricated is available for usage. It is possible to switch out the cutting tool in accordance with the kind of material that has to be cut. Details of the pipe are provided by this project. It is possible to find widespread applications for this equipment in virtually every industry. One of the most important aspects of every industry is the process of cutting pipes. Hand-operated cutting machines are typically used in middle and small-scale companies. These machines are typically controlled manually. Within the context of the current world, automation is unavoidable. Any machine that is designed to make efficient use of both human labour and material resources is considered an automated machine. The pipe cutting machine is powered by a motor in order to function properly. Pipe cutting of both small and big sizes was utilized in our project, and adjustments were made to a variety of pipe types.

articleTitle: Enhancing Machine Translation: Cross-Approach Evaluation and Optimization of RBMT, SMT, and NMT Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This paper presents a comparative analysis of three major machine translation approaches: Rule-Based Machine Translation, Statistical Machine Translation, and Neural Machine Translation. Through a detailed evaluation of these methods, the paper identifies the strengths and weaknesses of each approach in addressing challenges posed by various language pairs and translation domains. The results demonstrate that Neural Machine Translation outperforms Rule-Based Machine Translation and Statistical Machine Translation in fluency and contextual accuracy, particularly for complex sentences, while Statistical Machine Translation remains more suitable for low-resource settings. The proposed analysis also introduces performance benchmarks, including BLEU scores, accuracy, and fluency metrics, establishing a standard for machine translation system evaluation. This research contributes to the body of knowledge by offering insights into optimizing machine translation systems for diverse languages, particularly low-resource languages, with a focus on scalability, computational efficiency, and practical applications. The significance of this study lies in its potential impact on improving global communication and fostering collaboration across linguistic barriers by proposing enhancements to existing machine translation methodologies. Future work will focus on refining hybrid machine translation systems that integrate the best features of Rule-Based Machine Translation, Statistical Machine Translation, and Neural Machine Translation to achieve more robust and adaptable translation solutions.

articleTitle: Enhancing Autonomous Vehicle Navigation Using Deep Learning-Based Scene Understanding
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: To navigate complex environments, AV navigation relies on the accuracy of scene understanding. In this work, a new approach based on deep learning is brought into relation with the object recognition, scene segmentation, motion prediction, and reinforcement learning for enhancing AV navigation. The methodology starts by utilizing the scene segmentation accomplished by breaking down the drivable areas along with obstacles using the U-Net architecture. Real-time object recognition using YOLO is incorporated at the end. With an LSTM network, the AV can predict potential future behaviors of moving objects. RRT<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">*</sup> is best for collision avoidance while navigating to build up a route. Conclusion: A Deep Q-Learning reinforcement learning system improves real-time navigation and provides a framework for optimization for dynamic decision-making and vehicle control situations. Simulation and experimental results also demonstrate that the technology increases the navigation efficiency and reduces the frequency of collisions, which improves the process of obstacle avoidance. Thereby, 92.5 % precision for U-Net can be proven.

articleTitle: RBoost-Net: A Hybrid Deep Learning Model for Efficient Cybersecurity Threat Detection to Preserve Privacy in IoT Devices
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The exponential growth of Internet of Things (IoT) devices has led to an increasing concern for cybersecurity due to the vulnerabilities present in these interconnected systems. This paper presents RBoost-Net, a hybrid deep learning model that integrates ResNet for feature extraction and LightGBM for classification to efficiently detect cybersecurity threats in IoT environments. The RBoost-Net model was evaluated against nine existing machine learning and deep learning models, including CNN, SVM, Random Forest, Logistic Regression, XGBoost, Naive Bayes, Gradient Boosting Machine, ANN, and LightGBM. The evaluation metrics considered were accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, AUC-ROC, training time, inference time, and false positive rate. RBoost-Net achieved superior performance across all metrics, with an accuracy of 95.32%, significantly outperforming the compared models. The model's ability to balance accuracy, speed, and false positive rate makes it an ideal candidate for real-time IoT cybersecurity applications. This hybrid approach demonstrates the potential of combining deep learning with boosting techniques for efficient and accurate threat detection. The paper also discusses the advantages of RBoost-Net in identifying various IoT threats, including Denial of Service (DoS), Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS), data breaches, and malware, and highlights its scalability and adaptability in diverse IoT environments.

articleTitle: A Novel Future Predictive Approach to Model Healthcare Status Forecasting Based on BigData Evaluation Principle
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The rapid advancement of technology and the exponential growth in healthcare data have necessitated the development of robust predictive models to anticipate future healthcare trends and outcomes. This paper introduces a novel predictive approach designed to model healthcare status forecasting using the Big Data Evaluation Principle. We aimed to predict the healthcare status of an individual using EHR and genomic data, as well as environmental lifestyle factors based on a comprehensive dataset by proposing novel approaches in this research. It looks to create complex machine learning models that can detect subtle patterns and forecast health outcomes - such as the onset, advancement or exacerbation of diseases. This system is a new one called BigData enabled Predictive Healthcare Modeling (BPHM) which has verified by cross-validation with the existing method Predictive Modelling for Healthcare Analyzer known as PMHA and cost of personal healthcare can be decreased; also quality of life can be improved using proposed systems. The accuracy of the proposed method is 97.8%. Referring to high-level computational methods, the proposed model is meant for resource allocation, treatment plan personalization and improved patient outcomes. Furthermore, the work will apply robust evaluation measures to assess performance of this model and investigate how it can support health policy-making as well decision making. This work ultimately aims to help build a patient-centric predictive, preventative and personalized healthcare in future.

articleTitle: An Optimized Sensors Associated Forest Fire Prediction and Reporting System Based on Internet of Things Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Forest fires pose a significant threat to the environment, leading to the destruction of ecosystems and contributing to climate change. This paper presents an optimized sensor-based forest fire prediction and reporting system leveraging Internet of Things (IoT) technology. The system integrates Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) and IoT-enabled devices to monitor environmental parameters, including temperature, CO2, and smoke levels. The system demonstrated high sensor accuracy, with temperature sensors showing a maximum deviation of ±0.5°C and gas sensors displaying an accuracy of ±2 ppm for CO2. Smoke detection accuracy was within ±0.05 ppm, making the system reliable for early fire detection. The system's response time improved significantly with increasing temperatures, detecting fire events within 10 seconds for temperatures above 100°C. The Wireless Sensor Network maintained a packet delivery ratio (PDR) of over 99% and an average latency of 200ms under high node density, ensuring timely transmission of critical data. With power consumption optimized for long-term deployment, sensor nodes were estimated to operate for up to 24 months. Overall, this system offers a cost-effective, accurate, and efficient solution for real-time forest fire monitoring and response, with potential applications in large, remote forest areas.

articleTitle: Enhancing Cybersecurity: A Scalable System for Real-Time Threat Detection Using ML and Automated Response
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Advanced forensic and cybersecurity technologies are required due to the swift evolution of cyber threats. Real-time threat detection and scalability are problems for traditional solutions since these rely on antiquated technologies and human processes. These technologies are overpowered by the massive amount of data produced by contemporary IT infrastructures and are reactive, frequently detecting risks after an incident. To overcome these limitations, the proposed system combines real-time data analytics, automated incident response, and machine learning (ML). It collects information from multiple sources, preprocesses it, and then uses ML methods such as DBSCAN (Density-Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise) and Isolation Forest to identify anomalies. Timely threat mitigation is ensured via automated reactions and real-time analytics. The evaluation reveals that the proposed system handles 20 TB of data in 45 minutes as opposed to 5 TB in 60 minutes by conventional systems, increases threat detection accuracy to 92.0% from 85.0%, and decreases average response time to 10 seconds from 45 seconds. These improvements show notable improvements in cybersecurity efficacy and efficiency.

articleTitle: HMLM: An Intelligent Artificial Intelligence Assisted Strategy to Identify UPI Frauds Based on Hybrid Markov Learning Methodology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The proliferation of Unified Payments Interface (UPI) transactions in the digital age has considerably improved financial inclusion, but it has also increased the vulnerability to fraud. This manuscript introduces a novel approach that employs Artificial Intelligence (AI) to detect UPI frauds. The approach is based on deep learning and is referred to as the Hybrid Markov Learning Methodology (HMLM). To evaluate the suggested system, it is cross-checked against the traditional Hidden Markov Model (HMM). Our approach combines the benefits of modern artificial intelligence methods with Markov models to improve the accuracy of fraud detection. Combining deep learning algorithms with probabilistic state transitions allows the hybrid Markov Learning Methodology to dynamically analyze transaction patterns and behaviors. By modeling both historical and real-time transaction data, our approach improves the identification of unusual activity and fraud patterns that conventional algorithms may ignore. From experimental data, we prove our approach minimizes false positives and improves the rate for fraud detection against the current options available. Our work advances the current state of fraud detection systems using more flexible and robust fraud detection systems, thus enabling security and confidence in UPI transactions.

articleTitle: Traffic Congestion Reduction Using Fuzzy Optimization Scheme in Heterogeneous Vehicular Communication Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: VANETs emphasize their similarities and challenges compared to MANETs, particularly concerning dynamic node movement and routing protocols. It highlights existing research efforts, including routing protocol proposals and optimization algorithms, addressing congestion, delay reduction, and resource management. Proposed TCRFOS approach for congestion reduction in VANETs through fuzzy optimization techniques. VANETs, a type of MANETs, pose unique challenges due to the dynamic nature of vehicle movements and network conditions. Existing routing protocols adapted from MANETs struggle to address the rapid changes in node locations and wireless channels. To tackle this, the TCRFOS approach integrates fuzzy logic and resource management to accurately predict resource survival time, optimizing traffic flow and minimizing congestion. Through fuzzification, fuzzy inference, and defuzzification, TCRFOS effectively manages resources, enhancing network efficiency. The document describes the system model, explaining how the method considers aspects such as the likelihood of road collapse and the road utilization ratio to enhance the road network while reducing congestion. Additionally, the fuzzy optimization process is explained, highlighting the components involved and their roles. Results from experimentation using the proposed ERCRMs protocol demonstrate significant improvements in various metrics such as network throughput, delay, routing overhead, transmission accuracy, and energy efficiency compared to existing methods. This underscores the effectiveness of the TCRFOS approach in enhancing communication efficiency, reliability, and energy conservation in VANETs, positioning it as a promising solution for congestion mitigation in dynamic vehicular environments.

Author Keywords: Traffic Congestion Reduction and Heterogeneous Vehicular Communication

articleTitle: An Integrated Algorithm for Load Balancing Discrepancies in Cloud Computing Using Weighted Least Connection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Cloud computing is expanding faster than anticipated; hence, load balancing must be done effectively. Conventional methods like Round Robin and static prioritization tend to struggle under dynamic demand, resulting in resource hoarding and headaches from bottlenecking. To avoid these limitations, the proposed Weighted Least Connection (WLC), which introduces manipulation of server weights dynamically, where server weight is recorrected based on live load metrics. It comprises adaptive weight adjustments, load checking in real time and task allocation based on server capacity to improve resilience and scalability together. The comparative analysis shows that WLC system reduces latency up to 25% and improved resource utilization across the servers by (41.67%). Medium and large task times also show an improvement of 33.33%-time savings for completion of a task. These highlights the ability of WLC in balancing cloud environments, and dynamic load balancing techniques as an alternative to static load balancing methods.

articleTitle: An Internet of Things (IoT) Assisted Forest Fire Detection Mechanism Using Hybrid Classification and Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: For all the primary and secondary advantages they provide, forests are an indispensable part of humanity's natural resource arsenal. Forest fires and other natural catastrophes significantly affect both the rate of global warming and the viability of Earth's biota. Consequently, studying how to automatically detect forest fires is crucial for reducing the frequency and severity of such catastrophes. Determinants of fire prevention and suppression strategies can benefit from early detection as well. In this study, we use computer vision algorithms based on artificial intelligence to identify fire and smoke in photographs. This paper presents a new hybrid methodology called Enhanced Learning with Fire Classification Model (ELFCM). It uses learning in conjunction with classification norms to accurately report fire and smoke details. To test how well the proposed scheme works, it is cross-validated with the conventional Random Forest Classifier (RFC). According to the findings of the experiments, some of the unreported or incorrectly detected fires that ELFCM reported may be confirmed by using IoT devices. The fire department receives this recorded report for their records. In the end, we tested the fire classification findings by comparing our method's performance to that of other previously announced fire detection methods that employed commonly used performance matrices.

articleTitle: IoT-Based Precision Agriculture Using Smart Sensors and Cloud Computing for Crop Monitoring and Yield Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The Internet of Thingsbased precision agriculture system plans to deliver the finest agricultural productivity by giving real-time monitoring and therefore informed decisions based on data. Data from the different environmental factors like temperature, soil and other aspects are evaluated by smart sensors and then subsequently sent to the AWS Cloud by a central microcontroller. Then, the XGBoost machine learning model is applied to predict agricultural output under several scenarios following all that has been done with the collected data. Hyperparameter tuning gives the best performance while feature selection enhances the accuracy of the model after normalization and preprocessing. The results of experiments give a 98.5% prediction accuracy, which is confirmed by an R-squared value of 0.92 and an error of 0.245. The system utilizes a new method to enhance farm productivity, reduce resource usage, and enable data-driven decisions in real time.

articleTitle: IoT Applications in Economic Data Collection and Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The process of collecting and interpreting lucrative data has transformed because of the adoption of technology related to the Internet of Things (IoT). This is because real-time data and perceptivity can now be experienced in ways that were before impractical thanks to modern technologies. This endeavor aims to examine the impact that Internet of Things operations have on lucrative data operations. More specifically, there is a lot of interest in how detector-driven data collecting improves the accuracy, timeliness, and granularity of profitable points of information. This inquiry uses case studies and empirical data to show how the Internet of Things (IoT) has revolutionizedseveral industries, including manufacturing, retail, and municipal planning. This research has been used to demonstrate these consequences. This article aims to investigate the role that the Internet of Things plays in enhancing data accuracy, enabling predictive analytics, and streamlining the process of making informed decisions. Furthermore, the research explores issues that have similarities to the previous discussions, including the need for a robust framework, integration obstacles, and data sequestration. The results highlight how the Internet of Things may be used to improve profitable soothsaying, optimize resource allocation, and foster innovation.

articleTitle: Boost Your Career: Real-Time Job Analytics, Virtual Voice Feedback and Job Notification Using Collaborative Filtering Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In today's rapidly evolving job market, job seekers encounter numerous challenges when trying to identify suitable employment opportunities and adequately prepare for interviews. The project titled “Boost Your Career: Real-Time Job Analytics, Virtual Voice Feedback, and Job Notification using Collaborative Filtering Algorithms” seeks to empower individuals by combining advanced analytics with personalized feedback mechanisms. The platform harnesses real-time job market data to provide users with valuable insights into current employment trends and the skills that are most in demand. By employing collaborative filtering algorithms, it generates tailored job notifications that cater specifically to the preferences and qualifications of users. This feature significantly enhances the overall user experience and increases the likelihood of securing a job placement. A standout component of this platform is its virtual voice feedback system, which simulates interview scenarios, allowing users to practice their responses in a realistic environment. Through this system, users receive constructive feedback on their performance, helping them refine their speaking skills and build confidence for actual interviews. By integrating these innovative features, this project aims to create a comprehensive tool that not only assists users in discovering job opportunities but also enhances their readiness for interviews. Ultimately, “Boost Your Career” facilitates a smoother transition into the workforce, equipping job seekers with the necessary tools and insights to navigate their career paths successfully.

articleTitle: A Novel Encrypted Data Hiding and Image Encryption for Authentication Based Communication Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Secure data sharing is crucial for many real time applications such as law enforcement agencies, military conversations and medical data sharing, etc., However, since sensitive information might be intercepted or leaked, sharing it presents a serious security risk. Here, a unique strategy combining steganography and cryptography approaches is proposed to overcome this difficulty. By encrypting data using AES encryption and concealing it behind an image using Modified Least Significant Bit (LSB) and picture encryption using Elliptic Curve Cryptography (ECC), the suggested method seeks to improve data transmission security. AES encryption, a well-known symmetric encryption method renowned for its efficiency and resilience, is used in the first layer of security. This guarantees that the plain-text communication, which is safeguarded by a powerful encryption key, stays private. By employing a modified Least Significant Bit (LSB) technique to incorporate the AES-encrypted text inside a cover picture, you may go one step further. The inclusion of crucial information is concealed within the seemingly innocent image thanks to this secret embedding, even in the event that the communication is intercepted. ECC encryption, a potent asymmetric encryption technique, adds a second layer of protection by preserving the validity and integrity of the cover picture itself.
