By utilizing the mathematical characteristics of elliptic curves, ECC encryption generates safe digital signatures for the picture that are verifiable and tamper-evident. By integrating these two techniques, proposed approach ensures end-to-end security for sensitive text messages. The use of AES guarantees the confidentiality of the message, while the modified LSB embedding conceals it within an image. Moreover, ECC encryption serves as a resilient method to authenticate the integrity of the image, guaranteeing that it remains unaltered throughout its transmission.

articleTitle: ENCL: Empirical Evaluation of Consumer Behaviour Analysis Model Using Internet of Things (IoT) Based Enhanced Neural Classification Logic
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The proliferation of consumer data can be attributed to “the Internet of Things (IoT),” which makes it easier to access and more detailed than before. In this research our purpose is to evaluate the effectiveness of a consumer behavior analysis model using data from IoT. The quality of the model is evaluated on multiple parameters - accuracy, predictability and business sense for marketing. It uses the analytics of huge amounts for data from IoT devices to predict patterns, customer preferences and trends. The proposed method called as Enhanced Neural Classification Logic (ENCL) is cross-validated with the already existing method, which is termed as Consumer behavior Forecasting Strategy (CBFS), and helps users to share gather or process information in a fast and cost-effective way through the proposed method. The results are useful to grasp the promise of IoT in more effective consumer behavior analysis. The research portrays the strengths, weaknesses and possible areas of improvement in this model which will be beneficial for both academic and industry practitioners. As such, the objective of this study is to show how an IoT-based consumer behavior analysis can increase business growth and customer satisfaction. The experimental evaluations demonstrate significant improvements in predictive performance over traditional methods, providing actionable insights for targeted marketing and strategic decision-making. The results highlight ENCL's potential to transform consumer behavior analysis by delivering more precise and nuanced understandings of market dynamics.

articleTitle: Advanced Colorectal Cancer Prediction Using CNN and XGBoost Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Despite advances in medical prognosis and early cancer detection, colorectal cancer (CRC) remains the third most deadly cancer in the world. Deborah L. Davidson further asserts the need for better models of prediction. This research proposes a hybrid model of CRC prediction that employs a combination of medical image analysis - using convolutional neural network - and structured clinical data processing, which is a tool called XGBoost. It uses CNN model which is trained on colonoscope and histopathological images to detect any cancerous pattern and XGBoost to process patient's demographics, genetic markers and lifestyle factors. A combined feature set is created, which incorporates both the CNN and the XGBoost features, thus allowing the ultimate classifier to evaluate the chances of disease progression.

articleTitle: Efficient Route Map Selection Using Cat Swarm Optimization with Multi-Hop Communication in Vehicular Adhoc Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: VANETs are a popular method for communication between nearby and stationary vehicles. VANETs enhance intelligent communication technology significantly, yet they face challenges like vehicle speed, dynamic topology, and routing complexities leading to communication disruptions. Various devices such as RSUs, OBUs, and dedicated short-range systems form the network, relying on inter-vehicular and infrastructure-based communication. This model introduces a unique two-layer vehicle node organization, allowing cars and buses to transmit, receive, and relay packets. The system emphasizes reduced node density and consistent path selection, employing AODV for multi-path routing. Inspired by cat behavior, the SCCSO method streamlines the optimization process, ensuring efficient energy utilization and routing path optimization. This paper presents a novel ERCSO for VANETs, focusing on energy efficiency and network stability. The proposed model employs multi-path routing using AODV and SCCSO to optimize paths based on node density and consistency. Through ns3 simulations, ERCSO is compared against existing methods, showcasing superior energy efficiency, consumption, delay reduction, throughput, and data delivery performance.

Author Keywords: Seeking and Tracing Cat Swarm Optimization (SCCSO)

articleTitle: Fruit Quality Detection:A Comparative Study of the YOLO Series
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Fruit Quality detection is an important aspect in the agricultural and food supply chain, it is necessary to ensure that only fruits that meet a certain standard of quality reach consumers. Generally, this process is done manually by workers carrying out visual inspection based on the fruit's appearance, texture, and color; this can be time-consuming and is subject to human errors. This may cause inefficiencies in large-scale production and possibly compromise the quality of fruits reaching the market. A fruit quality detection system is designed in this study using computer vision techniques, and a comparative analysis of YOLO series models is conducted for fruit quality detection. The analysis focuses on various performance metrics, including speed, accuracy, and robustness, while considering the benefits of each architecture. Each model is assessed to highlight its key strengths and ability to accurately classify fruit quality, with the goal of selecting the most suitable model to address the shortcomings of traditional methods. The performances of YOLOv8, YOLOv9, YOLOv10, and YOLOv11 are analyzed in terms of precision, recall, and mean Average Precision (mAP). YOLOv9 had the highest mAP50 and mAP50-95 with the score of 0.981 for both. Furthermore, the model has a very high recall of about 0.936, which makes it ideal for detection tasks needed in precision-demanding areas.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of Weapon Detection in Images Using Deep Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Finding weapons is an essential part of maintaining public safety and averting violent happenings. The YOLO (You Only Look Once) object detection algorithm has become a well-liked and effective method for real-time firearm identification using computer vision algorithms in recent years. The application of YOLO for weapon detection and its efficacy in detecting firearms, knifes, and other weapons are covered in this report. Using a collection of annotated photos, we trained a YOLOv8 model, and then we assessed its performance using a test dataset. The findings show that YOLO is an accurate and reliable approach for weapon detection, improving the model's performance in many settings and obtaining a high mAP and mA.

articleTitle: ENOP: A Robust Methodology to Predict Working Employee Stress Levels Using Enhanced Neural Optimization Principle
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Employee stress is a significant concern in modern workplaces, especially in high-demand industries like IT, where prolonged stress can lead to mental health issues and reduced productivity. This paper introduces ENOP (Enhanced Neural Optimization Principle), a robust methodology to predict employee stress levels using a hybrid approach combining AlexNet for feature extraction and LightGBM for classification. The model leverages physiological data such as Galvanic Skin Response (GSR) and Electrocardiogram (ECG) along with survey-based demographic and psychological factors. Key features include health concerns, pressure, financial and family issues, working hours, and regular interaction. The AlexNet-LightGBM model demonstrated high performance across multiple metrics, achieving an accuracy of 92%, precision of 89%, recall of 91%, and an F1-score of 90%. This hybrid approach outperforms traditional machine learning methods in both processing efficiency (92%) and training time (280 seconds), making it suitable for real-time stress monitoring and management. The model's ability to provide actionable insights into stress-inducing factors allows for targeted interventions, helping improve workplace productivity and employee well-being.

articleTitle: A Novel Phishing Attack Detection System Based on Web Platforms by Using Deep Learning Methodology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Global economic expansion facilitated by technology has led to an evolution in phishing attacks in recent years. An uptick in phishing and other sophisticated online attacks, together with an uptick in impersonation frauds, has contributed to a general uptick in fraudulent activity losses this year. To safeguard users' online activities, a more effective phishing detection mechanism is necessary, since the worldwide impact of these attacks will only grow. Using the URL and website content such photos, text, and frames, this study aimed to build a deep learning-based phishing detection system to fill this demand. When it comes to image and natural language processing, deep learning methods work wonders. Binary Learning with Phishing Detection Strategy (BLPDS) is a novel approach to efficiently detect phishing attacks introduced in this paper. To assess its efficacy, it is cross-validated with the conventional Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) method. Applying the BLPDS to big datasets allowed for a thorough experimental evaluation and comparison of its efficacy in detecting phishing web pages and attacks. The precise proof demonstrating the efficacy of the suggested system is shown in the result section.

articleTitle: A GRU-Driven Machine Learning Model for Detecting Cyberbullying on Twitter
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: One of the biggest issues facing the safe online community is the exposure of cyberbullying on social media, especially on Twitter. This work explores in depth how the Gated Recurrent Unit(GRU) method can be used to classify and identify cyberbullying content in Twitter datasets. The GRU algorithm can be used in an application to determine whether the given status updates can be classified as bullying or non-bullying with the help of patterns and rules. It is evaluated by testing its performance on the accuracy of risk information. The results show that the GRU algorithm performs well in automatically detecting cyberbullying cases, which is useful for the development of more robust social media management systems.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Cloud Computing and the Gig Economy Pricing Strategies
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Cloud computing services and gig economy platforms vary in flexibility, efficiency, and scalability due to their pricing schemes. Cloud computing services provide flexibility and cost control via pay-as-you-go, subscription, and freemium models. Like gig economy platforms, workers and customers pay for task completion, time-based contracts, and premium services. Assessing how successfully different pricing techniques fulfil varied demands, from short-term initiatives to long-term commitments, requires identifying their strengths and weaknesses. The goal is to evaluate these models' capacity to meet shifting demand, save money, and scale. The methodology also assesses cost predictability and company and consumer advantages of each pricing structure. The comparison seeks to improve resource allocation and financial planning by revealing how various pricing systems function in different circumstances. The research helps decision-makers use cloud services or gig economy platforms for different operational purposes by emphasizing their economic consequences. From datasets, simulated pricing model data was examined. The first example includes settings such as Hours Used (5–25), Pay-as-You-Go (10–50 USD), and Subscription-Based (30 USD). The second instance has Job Size (Resources) from 5 to 25, Freemium Model (USD) from 10 to 30, and Usage-Based Pricing (USD) from 10 to 50.

articleTitle: Smart Energy Management in Buildings with Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The use of machine learning techniques for developing intelligent energy management systems for buildings. Because of the growing emphasis placed on energy efficiency and sustainability, optimizing the amount of energy that is consumed in buildings has become an extremely important task. Tominimize energy waste and reduce operational expenses, smart energy management systems offer a viable alternative. These systems leverage advanced data analytics and automation to achieve their goals. Throughout the course of this research project, we investigate the possibility of incorporating machine learning algorithms into building energy management systems. These algorithms include neural networks, decision trees, and reinforcement learning. These algorithms examine past data on energy usage, weather trends, occupancy schedules, and building attributes to estimate energy demand, optimize HVAC (heating, ventilation, and air conditioning) operations, and intelligently schedule tasks that use a significant amount of energy. We demonstrate the efficacy of machine learning approaches through case studies and performance evaluations. These techniques are utilized to improve energy efficiency, reduce carbon emissions, and enhance occupant comfort in buildings. The findings of this study contribute to the development of intelligent energy management methods, which in turn paves the way for buildings that are more sustainable and kind to the environment.

articleTitle: Unified AI-Based Biometric Authentication: A Low-Power, High-Security Solution
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The rapid advancement of smart home technology has revolutionized the way we approach residential security. As traditional locking mechanisms become increasingly vulnerable to sophisticated attacks, the need for innovative and robust security solutions has never been greater. This paper introduces an advanced intelligent door lock system designed to meet the increasing demands for secure and efficient access control. The system integrates cutting-edge hardware components such as the ESP32 microcontroller, OLED display, Wi-Fi module, and specialized recognition devices including a fingerprint scanner, facial recognition camera, and voice recognition module. These components work in synergy to offer robust biometric authentication capabilities, enhancing both security and user convenience. The system's software architecture utilizes optimized algorithms for each biometric modality, ensuring reliable performance under varying environmental conditions. Central to its operation is the Unified Multimodal Biometric Integration Algorithm (UMBIA), which combines fingerprint, facial, and voice recognition data into a unified feature vector. This algorithm employs machine learning classifiers to evaluate the fused features against stored templates, ensuring high accuracy and adaptability. The proposed system represents a significant advancement in access control technology, promising enhanced security and seamless integration with smart home ecosystems.

articleTitle: Enhancing Brain Tumor Diagnosis Through Advanced Artificial Intelligence and Improved SITD Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Braintumors are among the most difficult to diagnose because of their nature and high fatality rates. This paperseeks to put forward an enhanced Artificial Intelligence-based model with better Supportive Intelligence for Tumor Detection (SITD) to facilitate brain tumor diagnosis. The proposed model focuses on the deep learning type of approaches for the classification of tumors and the estimation of the severity of the tumor through MRI images from BRATS and TCGA-GBM datasets. As feature extraction, it used convolutional neural networks (CNNs), and an adaptive learning strategy was incorporated for model updating. The system evaluated had an average accuracy of 96.8%, a recollection mean of 95.2%, a specificity mean of 97.5%, and a resistance percent over 98.1%. Pre-processing takes from 750ms to 1.8 sec per image, meaning that it can perform real-time clinical tasks. These results show that the proposed model performs better than the previous approaches. Therefore, the proposed SITD model is a powerful approach to brain tumor detection that improves patient results.

Author Keywords: Digital Imaging and Communications in Medicine

articleTitle: An Improved Poultry Farm Health Prediction System based on Artificial Intelligence Assisted Hybrid Deep Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Poultry production is a crucial factor in worldwide economic development, significantly enhancing human ecological resilience. It provides economical and easily obtainable protein supplies, including meat, eggs, and various by-products. Poultry farming not only provides nutritional advantages but also increases household income, strengthens food security, and contributes to poverty alleviation, so playing a crucial role in global economic progress. Poultry meat and eggs are in high demand due to the growing global population. Poultry disease management concurrently presents a critical problem, posing substantial risks to food security and economic stability. Utilizing advanced technology presents opportunities to develop techniques that enhance farm profitability while reducing environmental effects and promoting the welfare of animals and humans. This paper presents an Artificial Intelligence (AI) assisted method termed the Coccidiosis Disease Prediction Strategy (CDPS) for effectively assessing poultry farm health, which is cross-validated against the traditional learning model known as Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to evaluate the efficacy of the proposed approach. The experimental research demonstrates that novel technology solutions, particularly image processing and advanced deep learning, significantly surpass traditional manual inspection techniques in the early identification and warning of diseases in the chicken industry. These developments highlight their potential to transform poultry health administration and preventing illness.

articleTitle: NCCP: A Logical Development of Deep Learning Based Human Gender Classification System Using Neural Convolutional Classification Principles
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The most important component of a person's distinctive identification is their face. There are a lot of uses for facial recognition technology beyond just categorizing people; for example, it may be used for security concerns at banks, other organizations, and places with big public gatherings. With the meteoric rise of social media and platform usage, gender and age detection quickly sprang to the forefront. Attribute data, like gender and age, enhances face recognition accuracy. Background complexity, object occlusion, and lighting fluctuations make gender classification from facial images a difficult endeavor. Expression analysis, identification, and tracking are just a few of the many uses for face images. This paper presents a novel learning algorithm, the Neural Convolutional Classification Principle (NCCP), for determining a person's gender from their facial features. To test how well the NCCP works, it is cross-validated with the more traditional Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model. The efficacy of the two models in classifying faces as male or female was tested experimentally. Both approaches were found to be successful for gender categorization, according to the results. In addition, a comparison was made between these two models and a few well-known gender categorization techniques.

articleTitle: Augmenting Security Systems with Sign Language Recognition Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Sign language is the ancient way of communication which was found before the vocal communication. It bridges the gap between people who are deaf and it overcome the barrier of language difference. Many people learn sign languages as they express themselves through hand movements and facial expressions in absent of spoken communication. The current security CCTV cameras with manual security is not efficient in critical situation, this novel approach overcome the limitation and immediately send assistance. If any distressing situation occurs in absent of vocal communication, how can a person seek help orescape the situation is still in dispute. To elucidate, this security assessment will help people in those critical cenarios. When a person shows help sign in the camera, the backend mechanism in the camera will detect and sends security alert to the registered emergency contacts. This can be implemented in public cameras for security purpose. Furthermore, it will be a great aid to women in any unexpected situation. This suggested mechanism emphasis the automated meta data such as the image captured by the camera. The Deep learning model implemented can be an effective mechanism in terms of risk assessment and security exclusive for deaf and dumb people. This study can further improve in future by detection of emotion along with the handgesture can increase the novelty of the gesture that is the real emergency and reduce people tampering the system for amusement.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Kidney Disease Prediction and Diagnosis using Machine Learning Strategies
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: With the advent of AI and machine learning (ML), clinical medicine has undergone a sea change, opening up new possibilities for advancements in both practice and research. The present state and future possibilities of using ML and Deep Learning (DL) to chronic kidney disease (CKD) are examined in this narrative review. Some examples that highlight the substantial importance of ML-diagnostic strategies are the rapid discovery of renal illness and the following prompt treatment of the condition. Predicting the onset of chronic kidney disease (CKD) using DL is an emerging area of research that seeks to equip doctors with AI-powered tools. A number of studies have attempted to compare and contrast various ML approaches in terms of their practicality, efficacy, and feasibility. One obvious limitation, though, has always been the absence of a comprehensive review of this material. So, this research familiarizes two contexts—one for ML-strategies, which classifies distinct essentials of kidney-disease-diagnosis(KDD), and another for medical sub-fields connected to DL—and provides a thorough literature evaluation of ML and DL utilizations in KDD. Also mentioned are areas where research is lacking and potential avenues for further investigation.

articleTitle: Fast and Accurate Community Detection in Social Media Networks with a Multi-Algorithmic Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Community detection is an essential technique for uncovering structural patterns in complex networks, such as social, biological, and information networks. In this paper to explore a hybrid approach to community detection by combining the label propagation algorithm and leiden algorithm. Although LPA is well known for its computational effectiveness in large- scale networks, because of its reliance on local label propagation, it frequently results in unstable and fractured communities. High- quality community structures are produced by the Leiden algorithm, which is more computationally expensive than the Louvain method but ensures well-connected communities by optimising modularity. Our goal in combining these two approaches is to take use of LPA's speed for quick community discovery and the Leiden algorithm's refinement powers for increased accuracy and stability. Large or dynamic networks where both real-time speed and community quality are crucial are best suited for the suggested hybrid method. The combination of these algorithms yields more cohesive and modular communities than either one working alone, as evidenced by experimental results on synthetic social network data. The method is a useful tool for large- scale network analysis because it strikes a balance between the necessity for strong and significant community structures and computational efficiency.

articleTitle: CollabStudy: A Comprehensive Platform for Focus, Productivity and Collaboration
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Students often struggle to stay focused and organized while preparing for exams due to the use of multiple applications for studying, communication, and resource sharing. This fragmented approach often leads to distractions, decreased productivity, and a lack of well devised study plans. CollabStudy addresses these challenges by providing an all-in-one platform designed to streamline and enhance the study experience. By integrating essential tools such as video and audio calls, chat, a whiteboard, and file sharing into a single environment, CollabStudy ensures seamless collaboration and efficient communication among students. AI-driven features like personalized study plans, note summaries, and learning recommendations offer tailored support, helping students maximize their study efforts. Focus Mode further enhances productivity by preventing tab switching, controlling notifications, and offering Pomodoro timers to maintain concentration. With AI functionalities, CollabStudy delivers intelligent study planners and interactive PDF tools, fostering a more effective study routine. The platform also includes a streak system to encourage consistent study habits, rewarding students for staying on track. CollabStudy creates an optimized, distraction-free study environment that meets the needs of modern students, promoting better organization, collaboration, and focus throughout their exam preparation journey.

articleTitle: An Improved Bat Optimization Algorithm for Knowledge Discovery for Routing and Energy Efficiency in the Internet of Things Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: An improved optimization algorithm, IBA, enhances routing and energy efficiency in IoT environments. As energy conservation becomes increasingly vital in our technological landscape, managing resource consumption is crucial for sustainability. The Internet of Things (IoT) has revolutionized connectivity, enabling diverse applications across various sectors, from smart homes to industrial systems. The impending 5G technology promises to accelerate this transformation further, offering unprecedented speed and coverage. However, with the exponential growth in mobile data transmission, network operators face the challenge of meeting escalating demands. Bio-inspired optimization techniques, like the Bat Algorithm (BA), have emerged as promising solutions due to their computational efficiency and applicability to IoT challenges. The proposed IBA builds upon BA principles, introducing novel enhancements to address specific limitations. Through methodical testing, IBA shows better results in packet delivery ratio, network throughput, energy efficiency, average delay, and routing overhead than current protocols. These findings highlight the capability of optimized algorithms to improve IoT system performance and address changing application needs.

articleTitle: AI in Emergency Responses: Distress & Lie Detection Using Audio & EEG
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The paper contributes findings toward the development of an artificial intelligence system that might be able to, in real-time, detect instances of dishonesty via facial expression analysis and audio spectrograms and EEG data. It uses through the Random Forest classifier applied on the process of processing EEG data analysis a process identifying the brain patterns related to dishonest conduct. The approach used is Faster R-CNN, which is a term for Region-Based Convolutional Neural Network, to detect and classify the micro expressions efficiently and accurately, in facial emotion analysis. These may possibly be the signs of not telling the truth about the person. More so, spectrograms will be utilized by the audio model in finding the stresses, speech, and tone levels in extracting vocal features associated with dishonesty. The same is achieved in making the identification of these features easy. Putting the EEG, facial expressions, and audio modalities together offer a holistic approach to the detection of falsification. This is only possible by this integration of information across the auditory, behavioral, and physiological domains. Although the system is very effective to be used in the critical event management, security, and law enforcement because of its capability to successfully detect dishonesty with data coming from varied sources, for one, it has the capability to effectively detect dishonesty. The system enables automatic report generation as well as the displaying of real-time deception possibilities. It is built to be useful in situations that include different languages and numerous contexts so as to better enhance the processes involved in decision-making.

articleTitle: Advancing Human-Computer Interaction: Real-Time Gesture Recognition and Language Generation Using CNN-LSTM Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Efficient human-computer interaction (HCI) has pushed forward hand gesture recognition (HGR), and natural language utterance generation (NLUG). Traditional systems are limited because these rely on static infrastructure and manual processing, accompanied by inaccuracies and latency. In comparison, the proposed system uses an advanced fusion of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for gesture recognition and long short-term memory (LSTM) networks for language generation to achieve real-time processing with context-aware responses. The results of the experiments showed a 90.5% increase in precision for gesture recognition and BLEU score 0,715 NLUG were described as displaying superiority to existing systems on the tool performance The proposed approach also reduces the latency to 90 ms, while in traditional systems it is about 150 ms. These results suggest an opportunity to reimagine HCI systems as truly immersive and efficient, responsive experiences that can optimize not only user interactions with applications in specific domains, but also social computing at large.

articleTitle: StudentsConnect: A Web Application to Track Library Permissions and Leave Requests in Hostels Using MERN
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This study focuses on developing “StudentsConnect,” a web-based hostel management system, as a solution to the inefficiencies faced by students when obtaining library permissions and submitting leave forms through traditional administrative channels. Currently, hostel administrations rely heavily on manual approvals and paper-based documentation, which often result in delays, administrative overload, and data mismanagement. Existing research on digital solutions for educational administration primarily addresses classroom and academic management, leaving a gap in real-time hostel and library permissions systems tailored for hostel setting. This research aims to bridge that gap by providing a digital solution that not only simplifies permission workflows but also enhances student independence and administrator productivity. By developing StudentsConnect using the MERN (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js) stack, this study leverages real-time data handling and a user-centric design to reduce the processing time of student requests. The methodology includes designing, implementing, and testing the platform in a controlled hostel environment to evaluate its impact on student satisfaction and administrative efficiency. The StudentsConnect significantly improves the responsiveness of hostel administration, reduces request handling times by 90% and increases the efficiency of permission management by 85%. These results demonstrate the potential of digital management solutions in transforming hostel administration by promoting operational efficiency and enhancing the student experience

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Analysis of Image Processing Methods for Agricultural Product Quality Control
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In the post-harvest stages of agricultural products, labor shortages and poor-quality control lead to significant market losses. The automated industries for agricultural products that use machine learning are evolving, with a recent focus on deep learning (DL). Computer vision (CV) serves as an essential part in the automation method for fruits and vegetables, where image processing (IP) ensures proper product categorization, addressing the issue of product loss. This paper focuses on IP techniques in sequential procedures, which can improve efficiency and precision in agricultural product sorting and grading. Deep neural networks and algorithms are effective because they achieve high classification accuracy with a low loss percentage.

articleTitle: Real-Time Wildlife Tracking and Anomaly Detection Using YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Wildlife monitoring and conservation have become crucial as human activities increasingly encroach on natural habitats. Automated animal detection systems offer valuable support in addressing this challenge. This project aims to develop a real-time animal detection system using a Laptop Processing Unit and curated datasets. The primary goal is to provide a cost-effective and accessible tool for researchers, conservationists, and wildlife enthusiasts to track and study animal populations in their natural habitats. By leveraging images captured from cameras in the wild or controlled settings, the system can identify and categorize various animal species. The project utilizes diverse datasets containing images of both wildlife and domestic animals, which are preprocessed to extract relevant features and labels. These datasets enable the training of machine learning models optimized for the limited computational resources of the Laptop Processing Unit. This research aims to create a system that is both efficient and affordable, with significant applications in wildlife conservation, animal monitoring, and even agricultural management. A key feature of the system is its ability to detect potential security breaches, unauthorized access, and other anomalies in the monitored area. When such a threat is identified, an alert system, such as a buzzer, is activated.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence-Enhanced Health Monitoring System via with Disease Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Internationally, coronary infection is the main source of mortality. This technique's results incorporate the capacity to anticipate earlier cardiovascular illness. The task utilizes an Arduino to control an IOT sensor (a heartbeat sensor to screen beat), and the outcomes might be seen on a successive screen. The therapeutic parameters that are also used for information preparation and testing are used to categorise the datasets. This approach uses the information preparation order technique to evaluate those parameters. with the aid of categorization and AI computations. The dataset is first separated, inspected, and screened. The data that is then accumulated is then handled in Python programming utilizing AI calculations, to be specific Choice Tree and Arbitrary Boondocks Classifier calculations. Concerning exactness, SVM (Backing Vector Machine) delivers improved results when used to analyze coronary illness. It is consequently shown that the recommended system is a solid one for foreseeing cardiovascular sickness previously. The proposed equipment and programming arrangement helps patients in the early identification of heart illness.

articleTitle: Advanced Wheelchair and Robotic Assistance Technologies Utilizing Autonomous Robotics for Individuals with Disabilities
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The advancement of autonomous robotics in assistive technologies holds significant potential for enhancing mobility and independence among individuals with disabilities. This study investigates the development of an advanced wheelchair and robotic assistance system utilizing autonomous robotics to enhance mobility and independence for individuals with disabilities. Key components include integrated sensors, mobility systems, and user interfaces, designed to provide robust environmental awareness, adaptive navigation, and high user satisfaction. Sensor integration, using LIDAR, ultrasonic, infrared, and cameras, achieved an obstacle detection accuracy of up to 99%, with combined sensor systems maintaining a reliability rate of 97% even in low-light conditions. The mobility components demonstrated optimal performance on indoor and smooth outdoor terrains, with an average terrain adaptability of 92%. User interface options, such as joysticks and touchscreens, scored 98% and 96% in command accuracy, respectively, while safety testing yielded an emergency stop response time averaging 85 milliseconds. Compliance with ADA standards confirmed, with the device achieving a collision avoidance accuracy of 98% in standard indoor settings. These results highlight the device's capacity to meet varied mobility needs, though further development in rugged terrain adaptability and low-light sensor functionality could optimize usability.

articleTitle: Identification of Factors that Influencing the New Product Development Time in Electric Vehicle (EV) Bus Manufacturers
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In the bus manufacturing industry, it is essential to implement effective new product development (NPD) strategies in order to remain competitive in the swiftly expanding electric vehicle (EV) market. This article investigates the primary factors that influence the time required to produce electric buses, including technical advancements, supply chain efficiency, regulatory compliance, and market dynamics. This paper employs both qualitative and quantitative research methods to investigate the relationship between these elements and their impact on the NPD timeline. The results provide insight into potential strategies that producers could implement to enhance their time-to-market objectives, decrease lead times, and optimize their development processes.

articleTitle: Experimental Analysis of Plant Disease Identification Methodology Based on Improved Classification and Deep Learning Principle
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The agriculture industry is essential for providing excellent food and significantly contributes to the growth of economies and people. Plant diseases can result in substantial reductions in food output and diminish species diversity. The prompt identification of plant diseases by precise or automated detection methods can improve food production quality and save economic losses. In recent years, deep learning has significantly enhanced the identification accuracy of image categorization and object detection systems. In this paper, a novel method termed Learning Enabled Disease Detection Logic (LDDL) is introduced for the efficient identification of plant diseases, which is cross-validated against the traditional Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to assess the efficacy of the proposed scheme. The report delineates the specific crop illnesses addressed, the models utilized, the data sources referenced, and the overall efficacy as measured by the performance criteria applied in each study for plant disease diagnosis. The findings demonstrate that the proposed model, LDDL, achieves superior accuracy compared to prevalent illness detection methods and identifies the primary parameters influencing the efficacy of deep learning-based tools. The research offers significant insights for researchers, practitioners, and industry professionals in plant disease detection by addressing challenges and limitations, presenting a thorough understanding of the current research landscape, elucidating the advantages and drawbacks of various methods, and suggesting potential solutions to facilitate their implementation.

articleTitle: Experimental Analysis of an Efficient Dental Carries Prediction System Based on Improved Convolutional Neural Network (iCNN) Principle
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Dental caries is a kind of infectious illness that weakens the structure of teeth, leading to cavities. Because of the discomfort and expense of treatment, studies on dental caries have focused on early diagnosis, as it is one of the most common oral health problems. Due to the high costs and lengthy research times associated with oral healthcare, artificial intelligence has recently been employed to create models that can forecast the likelihood of dental caries. The agony and expensive price of therapy have prompted this investigation toward early detection. Models that may forecast the possibility of dental caries have recently been developed using artificial intelligence. This is in response to the high expenditures and significant time commitments connected with medical research in oral healthcare. In this study, a new method for efficiently identifying dental caries is presented using an Improved Convolutional Neural Network (iCNN). To test how well the suggested scheme works, it is cross-validated with the standard method called Support Vector Machine (SVM). This paper's suggested method, iCNN, demonstrates that dental practitioners may greatly benefit from deep learning to aid in the early diagnosis and treatment of dental caries.

articleTitle: ResQ – Intelligent Real-Time Disaster Management Using Machine Learning and IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The project, therefore, is to be a ResQ using deep learning capabilities for an enhanced response and coordination in cases of disaster. The best sources of real-time data on the weather services, government alerts, and user reports then integrate into critical updates and predictions during a disaster. The ResQ has such as features: real-time alerts, access to emergency contact information, route optimization evacuation, resource mapping, user-generated incident reports, first aid tips, offline functionality, volunteer coordination, and multi-language support. Deep learning algorithms in fact enhance predicting capabilities and thereby improve better management of disasters and effective allocation of resources. It is a means through which the effects of disasters will be reduced, rationalizing rescue procedures and saving more lives in the long term.

articleTitle: Evaluating the Impact of Federated Learning and Blockchain Integration on Work-from-Home Efficiency and Work-Life Balance in Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The current development in the IT sector is revolutionized by remote work that emphasizes the importance of safe collaboration processes. It aims to establish how federated learning (FL) and blockchain systems can overcome data privacy and work-from-home (WFH) productivity limitations. In the decentralized FL model incorporating a blockchain validation approach, the data will remain intact and communicate a minimal overhead. Key findings include a highly enhanced model performance with a success rate of 88.3 % the time taken for training with 44 minutes only, and a work-life balance score of 8.5 higher than previous WFH frameworks. The blockchain integration provided 99.8% data security and little impact on latency and power to authenticate model updates across nodes. These outcomes confirm that FL can enhance the FL and blockchain integration in remote IT structures while motivating employee performance and reducing stress levels. The proposed framework establishes a sound solution for the security and effectiveness of WFH operations regarding productivity and privacy while being portable for different organizational perspectives.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Deep Learning Algorithm for Improved ChatBot Accuracy and Relevance Through Advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This research presents the Hybrid Retrieval-Augmented Transformer Network (HRATN), a cutting-edge deep learning algorithm crafted to significantly elevate the performance of ChatBots through an innovative approach to Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). The HRATN framework addresses several limitations inherent in conventional RAG models by seamlessly integrating a sophisticated retrieval mechanism with advanced generative transformer architecture, thereby enhancing both the accuracy of information retrieval and the coherence of the generated responses. The core of the HRATN model features a dense vector-based retrieval system that adeptly extracts relevant information from an expansive knowledge base, which is then fused with a transformer network equipped with advanced attention mechanisms to optimize response generation. A notable innovation in HRATN is its hybrid fusion layer, which effectively combines retrieved data with the outputs of the generative model to deliver responses that are not only more precise but also contextually more relevant. To assess the efficacy of HRATN, extensive experiments were carried out, comparing its performance against leading RAG models in standings of response correctness, relevance, and computational effectiveness. The results underscore that HRATN markedly enhances both the accuracy and relevance of responses while maintaining superior computational performance. This research underscores the potential of HRATN to make significant advancements in conversational AI, by equipping ChatBots with enhanced capabilities for providing more reliable and context-aware interactions, thus making a meaningful contribution to the broader fields of artificial intelligence and human-computer interaction.

articleTitle: INN: Experimental Evaluation of Machine Learning Based Obesity and Overweight Prediction Using Intensive Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Obesity and overweight are significant public health concerns worldwide, contributing to a range of chronic diseases, including cardiovascular disease, diabetes, and certain cancers. This study presents an advanced predictive model for obesity and overweight detection using an Intensive Neural Network (INN) integrated with Support Vector Machine (SVM). The model is designed to address the complex, non-linear relationships between various factors contributing to obesity, such as age, gender, height, weight, BMI, physical activity levels, dietary habits, and genetic factors. A dataset consisting of 28,765 manually collected data points was used to train and validate the model. Through meticulous data preprocessing, including handling missing values, noise reduction, feature scaling, and feature selection, the data was prepared for optimal model performance. The proposed INN + SVM model achieved an outstanding accuracy of 94.76%, outperforming nine existing models, including Convolutional Neural Network (90.47%) and Deep Neural Network (89.12%). Additional metrics such as Precision (93.22%), Recall (92.88%), and F1-Score (93.05%) further validate the model's superiority. The integration of SVM with INN enhances the model's ability to classify difficult cases, resulting in a robust and reliable tool for predicting obesity and overweight conditions. The results suggest that this hybrid approach holds significant potential for improving early detection and intervention strategies in healthcare.

articleTitle: Optimized Predictive Storage Resource Allocation Through Neural Forecasting for Cloud Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The demand for efficient and scalable management of storage resources is growing enormously with the rapid growth in data-intensive applications within the cloud environment. Optimized PSRANF is the state-of-the-art approach towards dynamic storage resource allocation, based on the forecast of future demands in storage. PSRANF utilizes state-of-the-art neural forecasting with Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks and Transformer designs to analyze the pattern of historical storage usage for highly accurate future need predictions. By proactively adjusting storage capacity to these predictions, PSRANF strikes an optimal balance between performance and cost by reserving just-in-time resources. It ensures that there is no risk of over-provisioning, which would be too costly. In the same breath, the risk of under-provisioning, which leads to performance bottlenecks, is avoided. What is more, the system will apply prioritization, placing the data of higher priority or frequently accessed data into faster storage tiers of a higher class of performance and less important classes of data into cost-effective storage. The adaptive feedback loop continuously refines the forecasting model, which, over time, improves accuracy and allows the system to handle changes in workload patterns. PSRANF combines neural forecasting with resource allocation in such a way that is cost-effective; thus, it is very well placed for cloud environments where the demand for storage is dynamic in nature and requires intelligent data-driven approaches. The AWS implementation of PSRANF has turned out to be quite a helpful tool in optimizing the storage resource allocation process. While it is able to predict 98.5% of the storage needs correctly by achieving a cost saving of up to 18.7<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>, managing data from 97.8% to 99.2%, and resources from 95.4%, it's robust for improvements in cloud storage management and operational efficiency.

articleTitle: A Cost Effective Methodology to Control Robotic Movements Based on Mobile Application and IoT Enabled Controller
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In this study, we present a cost-effective methodology for controlling robotic movements using a mobile application and an IoT-enabled controller. Our system utilizes an ESP8266 microcontroller, various sensors, and a mobile app to communicate commands to the robot via Wi-Fi and Bluetooth. The system's performance was evaluated based on key parameters, including response time, movement accuracy, energy consumption, and wireless communication stability. The response time for Wi-Fi ranged from 50ms at 1 meter to 240ms at 45 meters, while Bluetooth achieved faster response times of 30ms to 240ms over the same distances. Movement accuracy tests showed minimal deviation on smooth surfaces, with deviations as low as 1.0 cm, but higher errors on uneven terrain and grass, reaching up to 5.0 cm during complex movements. Bluetooth showed a power efficiency advantage, consuming 30-40% less power than Wi-Fi. Signal strength for Bluetooth remained stable up to 25 meters, while Wi-Fi was more reliable for longer distances but exhibited degraded performance beyond 30 meters. The total system cost was kept under USD 50, demonstrating its affordability for educational and industrial applications. This project successfully achieved its goal of creating a low-cost, efficient, and responsive robotic control system.

articleTitle: BOTika: A Pharmaceutical Management System Using Seasonal Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average (SARIMA) and Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This study introduces “BOTika: A Pharmaceutical Management System,” which incorporates the Seasonal Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average (SARIMA) model and a Clustering Algorithm to tackle significant challenges faced by small and medium-sized pharmacies in Metro Manila. BOTika is designed to streamline and enhance pharmaceutical operations, focusing on areas such as inventory control, sales monitoring, profit evaluation, and medication management. Its primary goal is to improve efficiency in pharmacy operations, particularly through predictive analytics powered by the SARIMA model. The system also uses a Retrieval Report Algorithm for data retrieval and Statistical Analytics for data interpretation. Additionally, a Clustering Algorithm is employed to group medicines by key characteristics, enabling targeted discounts and promotions. The system's interface, developed as a Progressive Web App (PWA), allows administrators to manage operations seamlessly, while customers benefit from a pre-order feature. Results demonstrate that the SARIMA model provides accurate demand forecasts, leading to better decision-making in pharmacy management. Ultimately, the project aims to modernize pharmacy operations, enhance customer experience, and support the sector's growth, contributing to both sustainable practices and economic progress in the region.

articleTitle: AI-Enhanced Emotion Recognition through Galvanic Skin Response and ECG Analysis for Improved Accuracy and Reliability
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Traditional methods of emotion detection, including the problem of recognizing seven basic emotions, have issues such as occlusion, noise, and self-reporting. Besides text mining there are voices, facial and gesture recognition algorithms as well. The indicated acoustics-based difficulties are resolved in the proposed system by employing the previously mentioned signals - less forgery and interferences for ECG and GSR. When noise from signals is removed, characteristic properties such as pace fluctuation and skin conductance are obtained. All of these features are organized using modern machine learning models such as Support Vector Machines (SVM) and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN). Measurements of labelled datasets are utilized to verify the system's accuracy levels, and better performance is reported in the dimension of emotion identification resilience. The proposed methodology in this research is more accurate than other existing systems, with an accuracy rate of 90%, recall rate of 88 percent, and F1-Score of 87.5%. Similar to feature metrics, the level of accuracy for particular parameters has improved. HCl technology will improve learning and mental health features such as recognition, emotion, and social interaction. The established goal of physiological ones is to serve as a solid and steady foundation for identifying emotions.

articleTitle: Leveraging Artificial Intelligence to Address Domestic Violence Against Women with Disabilities in India
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Women who have impairments frequently confront compounded vulnerabilities, which makes them more prone to domestic violence and less willing to accept acceptable support. This article investigates how artificial intelligence technology can improve discovery, prevention, and intervention tactics. Artificial intelligence canrecognize patterns of abuse and forecast high-risk situations by analyzing data from a wide variety of sources, such as social services, healthcare providers, and judicial systems. The research highlights the emergence of AI-driven tools such as mobile operations for reporting abuse, virtual sidekicks for providing information and support, and predictive analytics to assist law enforcement and social services. These tools are similar to mobile operations reported by abuse victims. It is also addressed in the study that ethical considerations, such as sequestration and data security, are taken into account, and it is emphasized that the implementation of AI is respectful of the rights and quality of women who have impairments. The findings indicate that artificial intelligence has the potential to play a significant role in the process of making the environment safer for these women, which will ultimately lead to a society that is more accepting and uncaring.

articleTitle: Empirical Evaluation of AI Based Oral Cancer Identification Scheme Using Learning Assisted Medical Image Processing Scheme
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Early detection is essential for enhancing patient outcomes, as oral cancer continues to be a substantial health challenge. This manuscript introduces the Optimized Neural Learning and Classification Principle (ONLCP), a novel AI-based oral cancer identification scheme that incorporates medical image processing techniques and deep learning. Our method utilizes smart to analyze and classify medical images, thereby enabling the early detection of oral cancer. The efficiency of the proposed scheme is assessed by cross-validating it with the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). The model is refined by this AI-based logic, which adapts to a variety of image characteristics and improves detection precision, while the ONLCP is employed for feature extraction and initial classification of oral lesions. The experimental results indicate that the AI-based scheme ONLCP obtains a prediction accuracy of 97.86%, with substantial enhancements in sensitivity and specificity when contrasted with conventional methods. The model's continuous development and adaptive learning are enabled by the integration of learning-assisted techniques, resulting in more precise and dependable cancer identification. Our results emphasize the potential of integrating AI with advanced image processing techniques to resolve critical challenges in medical diagnostics. This research has the potential to improve patient care and treatment outcomes by contributing to the growth of more efficient and scalable techniques to early oral cancer identification.

articleTitle: Cognitive Computing in Customer Service Automation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The application of cognitive computing is revolutionizing the automation of customer service by utilizing cutting-edge artificial intelligence technology to improve interactions with customers. An investigation into the incorporation of cognitive computing into customer service platforms is presented in this research study. The paper focuses on the impact that this integration has on efficiency, personalization, and overall service quality. The study investigates how cognitive tools, like as natural language processing, machine learning, and sentiment analysis, automate mundane processes, deliver intelligent responses, and adapt to the specific requirements of individual customers. This is accomplished through a comprehensive investigation of existing technologies. Cognitive computing is beneficial in lowering operational costs, improving response times, and boosting customer happiness, as demonstrated by case studies and empirical data. The findings highlight the potential for cognitive computing to improve customer service by providing more dynamic and intuitive solutions compared to the standard automation methods currently in use. Towards the end of the study, recommendations are provided for the implementation of cognitive computing methods in customer service. These recommendations emphasize the necessity of ongoing innovation and adaptability to the ever-changing demands of customers.

articleTitle: Integrating Predictive Analytics and Deep Learning for Vehicle Safety Incident Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Forecasting vehicle safety incidents is an important step towards improving road safety and reducing accidents. Rule-based systems, which often rely on historical data, can be inflexible and reactive, resulting in high false positive rates and poor accuracy. It presents an integrated predictive system that combines with Deep Learning using CNN and LSTM analysis of multimodal data channels (Traffic images, Weather reports, Vehicle sensor signals). The hybrid architecture incorporates spatial and temporal dynamics, achieving a mean prediction accuracy of 92 % and lowering the false positive rate to 10%. It is important to highlight that results show significant improvements over state-of-the-art systems with 89% precision and 85% recall. The model allows safety management in real-time so that authorities can intervene before an accident happens. By creating a shift from reactive to proactive, the new way of forecasting incidents also makes for improved road safety and ultimately saves lives through timely interventions.

articleTitle: DCVCP: Experimental Evaluation of Leukaemia Disease Prediction Using Deep Convoluted Vector Classification Principle
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: A wide variety of cancers, including skin, breast, lung, and blood malignancies such as lymphoma and leukemia, are defined by the uncontrolled growth of cells within the body. Acquired lymphoblastic leukemia is among the most prominent cancers. Blood cancer diagnoses are notoriously time-consuming because hematologists often make mistakes. With the use of cutting-edge tools like Deep Learning and Machine Learning, this study considers a fresh approach to leukemia classification. The precise diagnosis of blood cancer is a crucial medical process, but it is also one of the most costly and challenging for clinical staff to do. Blood cancer is one of many severe forms of the disease. The devastating and deadly blood cancers, lymphoma and leukemia, impact people of all ages and genders, and they are a leading cause of other illnesses and an elevated survival rate. Damage to and an increase in immature monocytes, neutrophils, eosinophils, and lymphocytes are hallmarks of both leukemia and lymphoma. Predicting and treating blood cancer early is crucial for improving survival rates in the health industry. These days, a number of manual methods exist for analyzing and predicting blood cancer based on microscopic medical reports of white blood cell images; this method is both reliable and deadly. It takes a lot of time and effort to manually forecast and analyze eosinophils, lymphocytes, monocytes, and neutrophils. The Deep Convoluted Vector Classification Principle (DCVCP) is a new deep learning technique for leukemia illness detection that was described in this study. To test how well it works, it was cross-validated with the current method, the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). findings from this study show that DCVCP can effectively leverage data from network sensors to identify blood cancer, which might lead to faster findings and lower costs in clinical settings.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based Intrusion Detection System with Integration of Blockchain Technology and Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The number of people and objects linked to the Internet of Things (IoT) has expanded dramatically due to its fast development, giving consumers more opportunities to interact with and manage their physical surroundings. IoT is susceptible to a number of security risks, because of its openness, connectedness, and constrained device resources. It is essential to guarantee the dependability and security of data transmitted in IoT networks. In order to solve these security problems, this work provides intrusion detection system that combines IoT with and Blockchain technology. As well as, deep learning method is integrated to improve the security. This work uses the SHA-256 algorithm to secure the data, the Adaptive Optimization algorithm for generating the keys, Rivest, Shamir, and Adleman (RSA) algorithm for encryption. and Deep Neural Network (DNN) for identifying intrusions in Internet of Things. Through identification and mitigation of possible risks, this framework successfully protects IoT networks and ensures the integrity of communications, as demonstrated by a comparison analysis with existing models.

articleTitle: Enhanced Framework for MRI Brain Tumor Recognition with Residual Learning and Intuitive Heatmap Visualization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Early detection of brain tumors is crucial for effective treatment, yet it poses a significant challenge due to the rapid nature of the disease's progression. This study explores the application of ResNet, aimed at improving the accuracy of brain tumor diagnosis in magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scans. Our model was trained on a dataset comprising 253 MRI images, which included 155 confirmed cases of tumors. The residual learning framework of ResNet effectively captures intricate features and mitigates issues such as vanishing gradients. The results indicate that the ResNet model achieved an impressive accuracy rate of 97%, surpassing traditional detection methods. We evaluated the model's performance using metrics like accuracy and F1-score, demonstrating its robustness. To improve the interpretability of our model's predictions, we utilized Grad-CAM (Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping), which highlighted critical areas in the MRI scans that influenced the model's decisions. Our findings confirm ResNet’ s effectiveness in medical imaging and stress the importance of model interpretability in healthcare, allowing radiologists to make informed diagnostic choices.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Impact of Green Marketing on Consumer Behavior Using Machine Learning with SVM-Based Sentiment Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The effects of green marketing on consumers utilizing machine learning methodologies, with a focus on the SVM for sentiment classification. The increased concern for sustainability and environment-friendly production has put pressure on producers to market their products well. In addition, it proposed SVM model had an 84.6% accuracy, a sentiment divergence of 0.12, and the time taken to process each instance was 3.2ms. The model also demonstrated performance improvements over baseline models: Naïve Bayes had 76.3% accuracy, Random Forest 79.7%, and Neural Network (LSTM) 82.1%. Furthermore, the model was accurate for positive sentiment at 87.5% recall at 89.2%, and implementing an F1-Score of 88.3%. Contrary to other methods of analysis, the model appreciates the complexity of consumer attitudes toward green marketing strategies. Examining how the self-identity of environmentalism has penetrated various aspects of consumers' lives, it makes a useful contribution to practice for firms seeking to target environmentalists effectively in the hope of developing better marketing messages and improving their relationships with this important group in the name of sustainable market practice.

articleTitle: Enhancing Vehicle Safety: A Comprehensive Approach to Accident Prevention Through Alcohol Detection and Ignition Control
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This paper aims to enhance vehicle safety by implementing an alcohol detection method to prevent accidents caused by driving under the influence. The approach involves integrating an MQ-3 alcohol sensor with a microcontroller, specifically an Arduino board. The MQ-3 sensor is employed to detect alcohol content in human breath, functioning within a fine sensitivity range of approximately 2 meters. The prototype includes an ignition system that simulates spark plug activation, serving as an ignition starter for the vehicle's engine. The ignition system's operation is contingent on the detected blood alcohol content (BAC) from human breaths as sensed by the alcohol sensor. The Arduino board facilitates the seamless integration of the alcohol sensor and offers expanded functionality compared to conventional microcontrollers. Notably, the compact size of the MQ-3 sensor allows for discreet installation within any vehicle, contributing to the device's adaptability. Emphasizing safety, the device is designed to safeguard individuals inside the vehicle, making it a valuable preventive measure against the risks associated with driving under the influence of alcohol.

articleTitle: A Novel Machine Learning-Enhanced Swarm Intelligence Algorithm for Cost-Effective Cloud Load Balancing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Cloud computing refers to the instant accessibility of shared computer resources over the internet on-demand, thereby revolutionizing the way organizations deploy and manage their IT infrastructure. Efficient load balancing in a cloud environment scales up, utilizing resources with optimized cost-effectiveness. This paper introduces a new Machine Learning-guided Improved Swarm Intelligence Algorithm for reliable load balancing in cloud computing. Methodology It spans on three main elements. The first is the data center controller for the management of tasks. VM allocation uses an Improved Beetle Swarm Optimization Algorithm and one-dimensional convolutional probabilistic neural network is used for host load prediction. To propose an approach that looks to optimize the key metrics such as make span, average cost of VM, resource utilization, and value response time through iterative optimization process. The results of the experiments reflect the success of the proposed algorithm, because an improved performance of load balancing is obtained in comparison with those achieved using PSO, Grey Wolf Optimization, and Genetic Algorithm. The convergence diagram displays the iterative optimization process achieved by the proposed algorithm in obtaining a balance among various performance metrics. Overall, the methodology proposed in this work will provide promising facilitation in the increased efficiency, scalability, and cost-effectiveness of environments based on cloud computing with a reliable load balancing.

articleTitle: Diversified Grid Optimization Model to Handle Fast Charging Provision of Electric Vehicles Using Artificial Intelligence (AI) Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The transportation industry is taking a giant leap forward towards a dependable, carbon-neutral future thanks to electric vehicles (EVs). The growing number of electric vehicles on the road is putting a strain on power networks and electrical grids caused by dispersed energy resources, particularly the EVI's demands for charging and discharging. Without proper coordination of charging and discharging, the already overburdened power distribution system would struggle to handle the large number of electric vehicles on the road. To get more people to use scheduling programs, electric vehicle owners can use dynamic pricing, a kind of demand response. Studying the timing of electric vehicle charging and discharging as well as its dynamic pricing model is, hence, crucial. There has been a lot of study on scheduling and demand forecasting models for electric vehicle charging that employ artificial intelligence, with many academics claiming that AI approaches outperform more traditional optimization techniques. The Diversified Grid Optimization Model (DGOM) is a novel method for optimizing charging facilities that aims to provide fast and efficient charging. To test its efficacy, it is cross-validated with the Dynamic Vehicle Charging Model (DVCM), a traditional charging scheme. The investigations pertaining to electric vehicle charging and discharging are categorized into scheduling, pricing, and forecasting in this paper's experimental analysis. This work finds the missing pieces of the puzzle when it comes to dynamic pricing models and EV discharge scheduling by establishing the connection between forecasting, scheduling, and pricing mechanisms.

articleTitle: Automated Pest Detection in Crop Fields Using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: When it comes to discovering and eliminating pests, traditional methods are typically laborious, time-consuming, and hazardous to the environment. In recent years, deep literacy methods have emerged as interesting and potentially useful technologies for automating the finding of pests in agricultural fields. The purpose of this work is to provide a detailed evaluation of the operation of deep literacy methods in automated pest discovery. These methods include a variety of characteristics such as image processing, point birth, and bracket algorithms. In this paper, we discuss the difficulties and opportunities that are involved with the implementation of deep literacy-based pest discovery systems. These problems and opportunities include dataset reflection, model training, and scalability. In addition to this, we highlight recent developments, case stories, and new exploration directions in this rapidly developing field. Automated pest discovery systems have the potential to enhance agricultural operations by utilizing the powers of deep literacy. This would allow for the prompt and precise identification of pests, which would be necessary for the development of effective pest management techniques. Cutting-edge technology Within the scope of this investigation, Yolov3-Tiny, Yolov4, Yolov4-Tiny, Yolov6, and Yolov8 were utilized for detection. For object detection, each of these models was selected. Images have been marked with Yolo. Yolov8 outperformed previous trials by having the highest mAP of 84.7% and an average loss of 0.7939 for the detection of tiny pests. An Android application that offered real-time insect detection utilized the Yolov8 paradigm. The purpose of this research is to develop and deploy novel deep-learning models, analytical tools, and a procedure for identifying crop pests for pest management.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Framework for Diabetes Prediction: PIMA Indian Dataset
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: A growing number of people throughout the world are struggling with diabetes, which is already one of the most prevalent diseases. On the other hand, diabetes can be significantly slowed down in its progression if caught early. A novel deep learning-based approach to diabetes early detection is suggested in this paper. The PIMA dataset included in the research consists entirely of numerical values, similar to the majority of medical data sets. Thus, popular convolutional-neural-network (CNN) models have restricted applicability to this kind of data. For the purpose of early diabetes detection using the robust representation of CNN models, this study converts numerical data into visuals according to the feature importance. The diabetes picture data that is generated is subsequently classified using three distinct methods. The first uses convolutional neural network (CNN) models called ResNet18 and ResNet50 to sort through photos of people with diabetes.
