Second, using support vector machines (SVMs), we combine the deep features of the ResNet models for classification. The final method involves using SVM for feature classification on the chosen fusion features.

articleTitle: Portable Field Device for Real-Time Soil Fertility Prediction Using CatBoost
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Accurate prediction of soil fertility is the main factor to improve agriculture production with adapted sustainable farming. Therefore, this paper would present a proposition for developing a Soil Fertility Prediction System using the NPK-pH sensors integrated with Arduino to acquire the data in real time. The system will incorporate the use of the CatBoost model, a gradient boosting algorithm, in predicting soil fertility using sensor data. The Arduino-based sensor setup allows for constant monitoring of soil conditions, providing a very accurate and highly precise measure of NPK levels and pH values. These are very key indicators of soil health that may influence crop yield and quality. Data collected is fed into the CatBoost model that is trained on historical soil and crop yield datasets to understand the relationship between soil properties and fertility. Experimental results reveal quite high performance of the CatBoost model in predicting soil fertility, therefore showing good application of the model. This system will be beneficial in making appropriate decisions for fertilization and good management of the soil by farmers, leading to better yields of crops and usage of resources efficiently. This was a huge step forward in precision agriculture, where sensor technology was integrated with high-machine-learning models, showing the potential of IoT-based sensor networks along with machine learning for real-time assessment of soil fertility and sustainable agricultural practices.

articleTitle: Securing Sensitive Data: How Blockchain Transforms Privacy in Healthcare, Law, and Education
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In the field of healthcare, law, and education, Blockchain technology (BT) is emerging as a transformative force. This paper helps to explore the usage of BT to enhance the privacy and security in the above said domains. In healthcare industry, blockchain offers privacy and secure management of the vital electronic health records (EHR) and patient health records (PHR), boosting the data integrity and access control. In the law sector, blockchain-enabled smart contracts are providing new possibilities for the transactions automation, transparency, and security of the transactions, thoroughly facing the challenges in terms of jurisdiction and compliance with regulations like GDPR. In the field of education, blockchain technology is improvising the record-keeping, degree verification, and collaborative learning environments. The paper helps to examine the features like the effectiveness, efficiency, and security aspects of blockchain implementations in these sectors, focusing on both the potential benefits and the challenges imposed that need to be addressed for the widespread adoption in real time.

articleTitle: Robotics in Healthcare: Artificial Intelligence-Driven Application for Medical Diagnosis and Treatment
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The rapid development of deep learning methods presents a potentially game-changing opportunity in the realm of education, particularly in the promotion of student involvement and the comprehension of the subject matter. To exemplify learning gestures and resolve educational challenges, this exploratory study investigates the operation of deep learning algorithms to determine the interests of students. Our deep learning model can provide direct predictions on the areas of interest for individual students by analyzing enormous volumes of educational data. These data include pupil relations, performance standards, and behavioral patterns of students. By aligning instructional tactics with the preferences of students, this strategy not only makes it easier for students to become accustomed to newly presented educational material but also encourages active learning. The research reveals that deep learninghelps capture the intricacies of student engagement. It also provides preceptors with valuable insights that may be used to cultivate a learning landscape that is more engaging and investigative. The results of our research highlight the possibility that deep learning will be used to change educational procedures to make them more adaptable and sensitive to the various needs of students. In this paper, the practice of using deep learning for interest identification in education is discussed, along with its methodology, perpetrators, and counteraccusations

articleTitle: Advancing Online Education: An Interactive Framework for Aligning Teaching Methods with Learning Styles
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This research develops an innovative method for enhancing existing distance education by adjusting the teaching process to students' learning styles. The study investigates the relationship between teachers' teaching styles and learners' preferences, refining Grasha's teaching style model to better suit students' needs. As a result, an online system was created that enabled teachers to modify their strategies during lessons, thereby improving student participation and performance. Furthermore, a mobile solution was also implemented to address the need for portable and easy-to-use options. To evaluate the adoption of the system, university students were administered questionnaires aimed primarily at determining their main learning styles. Based on the analysis, lecturers were trained to modify their teaching methods accordingly. The findings revealed significant improvements in student satisfaction and academic performance after the alignment of teaching methods with learning preferences. Cronbach's Alpha values confirmed the high reliability of the results, highlighting increased engagement and satisfaction among students. The contribution of this study lies in its practical approach to improving online education through personalized teaching methods. The platform provides educators with a real-time feedback loop, enabling dynamic adjustment of teaching strategies to optimize student engagement. The research demonstrates technical soundness, supported by rigorous data analysis, and has the potential to revolutionize online learning environments globally.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based Approach Using Hand Gestures for Mouse and Video Control
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Machine-learning-based hand gesture recognition system will be greatly effective for individuals that help to increase utility without much human interference from input device at a distant or for the disabled. It will bring accuracy and hands-free control to experts and professionals, for example, in multimedia creation or virtual reality, hence improving workflow and interaction with digital environments. The suggested system is based on a real-time, low-cost hand gesture recognition system for HCI that uses CNN for hand detection, gesture segmentation, and classification. The existing systems employ models based on a framework that has used a convolutional neural network to create a video player controlled via human gestures. The existing system used a web camera to capture user gestures and performs basic activities like play and pause. Implemented in Python with Keras and Tensorflow, the system recognize and translate these gestures as video player commands. Deep learning techniques and Convolutional Pose Machines architecture are used for hand detection. The initialization procedures are carried out using Kalman filter and multi-frame recursion, hence reducing the number of redundant and erroneous frames. The proposed approach implements AI Virtual Mouse technology, which is based on capturing the hand movements, for controlling video and mouse operations using a web camera. Adopting OpenCV with Hand Detection and a Speech-To-Text library applied for implementing voice commands, the system is enabled so that users can navigate the virtual screen and manage video playback functions like play, pause, adjust volume, etc. The touch-free and multimodal approach improves. It has accessibility and provides a much more user-friendly experience.

articleTitle: Enhancing Multi-Object Detection Systems Cutting-Edge Techniques of Implementation Strategies, and Performance Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In many industries such as retail, driverless cars, and security, object detection is vital. The project report explains the development and implementation of an object detection system with machine learning focusing on the COCO model (Common Object in context. COCO Model, the one with quite a capability and database, is the COCO's key scheme of object identification. This is a single research piece which is drawn with the idea of creating a system which can be used by software. In addition, YouTube, so that objects are precisely located and identified with the highest accuracy. Through the use of machine learning approaches, namely deep learning algorithms, the system can detect various objects in numerous scenarios. Transfer learning of COCO on a massive dataset creates our model setup with 80 distinct item categories. Python, with frameworks such as Tensor Flow or PyTorch, is commonly used for such tasks due to its adaptability and substansial dataset for machine learning. An assessment of the system of the functionality is conducted using common measures like recall and accuracy and F1 score. Real-world scenarios are simulated to assess the system's robustness and generalization capabilities.

articleTitle: Impact of Natural Language Processing on Sentiment Analysis in Stock Market Predictions
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This study explores the connections between sentiment analysis and Natural Language Processing techniques to enhance stock market predictions, specifically targeting India's Nifty 50 index. Historical price data serves as the basis for traditional stock prediction models; however, they often overlook the significant impact of market sentiment, as highlighted in financial news articles. Not including these details may lead to projecting false predictions as since stock values are very sensitive to market responses toward news events. This research has extracted measures of sentiment that outline the polarity and subjectivity from a judiciously selected collection of news articles related to Nifty. Combining all these indicators with the stock market history makes the predictions highly accurate. Our results were different from the traditional ML models with an MSE of 0.0058 and an RMSE of 0.0762 using Long Short-Term Memory. The findings when including sentiment improves the accuracy in making predictions as well as provides a better insight into market behavior, which in turn helps analysts and investors make better choices in the volatile stock markets.

articleTitle: Experimental Evaluation of an Improved Air Quality Prediction Approach Based on AI Powered Deep Learning Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Everyone knows that pollution is becoming worse and worse, and that this is contributing to a sharp increase in global mortality rates; nevertheless, “Air-Pollution” is particularly harmful to humans. Air pollution is rapidly becoming a big threat to all forms of life on Earth, including humans. Officials in charge of public health are worried about the steadily declining air quality in our nation. Pollution levels are rising, which is causing the air quality index to rise daily. Air pollution not only adds to climate change, but it may also cause lung cancer, neurological diseases, and the greenhouse effect, all of which can be lethal. Reducing air pollution requires accurate air quality forecasts. Predicting the air quality index makes use of Machine Learning and Deep Learning techniques, despite the abundance of research on the subject. An improved learning for quality prediction strategy, or ILQPS, is developed in this research as a new deep learning model for detecting air quality contamination. In order to assess the efficacy of the suggested system, this model is cross-validated with the traditional learning model known as Linear Regression (LR). Supporting early warning and regional pollution control, the suggested solutions can greatly enhance public access to information on air quality forecast.

articleTitle: Genetic Algorithms and Computational Biology in Crop Improvement
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Genetic algorithms (GAs) are a subset of machine learning and can potentially solve complex biological challenges in agriculture, including crop improvement. These algorithms help simulate the process of nature selection using techniques such as Mutation, Crossover, and Selection. Integrating genetic algorithms with computational biology can help improve the agriculture field's outcomes such as crop yield, resistance to crop diseases, and crop quality, and crops are more adaptable in the environment. The role of genetic algorithms in agriculture focuses on improving breeding strategies, optimizing agricultural outputs, sustainable farming, and enhancing global food security.

articleTitle: Soil Fertility Feature Extraction and Reduction Algorithm for Optimizing Agricultural Yield Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Agricultural datasets, such as those provided by the Indian Chamber of Food and Agriculture (ICFA), contain critical parameters that influence soil fertility and crop yield, including nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium, soil pH, dew point, and temperature. The challenge lies in reducing the dimensionality of these datasets while retaining the most informative features to advance the accuracy and interpretability of predictive models. This paper introduces the Soil Fertility Feature Extraction and Reduction Algorithm (SFFERA), a novel algorithm designed to address this challenge effectively. SFFERA integrates multiple feature reduction techniques to ensure a comprehensive and efficient selection process. Initially, correlation analysis is employed to identify and eliminate redundant features, ensuring that highly correlated features do not skew the model. Subsequently, Information Gain (IG) is calculated to determine the consequence of each attribute with respect to the target variable, ensuring that only the most informative atttributess are retained. Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is then applied to transform the dataset into a lower-dimensional space, preserving as much variance as possible while reducing complexity. Finally, Recursive Feature Elimination (RFE) with a decision tree classifier is utilized to iteratively select the most significant features, further refining the dataset. By combining these techniques, SFFERA effectively reduces the dimensionality of agricultural datasets while maintaining the integrity of the information crucial for predictive modeling. The application of SFFERA to the ICFA dataset demonstrates significant improvements in model performance, highlighting the algorithm's potential to enhance agricultural productivity predictions. This comprehensive approach ensures that the most relevant features are extracted, leading to more accurate and reliable predictive models in agriculture.

articleTitle: AI-Powered Data-Driven Approaches to Fraud Detection in Finance
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Despite detection techniques have advanced, financial fraud is still a serious problem. Conventional rule-based approaches frequently suffer from high false positive rates and missed fraudulent activity because of their rigidity and vulnerability to changing fraud tactics. To improve fraud detection in finance, the study suggests a data-driven, AI-powered method. The system continuously adapts to new fraud tendencies by dynamically analyzing transactional data and utilizing machine learning (ML) algorithms for anomaly identification and predictive analytics. When it comes to real-time monitoring, essential elements include feature engineering, data preprocessing, data collecting, and model training. Its effectiveness in reducing financial risks is demonstrated by testing it against Existing systems and finding superior performance metrics in precision (0.95), recall (0.92), F1-score (0.93), and AUC-ROC (0.97). With the ever-changing financial landscape, the scalable and real-time fraud detection capabilities of the proposed system are essential for preserving transaction security and integrity

articleTitle: Multi-Lingual Handwritten Recognition Using Convolutional Recurrent Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Character recognition from handwritten text, particularly for Tamil and English scripts poses special difficulty because of many styles of characters in this script, and due to the complexity of these scripts. In this paper, we introduce a robust convolutional recurrent neural network (CRNN) model to accommodate the vagaries of both Tamil and English handwritten character recognition. Using a comprehensive dataset with more than 60,000 images, the model includes English characters (0 to 56), as well as Tamil (0 to 155), capturing the characters of both languages exhaustively. The proposed architecture of the CRNN, includes a convolutional neural network for feature extracting and a long short-term memory network and the gated recurrent unit both of which allow for sequence understanding. The input images are then normalized and undergo several convolutional layers, succeeding LSTM and GRU layers which handle the sequential information that is important in character recognition. In the evaluation performance metric, our proposed CRNN model distinguishes Tamil script characters with 92% recognition rate, and the English script characters with 95% recognition rate. Furthermore, the designed model gets the average F1 score of 0.91 with the precision 0.93, and recall of 0.90 which improved than the traditional CNN based OCR systems and baseline CRNN architecture. These metrics demonstrate how well the model is able to detect intricate forms of characters in both script and how immune it is to variations in style. As a speech component to enhance the system, integrating Text to Speech (TTS) with gTTS technology turns the identified text into Tamil or English and makes our system user-friendly. Not only does the model provide a text form of what it recognized, it also produces the audio to have a full functional output and to expand the use of the model to audio processes. This paper demonstrates that the proposed deep learning models and the integration of TTS can enhance the recognition of bilingual handwritten characters in documents and promote document digitization applications, education, and language-related initiatives.

articleTitle: HybridNet-X: A Hybrid Deep Learning Network with Fuzzy-Enhanced Firefly Algorithm for Lung Disorder Diagnosis Using X-Ray Images
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Lung disorders such as pneumonia and tuberculosis present significant diagnostic challenges when detected through images of chest X-ray. This work proposes HybridNet-X, a hybrid deep learning model that integrates EfficientNet and Vision Transformer (ViT) with a hybrid Attention Mechanism to improve feature extraction and classification accuracy. Additionally, the model is optimized using the Fuzzy-Enhanced Firefly Algorithm (FEFA) which refines the network's parameters by enhancing convergence speed and solution accuracy. This combined approach leads to a more efficient and precise diagnosis of lung disorders. The methodology encompasses several stages including image preprocessing, feature extraction and classification followed by optimization using FEFA. The proposed HybridNet-X with FEFA optimization model outperforms the other baseline models like VGG+FEFA, ResNet+FEFA, DenseNet+FEFA using the NIH Chest X-ray repository containing a labeled dataset of X-ray images with a accuracy of 98.5% accuracy, precision of 98.7%, recall of 98.4% and a F1-score of 98.5%. In contrast, the proposed classifier without FEFA optimization resulted in lower performance with an accuracy of 96.8%. The results confirm that the integration of FEFA significantly improves the classification performance making the model more robust and suitable for real-time clinical application in detecting lung disorders from X-ray images.

articleTitle: An Internet of Things Assisted Autism Spectrum Disorder Prediction Using Deep Learning Principles with Medical Image Processing Assistance
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Characteristics of the complex neuro-developmental condition Autism Spectrum condition (ASD) include impaired social communication and restricted, repetitive patterns of behavior. This study presents a novel approach for identifying ASD in young infants by integrating deep learning, Internet of Things (IoT) and medical image processing. The goal of this research is to create comprehensive and discriminative features by combining wearable sensor data with brain imaging and smart home environments. For the greatest results, early diagnosis is essential. The proposed method called IoT based Autism Predictive Framework (IoTAPF) has a high detection rate of 97.8% and is cross-validated against the current Learning based Autism Detection Strategy (LADS). The proposed approach aims at improving diagnostic specificity which helps in forecasting behaviors and thus pushing earlier interventions, providing better support for ASD individuals and their families. The paper discusses the design and implementation of the framework, including sensor integration, data management, and predictive modeling. Preliminary results from pilot studies are presented, demonstrating the framework's potential to improve diagnostic accuracy and support individualized care plans. The proposed solution represents a significant advancement in the application of IoT technology for early autism detection and management, paving the way for more proactive and data-driven approaches in the field of neuro-developmental disorders.

articleTitle: Real-Time Human Assault Prediction Using Human Behavior Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Partial blockage, perspective, size variations, fore-ground chaos, illumination and appearance oscillations are some of the hurdles that make it problematic to deduce human behavior from progression or still photographs. Thus, the problem of classifying time series for Human Behavior Recognition is very difficult. It is the use of sensor data to infer individuals or circumstances. In order to properly create features out of raw data to fit a model using machine learning, the vast majority of pattern recognition techniques require in-depth domain expertise and certain signal processing techniques. The basis of human- computer and interaction between people is the recognition of pattern behavior. Systems that are operated manually require a lot more time and money. The current state of the world has made the construction of human behavior recognition systems necessary. Not only will this system be affordable, but it's also a utility-based system that could be integrated into several apps that help with various tasks requiring accurate and efficient recognition at a high rate of time savings. The KTH action video dataset is used in the present project's system design. Preprocessing techniques make it possible to retrieve those preselected specific frames. Pixel and visual flow discovery techniques are employed in the feature gathering processing process. The extraction of attributes is visualized using the data visual representation approach. To identify and categorize human behaviors, deep learning algorithms like Spatio-Temporal Net are applied after this technique. This well organised model can be used as an application for monitoring of roads, e.g., a recording device module installed in the road that is always monitoring the area. The camera alerts the authorities when it detects odd behavior in people, such as fighting or other conflicts. The police have developed a React Native mobile application that triggers alert notifications and enables live streaming upon detecting unusual human actions via the camera. As a result, this research successfully equips the cameras with powered by AI human activity identification models, which can be used in actual-time applications like preventing and generating proof of aberrant detection on a road.

articleTitle: An Integrated Dynamic Behavior Analysis and Adaptive Detection Framework for Enhanced Cloud Malware Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: As malware threats continue to evolve and pose significant risks to cloud computing environments, there is a pressing need for advanced detection systems that can effectively address these challenges. This research introduces the Dynamic Behavior Analysis and Adaptive Detection Network (DBA-ADN), a novel framework designed to enhance malware detection through a combination of dynamic behavior analysis and adaptive detection techniques. DBA-ADN integrates real-time behavioral data with sophisticated adaptive algorithms to achieve superior detection performance. The study involves a comprehensive comparison of DBA-ADN against several benchmark systems, including MDCD, GloVe with CNN, CloudIntellMal, Hybrid Deep Learning Models, and DenseNet-121. The results reveal that DBA-ADN outperforms these established methods, achieving an impressive accuracy of 98.20% and an F1 Score of 0.99. This enhanced performance is attributed to DBA-ADN's ability to accurately identify both known and novel malware threats while minimizing false positives and false negatives. The framework's innovative approach addresses key limitations observed in existing solutions, as difficulties in handling sophisticated malware and inefficiencies in traditional detection techniques. By leveraging dynamic behavior analysis and adaptive algorithms, DBA-ADN not only improves detection accuracy but also reduces the complexity of deployment compared to its counterparts. The findings highlight DBA-ADN's potential to set a new benchmark in malware detection within cloud environments, offering a robust solution to the ongoing challenges of cybersecurity. This research contributes significantly to the field by providing a highly effective and adaptable approach to malware detection, laying the groundwork for future advancements and continued innovation in the domain.

articleTitle: Network Intrusion Detection Through Stacked Machine Learning Models on UNSW-NB15 Dataset
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: As an essential component of system defence, intrusion detection systems (IDSs) are now attracting a lot of attention. IDSs employ the data they gather about network traffic from different locations inside a computer system or network to protect the network. The vast amount of data and intricate patterns involved make it difficult and time-consuming to distinguish between legitimate and malicious network activity. In the past, finding incursion sequences in network connections required an analyst to go over large datasets. As a result, effective techniques that take into accountthe state of network traffic are required to identify network intrusions. This research offers a novel machine learning technique for detecting intrusions systems (IDSs) that identifiesintrusion features using a stacking classifier. The method integrates multiple models with a stacking classifier to improve prediction accuracy, to generate rules through categorisation. These rules, which are used in the stacking classifier to detect intrusions and carry out preventative measures by rejecting intrusions, are able to recognise intrusion characteristics. Among the attack types that are categorized are Shellcode, Worms, Fuzzers, Reconnaissance, Analysis, Backdoors, DoS, Exploits, Generic, and Normal. The following methods were used to assess the recommended strategy's efficacy: The three types of errors are Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE), Mean Squared Error (MSE), and Mean Absolute Error (MAE). Through the use of group learning's advantages, this strategy seeks to improve intrusion detection systems' effectiveness(IDSs) and offer a more reliable and accurate means of detecting and preventing network intrusions.

articleTitle: Enhancing Pathfinding Optimization for Mode of Transportation with in Intramuros for Improved Efficiency and Navigation Using the A* Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The study aims to develop an advanced AI navigation app designed to assist drivers in finding efficient routes within Intramuros. The study focuses on developing a user-friendly mobile application that offers transparent fare calculations using Linear Regression, allowing passengers and drivers to track and understand fare breakdowns. Additionally, the study incorporates a system that presents multiple route options to various historical sites within Intramuros, providing accurate predictions for travel time and distance using the Random Forest Regressor. Finally, the implementation of an AI-driven navigation app utilizing the A* algorithm aims to optimize navigation through elevated routes within Intramuros, offering precise and dynamic directions that adapt to changing road conditions, ensuring smoother and faster journeys. This study aimed to survey drivers in Intramuros and IT professionals to evaluate the effectiveness of the developed mobile application. The researchers used interview questions and rating sheet surveys, which were conducted as part of the research. Statistical tools, such as the four-point Likert scale, were employed to assess the functional suitability, reliability, usability, and performance efficiency of the system. The results for functional suitability are 3.08, reliability is 3.04, useability is 3.18, and performance efficiency is 3.09. The overall result is 3.1, which signifies that the app has demonstrated good performance across all evaluated criteria

articleTitle: Leveraging NLP and Deep Learning for Automating Product Categorization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Classification of products in a specified category is key to effective stockkeeping, better systems that suggest products to buyers, and an overall more pleasant shopping experience when one shops online. Attempts to address the research problem in practice with the use traditional methods such as rule based systems, manual tagging or even simpler machine learning models like Support Vector Machines (SVM) are usually proven to be ineffective, inefficient and non-scalable in nature. The paper proposes a system that employs machine learning for product category classification. Standard Natural Language Processing techniques such as tokenization, stemming, stop word removal as well as vectorization techniques such as Count Vectorizer are applied on the product descriptions. For classification purposes, BERT based Contextual Embeddings and a mutually inclusive Random Forest (RF) and Logistic Regression (LR) based model have been employed in the project to ensure correct category creation with high accuracy. As a data set includes a variety of product descriptions collected from different e-commerce sites which indicates the real-world complexity and variety of data. Key performance indicators like accuracy, precision, recall and F1-score are useful in training the model. Results indicates that performance of BERT-based deep learning network architecture with hybrid RF + LR outshines all the existing methodologies including SVM. Also the Project assesses how data augmentation, transfer learning and model tuning affect classification accuracy. The results also emphasize how NLP and deep learning can scale up and be effective in automating product categorizations. The future improvement will be integrating more sophisticated techniques in NLP and multi-modal data and also user feedback in order to improve the performance of the system even further.

articleTitle: An Improved Neural Classification Logic to Predict Kidney Disease Identification Using Medical Image Processing Principles
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Kidney disease is a significant global health concern, requiring accurate and early diagnosis to prevent progression and ensure timely treatment. This study proposes an improved neural classification logic combining an AutoEncoder and an Artificial Neural Network (ANN) to predict kidney disease using medical image processing techniques. A dataset comprising kidney images from CT, MRI, and ultrasound was utilized to train and test the model. The AutoEncoder was employed for unsupervised feature extraction, reducing dimensionality while retaining key information related to kidney abnormalities. The ANN then classified these features into healthy or diseased categories. Image preprocessing techniques such as noise reduction, resizing, normalization, and contrast enhancement were applied to ensure data consistency. Additionally, advanced segmentation algorithms like U-Net were used to isolate the kidney regions from the background, focusing on the Regions of Interest (ROI). Data augmentation was applied to improve generalization. The proposed model achieved a classification accuracy of 94.8%, outperforming baseline models such as CNN (92.1 %) and SVM (88.7<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>). The AutoEncoder + ANN combination demonstrated superior precision, recall, and Fl-score, with an AUC-ROC of 97.4%. The results highlight the model's robustness and potential for practical applications in the early detection of kidney disease.

articleTitle: Integrating Blockchain Deep Learning and Ensemble Methods for Optimized MQTT Protocol in IoT Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: MQTT is a lightweight protocol used commonly that offers low power consumption and overhead, but suffers significant security threats such as Man-in-the-Middle (MiTM) attacks, Packet Sniffing, and network anomalies. The presented work introduces an enhanced MQTT protocol that integrates blockchain technology, deep learning, and ensemble methods in optimized ways connected with security and performance for IoT environments that are either resource-constrained or challenged. Blockchain technology ensures integrity of data and tamper-proof communication between IoT devices with brokers; Deep Learning models, including LSTM and CNNs, detect anomalies in real-time and prevent MiTM attacks. The techniques in Ensemble Learning which combine Random Forest and XGBoost together enhance the ability of detection of attacks, improving accuracies and reliability. The system is designed to be lightweight yet effective for securing MQTT communications, especially when it ensures authenticity of data while optimizing the network traffic load with minimal processing load. The experimental results find good improvements in network threat detection capabilities and the efficiency of data transmission. Such results confirm the possibility of bringing such technologies into an IoT framework. It develops more secure IoT networks, particularly for applications that require the handling of high security and optimized performance.

articleTitle: A Smart Robotic Design to Identify and Diffuse Bombs in Defence Environments Using Sensors Assisted Internet of Things (IoT) Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Numerous news media outlets cover incidents in which trained personnel or combatants are injured or perish while defusing bombs. The military robot that conducts intelligence operations. While it has been beneficial to the Army, firefighters, and police officers in critical situations, many of the current systems are inefficient due to their lack of accuracy and technology. Our objective is to develop the most efficient robot possible in order to achieve accuracy and technology. Robotic limbs equipped with metal detectors are being installed to provide manual assistance. The wireless explosive disposal device will enhance our nation's defense against terrorists, suicide bombers, and other similar activities. Experts are required to operate the explosives detectors and disposal system. However, this method of analysis necessitates additional time and poses a risk to the lives of experts. A novel robot, the IoT Defense Robotic Model (IoTDRM), is developed in this paper with the assistance of Internet of Things (IoT) technology. The proposed model is cross-validated against the conventional logic of the Smart Bomb Diffusing Robot (SBDR) to assess its performance. The signals are transmitted from the sensor end to the IoT controller in this robot, and they are retransmitted to the server end via a wireless system. The user controls the automaton manually using a personal computer or mobile phone. When the sensor detects a metal, a buzzer alarm will sound. The metal is examined using a wireless camera to determine whether it is a weapon. Since the identified metal is a bomb, the user instructs the robot to detonate it via the computer.

articleTitle: Innovations in Project Management: Leveraging Technology for Improved Efficiency and Performance
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Because of the implementation of innovative software products, designs can improve decision-making processes, expedite workflows, and optimise resource allocation. This is made possible by the incorporation of AI-driven analytics, pall-based collaboration platforms, and robotization tools. These skills are available to design directors with whom they work. To explain the benefits that these technologies offer to the process of creating operation scripts in the real world, case studies and actual data are emphasised within the scope of this inquiry. Through the reduction of the number of tasks that are carried out manually, the improvement of communication through the provision of real-time perceptivity, and the enhancement of communication, these ideas contribute to the formulation of design operating techniques that are more agile and responsive. The goal of this research is to provide a comprehensive analysis of the current technological landscape in the creation and operation of design technologies. In addition, the research will provide strategic recommendations to associations that are interested in utilising these technologies to improve their design challenges and gain a competitive advantage. According to the findings, the use of technology is essential for the operation of ultramodern design, which results in significant improvements in terms of both the effectiveness and the overall performance of design compared to traditional design.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Image Processing for Defect Detection in Electronic Components Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In electronic factors manufacturing, icing product quality through disfigurement discovery is pivotal for maintaining trustability and performance norms. This exploration investigates the operation of deep literacy ways in image processing for disfigurement discovery. Deep literacy algorithms, particularly convolutional neural networks(CNNs), have shown remarkable success in automated image analysis tasks. This study explores their effectiveness in relating blights similar to face abnormalities, cracks, or indecorous assembly in electronic factors. By using annotated datasets and advanced neural network infrastructures, the proposed approach aims to enhance delicacy and effectiveness in disfigurement discovery compared to traditional styles. The methodology involves preprocessing raw images, training CNN models on labeled data, and validating their performance through rigorous testing and evaluation. Results demonstrate the eventuality of deep literacy to revise disfigurement discovery processes in manufacturing, offering more dependable examinations that contribute to bettered product quality and reduced product costs. This exploration contributes precious perceptivity to the integration of AI technologies for enhancing quality control in artificial settings.

articleTitle: Decentralized Trust: Visual Cryptography for Transparent E-Voting Solutions
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: E-voting system is a digital mechanism that enables people to vote electronically, ensuring confidentiality, security, and transparency. Visual cryptography (VC) is a cryptographic technique where a secret image is divided into two or more shares, and only by superimposing these shares can the secret be revealed. When combined, visual cryptography offers a unique and secure way to enhance e-voting systems, providing features such as transparency, privacy, and tamper-proof mechanisms. It has an exceptional way of splitting a secret image into n pieces such that each piece reveals no information about the whole. Whenever these shares are stacked or overlaid, the original image is recreated again. This means that every share taken alone does not provide any clues to what is in the hidden content, and so it is a very good option for safeguarding shared information. In terms of electronic voting systems, visual cryptography can be used as a possible solution to addressing issues such as vote tampering, coercion and confidentiality of voters. This paper aims to enhance the security and confidentiality of electronic voting systems through the implementation of visual cryptography. A high level of security and verifiability can be realized with e-voting system through visual cryptography.

articleTitle: Illegal Boat Detection Using Satellite Imagery with Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Satellite imagery has played a vital part in real-time monitoring and identification of threats in modern times. Accurately identifying illegal boats that are in or around the legal border of a country is a vital tool in defense sector of a country. Here we are using a large ship dataset containing unique ships, for which large number of images are used. We will use Convolution neural network for feature extraction and classification of images. The CNN is trained with function which increases the gap between the different kind of objects and ships and decreases the gap between the similar sea vessel. The ultimate goal of this project is to identify illegal sea vessels approaching or within the country's legal borders and to alert the appropriate authorities in real-time. By providing timely and accurate identification of potential threats, this system can significantly enhance maritime security and defense capabilities. Through continuous training and refinement using a large and diverse dataset, we aim to develop a highly reliable and effective tool for national defense, ensuring the safety and security of maritime borders.

articleTitle: A Novel Trust Assessment System for Online Social Networking Environment Using Learning Assisted Classification Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Trust is essential in the constantly developing environment of online social networks. The Nexus Terroism Impact and Intro Trust facilitate the communication, decision-making, and maintenance of digital communities among individuals. Trust-based Learning with Classification Principle (TLCP) is introduced in this research to improve the assessment of trust in social networks. To ascertain its efficacy, our proposed methodology undergoes a 10-fold cross-validation against the Trust Assessment Methodology (TAM). The traditional Trust Assessment Model (TAM) evaluates and regulates trust in Internet social networking. This method incorporates trust assessment factors to generate a user dependability judgment that is both discriminatory and dynamic. The Trustworthy Account Management (TAM) challenge is designed to enhance digital trust by addressing disinformation, deception, and hostile conduct. The TLCP is able to accurately evaluate trust by utilizing reputation scoring, community analysis, and user behavior metrics. Trust levels are dynamically adjusted as a result of the identification of trustworthy behavioral patterns and danger indicators by machine learning algorithms and social media data. This research examines the connections between trust management and digital interactions and suggests a general solution to alleviate specific trust evaluation issues across online social networks.

articleTitle: An Effective Customer Segmentation Approach to Improve E-Commerce Platform Quality Based on Intensive Learning Methodology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: To accomplish company goals and reap advantages while satisfying and meeting consumer expectations, segmentation is an essential facilitator. Identifying subgroups of the target market that share common traits, requirements, and priorities is customer segmentation's primary goal. Various dataset dimensionalities are also considered, as are changes across time. In this study, we use time-based segmentation and clustering approaches to the e-commerce industry to conduct predictive neural network analysis using factors such as product reviews, goods, buying trend, watching pattern, and more. In this research, Intensive Neural Classification Learning (INCL) is presented as a novel deep learning technique. To assess its efficacy, it is cross-validated with the traditional Neural Network (NN) learning algorithm. We have evaluated unigrams, bigrams, and trigrams as part of the feature extraction process and identified the unique brands per consumer. In addition, the customer's chosen brands may be determined using a neural network, and the projected data can then be utilized for statistical analysis. We all know that sentiment analysis and categorization are huge help when trying to guess how customers feel about certain companies and items. Lastly, using the provided set of input data, we will choose the top brands by assessing the accuracy of the forecasts.

articleTitle: Transforming HR in Finance by Leveraging IoT and AI for Strategic Talent Management
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Financial institutions have recognized the value of AI and the IoT in enhancing strategic human resource management. The paper presents a comprehensive integration framework that utilizes AI and IoT technologies. The focus is on key aspects of human resources operations, such as employee recruitment, retention, employee engagement, and performance evaluations. Productivity and efficiency can be maximized by 72% and 92%, respectively, through the application of AI algorithms and predictive analytics in IoT devices used in the collection of real-time data for HR operations. The proposed framework will be diverse in performance indicators, have appropriate strategies for change management, robust security measures, and pipelined data meant for long-term use. It consequently contributes to the design of a dynamic and personalized human resource management strategy based on insights derived from data.

articleTitle: Experimental Procedure to Design a Smart Shopping Trolley for Supermarkets by Using Internet of Things (IoT) Association
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This paper presents the design and development of a smart shopping trolley using Internet of Things (IoT) technology to enhance the supermarket shopping experience. The trolley is equipped with RFID sensors, weight sensors, barcode scanners, and GPS to automate item scanning, provide real-time price updates, and track trolley location. The system was tested over 30 days in a supermarket environment, and key performance metrics were recorded, including item detection speed, weight sensor accuracy, and system reliability. The trolley achieved an average item detection accuracy of 98.2%, with a reduction in checkout times by 40% compared to traditional methods. Customer feedback indicated an average satisfaction rate of 90%, with real-time updates being particularly appreciated. Error rates, including failed item detection and price calculation errors, decreased over time, demonstrating the system's capacity to self-optimize. Overall, the smart shopping trolley provides an efficient, user-friendly solution for supermarkets, improving both operational efficiency and customer experience. Future improvements will focus on refining AI-based product recommendations and integrating more advanced inventory management capabilities.

articleTitle: Uncovering Social Dynamics in Education Through Graph Neural Networks and Continual Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The informal structure of classrooms forces researchers to contemplate the social aspects that shape student behavior. Such models have been useful despite their omission of connections between students. Aimed at resolving this gap, graph neural networks and continual learning are introduced to represent and interact with academic networks and find correlations affecting academic performance. The proposed work, which includes monitoring student behavior, attendance, participation, and online metrics, will be utilized with a, and online activities, with a Graph Convolutional Network (GCN) model for social network mapping. The scope of this research evolves as technology and educational policies change, thanks to continual learning. Comparing the performance of the proposed model with models such as DGNN, LSTM-NN, ASSAN have shown better accuracy. The proposed model is better than existing ones with an accuracy of 86.50%, 81.30% F1-score, and a precision of 84.35% at 100% data saturation. This becomes useful in complementing research by helping educators to recognize the social factors and plan in a way that positively influences the learning outcomes of the students.

articleTitle: Enhancing E-Commerce Product Recommendations Using LLMs and Transformer-Based Deep Learning Architectures
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The integration of large language models with deep learning architectures brought an evolutionary revolution in the context of product recommendation systems because of several limitations of traditional methods, such as collaborative and content-based filtering. In this paper, a novel framework for product recommendation is proposed by integrating large language models jointly with deep learning. The contribution of large language models is that it adds semantic understanding capability to the predictive power provided through neural networks. Domain ontologies will be used in this hybrid model to enhance the accuracy and personalization of recommendations, considering complex user preferences and product attributes in e-commerce platforms. It takes a state-of-the-art pre-trained LLM, such as Llama-3, as input and generates personalized embeddings of users based on history, item descriptions, and contextual information. In this work, the Transformer architecture has been used in re-fining and ranking the products for relevance using attention mechanisms that select the most important features in each recommendation task. Besides, knowledge distillation will be used to conduct the small and efficient student model training process. The distilled model receives soft predictions that involve the teacher LLM, which greatly reduces computational overhead but preserves high recommendation accuracy. Eventually, the framework will be evaluated on a real-world e-commerce dataset to explore how it increases the click-through rate, purchase rate, and user's engagement compared to the traditional systems.

articleTitle: MED-LINK: A Web-Based Solution for Innovative Medical Resource Allocation in Healthcare
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Medical resource sharing is crucial for addressing shortages and ensuring the timely availability of essential healthcare resources, especially during emergencies. Increase in demands for efficient management and cost effective utilization of scarce medical resources has been occasioned by the recent COVID-19 pandemic with special reference to catering for emergent needs of patients. This research also presents MEDLINK a novel free web-based system that allows the ‘real time’ management and allocation of all necessary resources in the hospital with the support of integrated artificial intelligence. With the help of MEDLINK, resource requirements are predicted, and real-time data on their availability and needful is given; therefore, healthcare facilities can request a bed, equipment, and personnel help, if necessary. It thus avails resource management and the handling of emergent situations beyond the conventional paradigms of a traditional hospital management system that focuses on the decentralized Management Resource units of MEDLINK. It uses Advanced Encryption Standard, 256 bit for data security while it uses MongoDB for data scalability. Compared with previously developed static models, our machine learning approach yields a 30% improvement in response time and a 12% increase in matching accuracy. Stress testing and user polls prove the efficiency of MEDLINK as on comparison to other services it is faster, more accurate, scalable and secure. In addition, already implemented data security measures are presented in the design and its possible further developments are described, which include connection to national health care databases as well as more sophisticated AI-based decision making systems. The main focus of this research is to use automation and intelligent technologies to redesign the medical resource management and enhance healthcare service.

articleTitle: Optimizing Resource Allocation in Cloud Environments Using Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Traditional cloud resource allocation techniques, which rely on static, rule-based systems, are inefficient and lead to greater costs and lower performance due to issues like over- and under-provisioning. The study presents a novel way to dynamically optimize resource allocation in real-time using reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms, such as Deep Q-Networks (DQN), Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), and Actor-Critic approaches. The RL-based system overcomes the limitations of traditional techniques by adjusting to shifting workloads and learning from the past. The average resource usage efficiencies of DQN, PPO, and Actor-Critic are 85.7%, 88.1%, and 87.4%, respectively, compared to 72.3% for traditional systems. The results demonstrate that RL approaches perform much better than traditional systems. The RL techniques also enhanced system performance and decreased expenses by as much as 29.4%; PPO had the highest results in response time (270 ms), throughput (190 requests/second), and user satisfaction (88%).

articleTitle: Enhancing Employee Motivation Through AI: The Role of Corporate Culture in the Workplace
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Motivating the employees is a vital factor for the success of an organization but measuring motivation is challenging, especially with the conventional tools and techniques that do not capture current situations and flexible working organizational environments. Presumably, this paper came up with an AI model that incorporates machine learning algorithms with corporate culture measures to estimate employees' motivation levels. The model relies on the IBM HR Analytics dataset that focuses on employee behavior and feedback data, for performance records. Approaches used herein are Principal Component Analysis for feature extraction and XGBoost and Logistic Regression for modeling. The proposed model obtained an accuracy of 90.5%, 89.2% precision, and an AUC of 0.92, surpassing typical models. Also, the system analyzed different employees and labeled them as high-risk employees with an accuracy level of 87.5%. The findings also show how AI can boost employee motivation by offering precise information on their requirements. Future research will involve applying the model with more substantial datasets and making the model more suitable for complex working contexts.

articleTitle: Data-Driven Insights into Automotive Customer Complaints: A Machine Learning Approach to Predictive Analytics
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Automotive customer complaints forecast as a difficult-to-solve and data-driven machine learning classification problem. Key findings from background research include the problems associated with data imbalance, shortcomings of the models in terms of temporal pattern analysis and variability of prediction errors. It incorporates clustering and LSTM models to analyze product complaint characteristics, improving accuracy and flexibility. The proposed model operates based on a diverse dataset of automotive complaints, and the model accuracy is 94.5%, the precision is 92.7<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>, the recall is 93.1%, the F1 score is 92.9%, and the AUC is 95.3%. Compared to other methods, the advantage of this particular work is that it achieves far better accuracy on complex and imbalanced data sets than previous approaches. The findings proved that the chosen model's approach is rather effective for the prognosis of different kinds of complaints to assist in the usage of the anticipative maintenance approaches. It is useful for automakers, because, knowing that the issues, and indicators of the low degree of customer satisfaction define, manufacturers can come to them before high-risk issues occur.

Author Keywords: Density-Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise

articleTitle: Improving User Experience in Movie Recommendations Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: For movie recommendation systems, conventional methodologies, such as content-based approaches and collaborative filtering, have cold-start problems and too specific recommendations. These limitations make recommendations less personalized and negatively affect user experience. The proposed approach overcomes these drawbacks by combining the traditional collaborative filtering with deep learning approaches, such as recurrent neural networks (RNN) and neural collaborative filtering (NCF). It captures complicated user preferences and adapts to dynamic user behaviors, thus increasing the accuracy of the recommendations. With the higher precision, 80.1%, and recall, 76.6%, compared to the traditional approaches, the proposed system outperforms the target methods, and evaluation results demonstrate significant improvements in their outcomes. In particular, the proposed system has an average score of 4.5 and longer duration of the watch time. The mean squared error is reduced to 0.35, and the satisfaction levels are higher. In other words, as the recommendation system suggests more engaging and relevant movies, it substantially increases the overall user experience.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of an AI-Driven Mental Health Chatbot: A Generative AI Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This paper describes the development, design, and maturation of an AI-based mental health chatbot that allows a user to engage with more accessible, higher forms of mental health assistance. As developed as a retrieval-based system which leveraged predefined responses contained in a database and based upon input received from a user, it matured into a far more scalable system which included the generative AI capabilities that allowed users to achieve far more personalized, contextually relevant interactions. This deployment variant robustly leverages on the chaining framework provided by LangChain to enable chaining of prompt templates, utilizes the OllamaLLM model that uses the Llama3 language model, and fully exploits other NLP methods. Therefore, the rule-based system is migrated to a generative model that integrates both algorithms of machine learning for effective enhancement of both understanding and generating. The primary issues with this development were about the conversational context, empathetic and coherent response, and the scalability of the system. All these were achieved through advanced prompt engineering, a set of rigorous evaluation metrics like BLEU score, accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score besides continuous user feedback for refining the performance of this model. This paper discusses methodologies to overcome the challenges and implications for the future of AI and mental health care with an emphasis on embedding technological advancements within empathetic human-computer interaction. The findings point out this chatbot is effective in providing emotional support and how AI is changing its role to improve the services of mental health.

articleTitle: Experimental Evaluation of Cross-Platform Recognition of Identical and Unknown Users over Social Networking Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The capacity to individually identify and categorize people across sites and apps is vital for trustworthiness, fraud prevention, and personalized experiences in online social networking. In this study, strategies for platform identification among similar and unknown social networking users are evaluated. We study strategies that employ user attributes, behavior history, and inter-network connections to match profiles on multiple platforms and uncover new, previously connected people. This cross-validation on the proposed method uses Social Linkage Identification Strategy (SLIS) and Friend Relationship Evaluator. According to quantitative experiment results, our approach improves search people across multiple social networks more than FRE. The extensive social connection web in many online social networks is used to enhance user identification and verification via the Friend Relationship Evaluator (FRE) system. Our process uses advanced machine learning and data fusion to handle a wide variety of natural ventilation phenomena from different sensors and platform formats. We evaluate attribute-based matching, graph approaches, and behavior analytics for accuracy, scalability, and computing cost. This study advances user identification systems across digital platforms and helps service providers and end-users establish more sophisticated online identity management strategies.

articleTitle: AI-Powered Drug Discovery: Accelerating Precision Medicine with Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: AI-powered drug discovery is a key factor in promoting precision medicine as it helps overcome the challenges of traditional drug discovery methods. The latter are commonly time-consuming and cost-ineffective, with high-throughput screening, and structure-activity relationship modeling causing the high prevalence of false negatives and false positives, leading to large drop-out metrics. The proposed system addresses the identified problem by using deep learning approaches to improve the accuracy and relevance of the predictions on drug-target interaction. It develops a data processing and methodologies scheme supported by example datasets based on genomic, clinical, and chemical data, and includes data collection, data preparation, model design, and model validation stages. The model performed with the use of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) demonstrates the benefits of the approach in terms of performance indicators and obtain 92.7% accuracy, 90.3% precision, and 89.1% recall. These results prove that the use of AI-related approaches not only saves the time and effort of the drug discovery process but also adds to its validity and accuracy, enabling efficient therapeutic options.

articleTitle: Future Internet Architecture for IoT Frameworks Implementing the Synapse Algorithm for Intelligent Energy Management in Smart Home Automation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel Internet architecture for IoT frameworks that integrates the Synapse Algorithm for intelligent energy management in smart homes. Current IoT energy management systems often face challenges such as inefficient energy consumption, poor adaptability to user preferences, and limited scalability in managing multiple interconnected devices. These issues are exacerbated by the inability to process large datasets effectively and in real-time. To address these challenges, the proposed framework, Intelligent Energy Management using the Synapse Algorithm (IEM-SA), offers a sophisticated solution. The framework leverages the Synapse Algorithm to optimize energy consumption by analysing data from interconnected devices in real- time, learning user behaviour patterns, and dynamically adjusting energy usage based on predicted demand. This not only enhances the system's energy efficiency but also enables seamless control and adaptability across different environments and devices. The proposed method improves energy efficiency, scalability, and adaptability within smart home environments. By integrating real-time data processing and machine learning, it supports the seamless operation of multiple IoT devices while significantly reducing energy waste. Findings indicate that the IEM-SA framework outperforms existing methods in terms of energy savings, system responsiveness, and scalability. Through simulation results, the proposed framework demonstrates its potential to optimize energy usage while improving the overall smart home automation experience.

articleTitle: Adaptation of Fitness Application Through AI Integration: An Android Based Application for Home Workout Fitness Experience
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The “iGym” fitness application is a user-friendly platform created to assist gym beginners, users who prefer to workout at home, gym enthusiasts, and gym instructors in determining the suitable workout for different body types. Many beginners struggle because they lack guidance on workouts, diet, and exercise intensity. This study aims to bridge that gap by utilizing predictive analytics to offer personalized workout routines and diet recommendations. By analyzing a user's past performance, physical attributes, and other relevant data, the app can forecast the outcomes of specific workouts, leading to tailored exercise and nutrition plans. These customized approaches enhance fitness efficiency, minimize injury risks, and promote overall health. Additionally, a progress tracker will motivate users by showing their achievements toward their fitness goals. The developers will use Multi-Linear Regression (MLR) to predict results based on users' consistent efforts, providing actionable insights for workout and diet adjustments. Users will also have the option to upload photos for visual progress tracking using TensorFlow. To boost engagement, the app will feature a rewards system that incentivizes users upon reaching goals while recommending appropriate food options to align with their fitness objectives. The approach has been successful in correctly identifying different proper workouts and calorie intake for each body type. iGym has proved its ability to appropriately recommend and predict through thorough testing. This achievement demonstrates TensorFlow's usefulness in this setting while also validating the system's design and implementation. While effective, the researchers believe that utilizing algorithms created specifically for complicated visual data could result in even greater accuracy.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence and its Role in Personalized Financial Advisory Services
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is causing a revolution in the field of substantiated financial advisory services. This is accomplished by applying sophisticated algorithms that assess massive amounts of data and provide customized recommendations to individual clients. The purpose of this research is to investigate how artificial intelligence might revolutionize the quality, efficacy, and accessibility of financial advice. Artificial intelligence systems possess the ability to repurpose various types of financial data, such as investment portfolios, customer preferences, and request trends. This enables them to provide well-founded strategies that correspond with pre-established risk thresholds. Machine literacy models and language processing techniques are used to accomplish this. Financial advisors can evaluate their services more efficiently and with greater personalization thanks to artificial intelligence, which will ultimately result in happier and more satisfied clients. Nevertheless, some barriers still need to be carefully considered to guarantee the ethical and transparent use of AI in financial advisory settings. Data sequestration companies, algorithmic bias, and nonsupervisory compliance are some of these challenges. The focus of this study is on how artificial intelligence could improve decision-making processes in the financial services industry. Moreover, it tackles unexplored areas for research and implementation to maximize AI's benefits while lowering its risks.

articleTitle: Optimizing Multihoming in IoT Nodes for Enhanced Connectivity
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: IoT nodes using optimized multihoming capability to improve performance and connection in harsh locations like coal mines, where network dependability is crucial. Coal mines provide unique issues that traditional single-network solutions frequently are unable to handle, such as frequent signal disruptions and constrained coverage, which increase operational hazards and impair communication. With the aim of ensuring reliable and continuous communication, this project intends to create and implement a sophisticated multihoming strategy that makes use of several network interfaces, such as Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and LoRa. To maintain optimal performance, dynamic network selection algorithms will constantly switch between networks while keeping an eye on real-time characteristics like latency, bandwidth, and signal strength.

articleTitle: Developing a Robust Rental Price Prediction System: Insights from Linear Regression, Decision Trees, and Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Estimation of the rent rate is an important task in the entire real estate industry and can have a heavy consequence for landlords and future tenants. This paper presents a predictive modeling in rental pricing, using machine learning approaches in the Java programming paradigm to build a strong system that could forecast rental values given a set of several property characteristics. Three algorithms were therefore used in this study: Linear Regression, Decision Tree, and Random Forest. The Linear Regression model assumes that there is a basic linear relationship in the middle of the input variables and rental pricing. In contrast, the Decision Tree uses a nonlinear methodology because it segments the data into various decision paths, therefore enhancing its interpretability. The Random Forest approach uses ensemble learning by combining multiple decision trees in order to enhance accuracy and robustness of the prediction. This is accomplished through an integrated web-based platform where these models were integrated into the platform, and a user could insert specific characteristics of the property and would return a set of predicted rental prices. The current study applies these algorithms to a real dataset in order to demonstrate pragmatic usage of machine learning in real estate. Detailed examinations of all three algorithms each have their individual advantages, which give valuable understanding of their efficacy in various prediction situations, hence the creation of a comprehensive instrument for estimating rental prices.

articleTitle: AI Based Acute Pain Detection: Insights Through Facial Expression Analysis Using CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Facial expressions can provide critical information about an individual's pain experience, expressing pain and detecting it can be challenging at several times. In this study, we employed efficient computer techniques for recognizing facial expressions corresponding to three different pain levels: little pain, severe pain, and no pain at all. A “Convolutional Neural Network” (CNN) is a type of computer program that we trained to identify certain facial emotions. This required training the computer to identify tiny fluctuations in facial expressions that correspond to various pain levels. This not only helps us in understanding of pain in manifestation but also provides a promising avenue for developing automated pain assessment tools. This work has impacts for healthcare applications as well, as it can lead to more accurate and timely pain management procedures based on objective face analysis.

articleTitle: Empirical Evaluation of Artificial Intelligence (AI) Powered Brain Stroke Detection Methodology by Using Learning Based Image Processing Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Stroke is a leading cause of death and disability worldwide, making early detection and accurate diagnosis critical for patient outcomes. This study presents a Hybrid Learning Assisted Tumor Detection Scheme (HLTDS) for stroke detection from brain CT images. The proposed model integrates Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) with advanced feature extraction techniques, including AutoEncoders and edge detection, to enhance accuracy and computational efficiency. HLTDS was evaluated against nine existing models: CNN, ResNet50, VGG16, MobileNet, DenseNet, Inception, Xception, and EfficientNet, based on key performance metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. The results demonstrate that HLTDS outperforms all compared models with an accuracy of 96.45%, achieving the highest precision (95.82%) and recall (94.67<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>), making it the most reliable model for identifying stroke-related anomalies. The model's efficiency in terms of training time (58 minutes) and inference time (145 milliseconds) positions it as an optimal choice for real-time clinical applications. Furthermore, HLTDS achieves a balance between model size and memory usage, making it suitable for deployment in resource-constrained environments. These results highlight the importance of hybrid learning approaches in improving stroke detection while ensuring scalability.
