Future work will focus on expanding the model's capability to handle multiclass classification and further reducing computational costs.

articleTitle: Enhanced Yoga Pose Classification Using Advanced CNN Architectures and MediaPipe
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: An advanced yoga poses classification system based on the integration of advanced Convolutional Neural Network architectures and MediaPipe. Yoga is characterized by a variety of poses which are beneficial for health hence it has to be classified well to avoid poses being done incorrectly or injures occurring. Conventional classification techniques that are based on visual observation or simple machine learning aren't accurate or dependable. The new system employs the use of MediaPipe for the real-time image capturing, detecting pose key points from the video frames that are then sorted out through a deep CNN for classification. The system's approach takes into consideration the merits of both technologies with an intention of achieving high accuracy and performance in real time. The structure and experimental design of the system are presented along with results proving its practicality and usefulness for personal training, online teaching, and rehabilitation. The discussion includes the elaborated technique and its applications and a plan for the future works is proposed.

articleTitle: A Various Approaches of Machine Learning Algorithms for Kidney Disease Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Chronic kidney disease is a serious health issue that affects people around the world. Proper diagnosis and treatment must be initiated as soon as feasible. The primary purpose of this research is to detect the existence or absence of CKD in the human body by analyzing a number of features obtained from a few medical tests. This research presents an ML-CKDP model that aims to improve dataset preprocessing for CKD classification and provide a web-based application for prediction. The proposed model includes a full data pretreatment protocol for transforming categorical variables to numerical values, imputing missing data, and normalizing using Min-Max scaling. To improve the datasets, a variety of techniques are used, including correlation, chi-squared, variance threshold, recursive feature elimination, sequential forward selection, lasso regression, and ridge regression. To predict CKD, the model uses four classifiers: K-Neighbors (KNC), Random Forest Classifiers (RFC), XgBoost (XgB), and Gausian Naive Bayes (GNB). The models' effectiveness is evaluated by testing their accuracy, examining the confusion matrix, and computing the Precision, Recall, F1 score, and support. In contrast to other algorithms performing on the same dataset, K-Neighbors classifiers (KNC) achieve an 89% accuracy rate, Random Forest Classifiers (RFC) and Gausian Naive Bayes (GNB) produce an 87% accuracy rate, and XgBoost (XgB) achieve a 99% accuracy rate to predict CKDs. The XgBoost classifier has the highest performance indicators. This study concludes that current advances in machine learning, as well as the use of predictive modeling.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator
Author Keywords: Machine Learning - Chronic kidney disease Prediction(ML-CKDP)

articleTitle: A Smart RFID Based Automatic Toll Booth Management System Using Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Internet of Things Technologies
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This work presents a Smart RFID-based Automatic Toll Booth Management System utilizing a Hybrid ResNetSVM model and IoT technologies to automate vehicle identification, classification, and toll payment. The system integrates an Impinj Speedway R420 RFID reader for automatic vehicle detection and a hybrid ResNet-50 and SVM model for real-time vehicle classification. By deploying IoT-enabled devices, such as Raspberry Pi and ESP8266, and connecting to cloud platforms like AWS IoT, the system efficiently processes vehicle data, facilitating seamless toll transactions. The RFID system achieved an impressive detection accuracy of 98% at vehicle speeds under 80 km/h. However, at higher speeds, detection accuracy decreased to 75% at 200 km/h. The hybrid ResNetSVM model performed exceptionally well, achieving an average vehicle classification accuracy of 95.5% across different vehicle types, including cars, trucks, and buses. System throughput was tested with traffic volumes of up to 50 vehicles per minute, maintaining a transaction success rate of 95.5% under heavy traffic conditions. This system not only reduces toll booth congestion and human intervention but also provides secure and automated toll payment options, utilizing payment gateways such as Stripe, UPI, and PayPal with success rates over 99%. Overall, this smart toll management system improves efficiency and user experience through the use of advanced technologies.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Techniques for the Automated Identification of Legal Non-Compliance in Online Terms of Service
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Due to the complexity of ToSs, it becomes difficult to meet legal requirements for ToSs because of GPA and CCPA among other jurisdictions. For this reason, this research has suggested the development of a machine learning model consisting of both SVM and Bi-directional Long Short-Term Memory (Bi-LSTM) for the identification of ToS non-compliance. The model uses linear and sequential functions for pattern reconstruction, which mitigates the complexity that legal language and the difference between jurisdictions may pose. When tested on multiple jurisdiction data this presented an accuracy of 88.8%, a precision of 91.5% and recall of 87.5<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>, an Fl-measure of 89.4, and an AUC ROC value of 0.92. The mutant one proposed method was found to be accurate by 12% more than the other models and was 15% more precise in comparison to other models. This makes it suitable for online use given that compliance can be monitored in real time with feedback. It is apparent from this analysis that the proposed model works well on a legal-noncompliant detection platform providing a strong platform for improved regulation of services offered online.

articleTitle: Anomaly Detection in Power Distribution Networks with Unsupervised Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The identification of anomalies in power distribution networks is a critical component in ensuring the reliability and stability of energy systems. This investigation aims to find anomalous patterns and vulnerabilities within applications used for power grids by examining how unsupervised literacy algorithms function. Because conventional monitoring techniques typically miss subtle or developing irregularities, unsupervised procedures are especially helpful. This is a result of unsupervised routine monitoring techniques. We create algorithms that can learn from unlabeled data to identify departures from the standard geste. To create these models, some methods are applied, including insulating timbers, autoencoders, and k-means clustering. It is possible to test these methods using data from the global power distribution system and assess how well they relate to abnormalities such as equipment failures, power outages, and unexpected consumption patterns. The purpose of this examination is to ascertain the practicality of certain styles. Results show that algorithms for unsupervised literacy can provide rapid and accurate discovery, lower the danger of network failures, and increase the effectiveness of functional activities. Furthermore, these algorithms can increase the effectiveness of functional processes. The study's findings provide insight into the possibility of using machine literacy to improve the sustainability and adaptability of cutting-edge electricity distribution networks.

articleTitle: A Secured and Lightweight Document Handling Procedure Using Blockchain Assisted Decentralized Data Manipulation Strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Managing data encompasses gathering, analyzing, storing and disseminating information. These days, multi-partner firms can't function without data sharing and collaborative data processing, which are essential for finding fresh insights. The majority of the time, institutions share data for institutional decision-making, advertising, and marketing purposes. The problem is that organizations share the data obtained, which mostly concerns individuals called data subjects or producers, without obtaining their meaningful consent. This means that those whose data is being used or misused have no idea what's going on. Data subjects also have little control over who outside organizations can access their information. In this work, we argued that data management should aim to gain the confidence of people whose information is being processed. Data subjects should be able to access and understand their data in order to do this. Lightweight Decentralized Data Manipulation Strategy (LDDMS) is a cloud-based data management and sharing platform that allows data subjects to choose who may access their data and consent to its collection and utilization using smart contracts. In order to determine how effective the suggested method is, it is cross-validated with the standard document processing technique known as Intelligent File Handling System (IFHS). Database mismatches are a common problem, but this method fixes them. The reliability and accuracy of data management are greatly enhanced by our system's exceptional performance in critical areas including data security, information verification, and error traceback. We provide a robust LDDMS as a future-proof answer to the problem of safe and effective educational data management.

articleTitle: Dynamic Hand Gesture Recognition and Real-Time Utterance Generation for Virtual Assistants Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: A novel virtual assistant machine learning approach based on the study is known as dynamic hand gesture recognition using real-time vocal generation. This single method solution for the same uses a deep learning model CNN, which actually recognizes the real-time hands and maps that to recognize the real-time vocal generator with the training of models that produce responses that are pertinent to context by using this gesture data. This system attempts to allow for the creation of logical, spoken responses through natural, instinctive communications by decoding gestures such as volume control requests, play, and stop. Accuracy was improved in gesture recognition as well as the latency of generating a response in order to satisfy the requirement of real-time interaction with a system latency of 100 ms and a high rate of 94% for the identification of gestures. In a nutshell, it has been proved that the method proposed reaches the goal of communication simplification and diversification for virtual assistants and it also shows how gesture-based interaction might replace text or voice commands in specific contexts.

articleTitle: A Novel Human Face Expression Recognition Based on Image Processing Assisted Convoluted Deep Learning Methodology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Facial expression recognition has become a critical component in applications involving human-computer interaction, security systems, and behavioral analysis. This paper presents a novel approach to human face expression recognition using a convoluted deep learning methodology supported by image processing techniques. The system is designed to accurately classify seven fundamental emotions—Anger, Disgust, Fear, Happy, Sadness, Surprise, and Neutral—using the FER2013 dataset. The methodology includes preprocessing steps such as noise reduction, grayscale conversion, and face registration. Feature extraction is performed using Gabor filters and Local Binary Patterns (LBP), while Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) are employed to learn deep hierarchical features. The system was optimized through hyperparameter tuning, achieving an overall accuracy of 96.29% on the test set. Precision, recall, and F1-scores for each emotion also exceeded 95%, with “Happy” and “Surprise” emotions showing the best performance. The results indicate that the model is effective for real-time applications requiring reliable emotion detection. The paper concludes with discussions on model performance, challenges in classifying similar emotions, and recommendations for future improvements.

articleTitle: Exploring Sustainable Consumer Behavior Among Women Educators in West Cochin Using ML and Social Media Analytics
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The study uses social media analytics and Machine Learning (ML) to examine sustainable consumer behavior among West Cochin women teachers. Particularly in sustainability, traditional approaches include polls and interviews suffer from temporal limits and biassed sample, therefore impeding real-time insights into consumer trends. Using natural language processing (NLP) for sentiment analysis and clustering for behavioral segmentation, the proposed system analyses enormous amounts of unstructured social media data using advanced ML techniques. The results show notable developments over existing systems: a sentiment analysis accuracy of 90.0%, clustering efficacy with a Silhouette score of 0.65, and predictive model performance with an accuracy of 85.0%. These results show the capacity of the proposed system to offer better understanding of sustainable customer behavior, so enabling focused marketing plans and a more environmentally friendly market.

articleTitle: ML Techniques for Employee Performance Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: When it comes to maximizing the effectiveness of a business and promoting professional growth, employee performance prediction is an extremely important factor. This research article investigates the use of machine learning (ML) approaches to forecast employee performance, with a particular emphasis on the incorporation of different algorithms from different sources to improve accuracy and dependability. Methods that have been used for a long time, such as linear regression and decision trees, are evaluated alongside more recent approaches, such as ensemble methods and deep learning. To refine the prediction models, our research makes use of approaches such as feature selection and dimensionality reduction. These techniques are utilized by utilizing previous performance data, demographic information, and behavioral indicators. It has been demonstrated through the analysis that sophisticated machine learning techniques, in particular ensemble and deep learning models, are superior to traditional methods when it comes to anticipating employee performance. Our findings offer HR departments concrete insights that can be used to adopt data-driven methods for performance management, which will eventually contribute to improved organizational outcomes and increased employee satisfaction. This paper offers opportunities for future development in predictive analytics within the field of human resources and emphasizes the potential of machine learning to alter performance evaluation systems.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Cost-Sensitive and Feature Reweighting Approach for Improved Crop Recommendation Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Accurate crop recommendation plays a crucial role in every agriculture-based country. Such recommendations are vital in regions where the choice of crops is affected in particular by several environmental factors. Recent trends and the techniques developed in machine learning often face challenges viz., class imbalance, where a few crops impact the dataset and the feature importance, that refers to certain environmental factors having an influence on the choice of crops than other several dependent factors. In this context, this paper proposes an innovative Hybrid Cost-Sensitive Support Vector Machine (SVM) model that uses Permutation-Based Feature Reweighting to handle both of these issues. The proposed model is tested and validated using the Kaggle Crop Recommendation Dataset, that contains 22 different crop types and 7 features of environment. To handle any class imbalance that arise due to unforeseen reasons this paper proposes a cost sensitive SVM, which use weighting technique to the most common crops, resulting in enhancement of the accuracy in prediction. Based on the enhanced experimentations a permutation-based feature re-weighting is suggested considering the environmental parameters such as pH and rainfall that effects the model accuracy and interpretability. Results show that the proposed technique achieve a precision of 97.73% and recall of 98.25% and F1-Score 97.81%, outperforming all the existing benchmarks.

articleTitle: AI-Driven CASGN Framework for Evaluating Descriptive Answers in Online Education
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: There is an enormous demand for automated assessment systems, which can handle the bulk assessments efficiently and effectively. While existing systems perform well in grading objective questions, they break down with subjective or descriptive answers that require a deeper analysis of context and understanding. To address this challenge, we have proposed the AI-Enhanced Context-Aware Semantic Grading Network-state-of-the-art algorithm for instant auto-descriptive response scoring in e-assessments. The AI-CASGN utilizes state-of-the-art AI technologies, particularly NLP and deep learning models-very specifically transformer architectures-during context-based semantic analysis. Beyond mere keyword matching, the system scores what students say and how relevant it is. This takes the concept of grading to an even more fine-tuned art. Scores change with depth and accuracy in the answer given to show complete evaluation. With the dynamic grading framework, adaptation on scores both regarding the accuracy and depth of the answer for a precise evaluation is possible. Inbuilt adaptive learning within the system performance evolves day by day by learning from the new data. AI-CASGN is designed to handle biases in mitigation by considering that there may be different patterns for a response to ensure that responses with varied wording but conceptually correct are fairly graded. It will have to deal with the volumes at scale, hence it is envisaged to process large volumes of responses in minimum time and with high accuracy to be deployed in real time in any educational institution. In future, the system will also provide personalized feedback to students for the purpose of continuous learning and improvement. This represents a scalable, real-time, unbiased tool that assesses subjective answers in modern online learning environments.

articleTitle: Automated Diabetic Retinopathy Detection and Multi-Stage Classification Using Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This paper presents an automated classification and identification of diabetic retinopathy (DR) based on CNNs. The model identifies four types of DR: no DR, moderate DR, severe non-proliferative DR, and proliferative DR. The model was trained and tested after preprocessing procedures applied to it in order to improve image quality and remove noise from the public dataset, famous for this purpose. Segmentation of the categorization process into two phases reduces complexity and increases accuracy. The proposed model achieved a class accuracy of 89.7<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> and achieved a sensitivity level of 92.1%, greater than any other methodologies reported in the literature so far. The approach provides clinicians with a more accurate method to detect DR that can lead to improved patient outcomes in the long term.

articleTitle: Experimental Analysis of Learning Based Approach to Evaluate the Integration of Social Networking Platform with Internet of Things Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Enterprising entrepreneurs are forging a new paradigm for consumer-business interactions by leveraging the convergence of social networking platforms-such as Facebook and Twitter-and the Internet of Things (IoT). This paper aims to assess an integration pipeline's performance using a learning based approach. Our aim is to understand the complex interplay between data that has been collected from IoT and how social media users act using advanced methods in data analytics. Our approach involves gathering data from both SNPs and the Internet of Things (IoT) and pre-processing it as needed before building a model that can be predicted and its performance evaluated. As opposed to the proposed method Elevated Social Networking Integration (ESNI) is a better strategy than the existing Social Networking Integration Analyzer (SNIA), which permits collecting less information through connected devices to enhance decision-making on consumer behavior and encounters. By offering a methodical approach to evaluating the value proposition of combining IoT with SNP, this study adds to the corpus of knowledge. The framework facilitates seamless interaction across diverse social media platforms, optimizing data flow and user experience. Empirical testing demonstrates ESNI's effectiveness in boosting engagement metrics and user satisfaction compared to conventional integration methods. This research highlights ESNI's potential to redefine social networking strategies, providing a robust foundation for future innovations in digital communication and marketing.

articleTitle: Computer Vision for Economic Activity Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: One of the most creative methods for real-time economic pattern analysis and interpretation is the use of computer vision in economic activity monitoring. The purpose of this study is to investigate computer vision technologies and assess their potential for automating the collection and analysis of visual data. If they did, it would allow for quicker and more accurate evaluations of economic activity. This study demonstrates how computer vision may be used to track several economic indicators, such as retail sales, the growth of infrastructure, and agricultural productivity. This is achieved through the use of complex algorithms for image recognition, pattern analysis, and object detection. The study highlights the benefits of using computer vision in place of more conventional data collection methods. Its effectiveness, scalability, and ability to provide thorough insights into the operation of the economic system are a few of these benefits. The purpose of this research is to demonstrate how computer vision can enhance decision-making processes for businesses and policymakers by giving them a better knowledge of patterns of economic activity. With the aid of case studies and experimental evaluations, this work was effectively finished. These results should be considered since they could have significant effects on how better policy planning and economic forecasting are done.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Transportation Management System with Driver Performance Evaluation Using Random Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Several public transportation services in the Philippines, such as the Transport Service Multi-Purpose Cooperative, still rely on paper records and basic tools. This leads to difficulties with data management, transit operation, and monitoring driver performance. To address these issues, this study developed a Comprehensive Transportation Management System with Driver Performance Evaluation to improve operational efficiency and service quality. Web technologies were employed to provide functionalities such as driver management, vehicle management, scheduling, dispatching, finance management, reporting, feedback systems, data visualization and driver portal. Additionally, a machine-learning Random Forest algorithm was integrated for evaluating driver performance, achieving 91% accuracy. Following the implementation of the system, an assessment was conducted using the ISO 25010 quality model, with feedback collected from 10 administrators and 70 drivers. The results demonstrated strong performance across key quality attributes. Functional Suitability received a score of 4.67, classified as “Very Satisfied,” while Performance Efficiency followed closely with a mean score of 4.65, which was also rated as “Very Satisfied.” Reliability achieved the highest satisfaction with a mean score of 4.75, maintaining the “Very Satisfied” classification. While still positive, Security received a lower score of 4.49, classified as “Satisfied.” Overall, the system scored 4.64 out of 5.00, reflecting an overall rating of “Very Satisfied.” The results imply that the study introduced significant innovations to the Pandacan Transport Service Multi-Purpose Cooperative.

articleTitle: Quantum-Enhanced Spiking Neural Networks for Closed-Loop Neuromodulation Systems: A Theoretically Advanced Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Over one billion people worldwide are affected with neurological disorders and their economic impact is approximately $800 billion annually, which constitutes major medical challenge. Using neuromodulation systems currently available suffers from sensitivity, reaction time as well as energy consumption. The proposal in this research is to address these major issues in closed loop neuromodulation by using a Quantum enhanced Spiking Neural Network (QESNN) architecture. This paper represents the interfacing of two major fields: quantum sensing and neuromorphic computing. The QESNN architecture comprises three core components: This is implemented as an array of quantum sensors, a quantum classical hybrid interface, and a spiking neural network (SNN). Taking advantage of quantum superposition and entanglement principles, the quantum sensor array noninvasively images neural activity at the level of single action potentials using NV centers. These sensors work at ambient temperatures, which is unlike superconducting devices. For processing with neuromorphic processing, quantum-classical hybrid converts quantum sensor data into classical signals with advanced signal process such as quantum state estimation and noise reduction. By modeling biological neurons with leaky integrate and fire neurons, the SNN serves as a low power, timed neural dynamics modulation component that emulates biological event driven behavior. A key innovation in our architecture is adaptive thresholding, which dynamically adjusts detection thresholds based on signal distributions, improving sensitivity and reducing false positives by 45.6%. The system also achieves 20-30% higher power efficiency through techniques like adaptive sensor frequency control and low-power processing. Simulation results that show how the QESNN performs better than classical systems with less false positives and greater energy efficiency are presented. A new platform is demonstrated that integrates quantum sensing with neuromorphic computing, providing a novel method enabling significant improvement of precision and efficiency in neuromodulation therapy for neurological disorders. As a future tool for our understanding of neuroscience, quantum technology and biomedical engineering, the QESNN framework has the potential for large societal impact.

articleTitle: Implementation of Yolo-Based Object Detection and Sensor Integration Model for Visually Challenged Person
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: It is suggested that visually impaired individuals use an assistive device to receive automatic direction and navigation. The gadget may provide obstacle-free navigation and use real-time image processing to detect impediments. The goal of the strategy is to maximise information flow by completing all activities in real-time and gathering all the information regarding path impediments. The suggested navigation stick is an inexpensive item, obstacle, and obstacle identifier. For safety and navigation, the suggested assistance system for the blind makes use of cutting-edge technology such as tilt and ultrasonic sensors, as well as YOLO(YouOnly Look Once) object recognition. It updates its location via GPS, haptic feedback, and real-time object detection. The user interface is independent and accessible through non-visual means. The suggested work focuses on a multi-label method for detecting items in indoor and outdoor settings utilising vision technology. It improves accuracy and cuts down on recognition time by using classification and clustering techniques.

articleTitle: Design and Development of an Intelligent Student Learning Prediction Model using Enhanced Deep Learning Principles
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The Intelligent Student Learning Prediction Model using Enhanced Deep Learning Principles (EDLP) platform is a major leap in the domain at the intersection of educational technology and artificial intelligence. We present a new, predictive model that combines AlexNet (a state-of-the-art convolutional neural network architecture for image recognition) with a very deep DNN tailored to analyze diverse data types from traditional academic records as well as complex input based on pictures. By taking advantage of these strengths-high-precision image-based feature extraction using AlexNet, and comprehensive data analysis with a DNN-the EDLP model is designed to make the most accurate predictions yet regarding student learning outcomes.Our research provides a comprehensive description of the methodologies used to develop the EDLP model, which includes data preprocessing, feature engineering, and their articulation with machine learning technologies. This is importantly on application of the model instituted a prediction rate of 97.6%, which indeed marked a prompted potential revolution in educational assessment and personalized learning strategies. This level of predictive accuracy, despite being more oriented towards the very effective profiling and prediction of the needs of a single student, places more emphasis on the great value the model offers as a tool to help educators and policy-makers be effective in improving teaching and learning. Thus, the implications of EDLP also relate not only to its ability to predict academic performance but are equally important regarding learning success-influencing factors as well as related intervention strategies.

articleTitle: Unveiling Textile Defects a Novel Fabric Defect Identification Based on Integrated Image Processing with Logical Learning Scheme
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: When it comes to controlling the quality of the cloth that is produced, defect identification is a crucial step. Considering the inefficiency and length of time wasted by human fabric defect detection methods, it would be more efficient to use computer vision technology to automatically detect fabric problems. This would allow manufacturers to better meet their demands. Recent years have seen a surge in interest in the topic of fabric defect identification as a result of the increasing cost of labour and the rapid development of automation within the textile industry. For the purpose of automated fabric flaw identification, we presented a learning-based methodology. We start by cropping the original image to a specific size and shape using a square slider. All of the cropped images are subsequently enhanced using improved histogram equalization. This work primarily aims to create a system called Logical Learning Scheme for Fabric Defect Detection (LLSFDD) that uses image processing techniques for simple and efficient defect detection and classification. To test how well the model works, it is cross-validated with a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). Weft and warp threads that are missing, as well as oil stains and holes, are the most common types of flaws found. The four-step process is the basis of the system. It starts with taking the picture, then uses image analysis to remove parasitic details and make the picture sharper. Afterwards, find the rates of straight lines, dark regions, and voids; these three metrics will describe the flaws that were previously indicated. Lastly, utilise a suggested model, the Logical Learning Scheme for Fabric problem Detection, to identify the kind of fabric problem.

articleTitle: Hybrid Optimization for Enhanced Retinal Image Classification Using Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The present study proposes a hybrid optimization algorithm that involves the integration of Neural Networks (NN), Genetic Algorithms(GA), and Particle Swarm Optimization(PSO) to improve the accuracy and efficiency of retinal image analysis. First, a wide range of features are extracted from retinal images and normalized. Then a NN is constructed with its weights and biases initialized to process these features. The fitness of each feature subset is measured with the help of a network's output, quantified by a Mean Squared Error(MSE)-based fitness function. Receiving fitness values, the GA component picks out the most important subsets of features, which are refined with crossover and mutation operations to retain diversity and improve the search process. In a parallel process, PSO dynamically adjusts the position of particles representing subsets of features through modification of velocity and position vectors under the influences of cognition and society. With the proposed integrated approach, iteratively, an optimal feature subset is generated by minimizing error and maximizing classification performance. Finally, after convergence, this last optimized subset of features is used in the final tuning of the NN to achieve a far-reaching improvement in the accuracy of classification. This method takes advantage of the complementary strengths of NN, GA, and PSO; therefore, it is able to provide an effective solution for the optimization of features within medical image analysis.

articleTitle: Tech Meets Agriculture - Precise Plant Disease Detection Using Deep Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Plant disease prediction is crucial aspect of agricultural field. Plant diseases are one of the major concerns for agriculture in recent times; most of the crops are prone to damage caused by these diseases, which later hampers global food security. The traditional methods used for disease analysis rely strictly on visual inspection. These methods are time-consuming and prone to errors. Deep learning has therefore emerged as a significant and formidable instrument for the automation of plant disease detection. This project uses the deep learning models, YOLOv5 and YOLOv9. It ranks high on accuracy and ensures efficiency in the system to detect diseases related to plant leaves. It uses annotated datasets for several plant leaf diseases with a convolutional neural network to extractfeatures and enable classification. The system provides real-time automated solutions for the identification of plant diseases through the integration of deep learning models into agricultural practices, with a view to allowing growers to take timely action to avoid further damage to crops. The proposed technique not only heightens the rate of accuracy for disease detection but also contributes toward the growing dimension of precision agriculture, within which technology acts as an assistant in the optimization of crop management and enhancement of yield.

articleTitle: Revolutioning Healthcare: A Superficial Learning Approach to Predict Heart Diseases by Using Artificial Intelligence (AI) Logic
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The prevalence of cardiovascular illnesses is on the rise, making early disease prediction all the more crucial and worrisome. Making this diagnosis is no easy feat; it requires speed and accuracy. The primary objective of the study article is to identify the patient subset most at risk for cardiovascular disease using a battery of medical diagnostic criteria. By analyzing the patient's medical history, we developed a technique to forecast the likelihood of a heart disease diagnosis. Clinical decision support systems have made extensive use of AI approaches for the accurate prediction and diagnosis of a wide range of disorders. Here, we present Superficial Neural Health Learning (SNHL), an AI-based method for accurate heart disease prediction, and we cross-validate it with K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN), a traditional learning method, to see how well it works. Many of the observable risk factors are shared by heart disease patients and can be utilized to make a good diagnosis. A system that takes these risk factors into account might be useful for both doctors and patients; it could alert them to the possibility of heart disease before they incur the expenses associated with unnecessary hospital visits or expensive checkups. In order to diagnose and categorize the patient with cardiac illness, we employed various deep learning algorithms, including KNN and SNHL. In order to control the model's applicability and enhance the accuracy of heart attack prediction in any person, a very helpful technique was applied. When compared to earlier classifiers like naïve bayes, etc., the suggested model's strength in predicting if a person has heart disease using KNN and SNHL was rather satisfying. Applying the provided model to determine the classifier's likelihood of correctly and precisely identifying the heart condition has thus relieved a considerable amount of strain. Both the quality and affordability of medical treatment are improved by the given heart disease prediction system and it is easy to learn a lot about which people are likely to have heart disease from this method.

articleTitle: Mixed Reality Learning System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: A Virtual Trainer based on MR technology represents a quantum leap in immersive training. Integrating the hardware and software elements, a Virtual Trainer could offer its clients an unprecedented opportunity to participate in highly realistic simulations in a wide range of training scenarios. The environments themselves also are visually realistic and dynamically sensitive, updating in real time to reflect user activity. Most critical is the Virtual Trainer provides for immediate feedback on a user's performance. It does this through the use of computer vision algorithms and motion tracking sensors which analyze the performed actions to give tailored advice. This real-time feedback makes the learning process more effective since it allows a user to iteratively improve both their methods and abilities. The Virtual Trainer also adapts its coaching style according to the client's preferences and level of ability, ensuring a fully customized. It can actually train each of the users with a good learning environment in all subjects and simulations to perform various things from the most complex thinking to physical training for users. In addition, performance analytics enriches the training process because it allows users to monitor their development as well as detect areas where one can improve over time. Training sessions are no longer a one-way passive endeavor because of the social and collaborative elements built into the Virtual Trainer. Elements, contributing to an enhanced sense of motivation and engagement. In general, virtual trainers in MR technology represent a milestone development in the realisation of new approaches to learning and skill acquisition and training.

articleTitle: Safety Reinvented Fabrication of Glass Cleaning Robot to Enhance Residential Safety Measures
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Using its pneumatic suction cups, this little window climbing robot should be able to clean and wash a pretty big area of outdoor office windows on high-rise buildings without human intervention. The robot will autonomously clean the room's windows in a predetermined pattern after being manually connected to the outer surface of the window. This study presents the results of an investigation into the potential of a robot called the Modular Glass Cleaning Robot (MGCR) to aid in the cleaning process. The suggested scheme's efficacy will be assessed by cross-validating it with the standard model known as the Conventional Glass Cleaning Robot (CGCR). One kind of robot that has recently evolved is the window cleaner. No matter the size of your building, this robot can find a job here. The primary objective is to develop a robot capable of swiftly and effectively cleaning glass windows, regardless of the location's inherent dangers. Hubbot, a robotic structure, is developed by this system. A combination of linear and rotational movements, as well as the ability to extend and retract the legs and avoid obstacles, will be accomplished. Its construction is both basic and lightweight. To simplify things, instead of a multi-joint legged moving structure, we'll see a hub and a few symmetrical legs. From a weight-saving standpoint, a hanging, reversible motor drives a rack and pinion gear. Furthermore, three distinct bearing configurations demonstrate a structural optimization of the rotating mechanism. Finding the optimal one that both keeps the robot's cost down and guarantees the shaft's stiffness is the goal. Lastly, the exploded picture of the entire structure is provided, along with a functional embodiment design that includes three mechanisms: adhesion, actuation, and movement. The detailed sequence formulations of the four movements are indicated. The designed robot is lightweight, small size and cheap because it is driven only by one rotary actuator and system of properly arranged conventional belts and pulleys. It detects the window frame using a series of optical sensors and suction cups that adhere to the window glass. Based on the data collected by the sensors, the microcontroller is programmed to direct the robot's movements in a predetermined pattern. So far, there are no competitive items on the market that are similarly priced.

articleTitle: A Robust Artificial Intelligence Enabled Methodology to Predict Online Consumers Behaviour Using Hybrid Deep Learning Strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Marketing and consumer behavior predictions are two areas where Artificial Intelligence (AI) is finding widespread use. Evaluating the accuracy of AI -based consumer behavior prediction is the focus of this article. Evidence from research in this area suggests that AI can help sift through mountains of data pertaining to customer performance. It includes looking at things like customer surveys, purchasing history, and behaviour. Furthermore, this sector may make use of deep learning techniques for consumer behavior forecasting. All sorts of advertising and marketing choices can benefit from this data. The Hybrid Learning for Behavioral Prediction (HLBP) method, first proposed in this study, integrates AI -assisted learning with categorization logic for processing. In order to assess the efficacy of the suggested program, this model is cross-validated with the traditional learning model known as Recurrent Neural Network (RNN). Even more encouraging is the possibility that AI can aid businesses in fine-tuning their advertising strategies. As a result, advertising may be more precisely targeted, and marketing budgets can be more efficiently used. Here, AI in a marketing context may provide customized experiences for consumers, such making better product recommendations and enhancing the shopping experience overall. In order to maximize the effectiveness of online advertising efforts, artificial intelligence can be employed. This research delves into the potential of artificial neural networks to identify customer behavior utilizing data collected from conventional surveys. Neural networks outperform classical discriminant analysis in most cases, demonstrating their strong discriminate potential.

articleTitle: Performance Enhancement using Q-Learning and Dynamic Clustering in Internet of Things Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: A comprehensive framework termed QLDC-IoT, integrating machine learning and dynamic clustering to optimize connectivity and resource allocation in dense High Wireless Connectivity Network (HWCN) environments. Leveraging Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) classification models enhances handover decision-making processes in heterogeneous mmWave and LTE networks. Moreover, an adaptive clustering model using the K-Means Clustering effectively distributes resources and oversees connectivity in compact wireless networks. Through rigorous experimentation in the ns3 simulation environment, the QLDC-IoT framework demonstrates notable enhancements in data success rate, loss mitigation, delay reduction, throughput optimization, and routing efficiency, offering valuable insights for protocol design and implementation in diverse (Internet of Things) IoT applications. The research contributes to advancing IoT technologies, addressing challenges in connectivity, resource management, and network efficiency to support the future development of connected communities.

articleTitle: BrewBooze: Barista and Bartender Drinks Simulator Integrated with Business Cost Prediction Using Multiple Linear Regression
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This research aimed to develop an innovative system that simulates the creation of barista and bartender beverages, enhances customer satisfaction through personalized coffee and cocktail flavor recommendations, and predicts startup costs for cafés. The system uses 3D models to guide users through beverage-making processes, and the GPT OpenAI API powers its flavor recommendation engine for accuracy and personalization. Additionally, multiple linear regression was employed to provide entrepreneurs with a detailed cost breakdown based on their capital and the year of establishment. BrewBooze was evaluated through a survey using Google Forms, having IT professionals, baristas, bartenders, and general consumers as their respondents. Half of the respondents drink their coffee/cocktail more than three times a week and only a quarter of them do not know the process of making it. Results have also shown that people are satisfied with the coffee/cocktail they are ordering and for the entrepreneurial side, most respondents prefer to have a capital of less than a million pesos, making it insufficient for starting a café. The ISO 25010 software quality model assessed the system, focusing on functional suitability, reliability, performance efficiency, and usability. The results returned a very satisfactory score, indicating that BrewBooze effectively simulates beverages, provides accurate flavor recommendations, and predicts startup costs, making it a valuable tool for both consumers and aspiring café owners.

articleTitle: Feature Selection in Learning to Rank for Listwise Approach using Multiobjective Evolutionary Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Information retrieval systems commonly depend on ranking models to prioritize search results, which requires efficient feature selection to improve accuracy. Feature selection improves the model's query relevance ranking by selecting the most relevant features. This unique method avoids diluting the ranking model with unnecessary variables, resulting in more accurate ranks. The proposed approach consists of three separate stages: multi-objective instance selection, feature selection, and ensemble method. By utilizing a listwise methodology, the algorithm directly enhances the optimization of ranking criteria resulting in enhanced performance. The effectiveness of FS-listwise was evaluated using standardized datasets. After conducting experiments, results shown that the proposed method have peak performance than MOFSRank and classical ranking algorithms, such as ListNet and LambdaMART, in terms of Normalized Discounted Cumulative Gain and consistently selecting a minimal yet highly effective feature set.

articleTitle: Efficient Routing Using Improved Ant Colony Optimization for Vehicular Communication in Urban Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: VANET is crucial for the progress of smart city transportation, allowing immediate communication between vehicles. However, the dynamic and fast-changing nature of VANETs presents significant challenges in routing efficiency. This paper introduces an Enhanced Routing with Improved Ant Colony Optimization (ERIACO) Approach to address these challenges. ERIACO leverages ACO for optimal route discovery, adapting to the dynamic network topology. Additionally, the approach incorporates Effective Link Prediction to preemptively manage potential link failures, enhancing network reliability. Through comprehensive ns3 network simulations, the performance of the ERIACO is assessed according to essential metrics including data delivery ratio, network throughput, routing overhead, energy efficiency, and energy consumption. Comparative analysis with existing methods, including IORDM, ITDMP, and OPRPW, demonstrates the superior efficiency and effectiveness of ERIACO in VANET environments. The results showcase that ERIACO achieves significantly higher data delivery rates, network throughput, and energy efficiency, making it a promising solution for the optimization of VANET routing and communication.

Author Keywords: Enhanced Routing with Improved Ant Colony Optimization (ERIACO)

articleTitle: Real-Time Video Analytics DL Solutions for Traffic Monitoring and Crowd Management
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The escalating opacity of metropolitan environments necessitates cutting-edge remedies for traffic oversight and group administration. Conventional schemes depend heavily on functionary observations and heuristic algorithms, guiding to inadequacies, lofty false-positive rates, and lethargic happening reactions. In contrast, the recommended deep studying-centered organization leverages real-time video analytics employing Convolutional Neural Network (CNNs), You Only Look Once (YOLO) for article discovery and LSTMs for temporal sample examination. The integration heightens the accuracy and speed of episode identification, reaching a remarkable 90% precision compared to present schemes' maximal of 78%. The scheme distinguishes traffic infractions and crowd surges in as minuscule as 2–4 seconds, substantially decreasing reaction times. Furthermore, its scalable structure permits deployment all over various urban contexts, confirming adaptability and improved community protection. Performance metrics affirm the scheme's better effectiveness in real-time analytics, establishing it as a pivotal progression over conventional tactics.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis in Social Media Using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This work offers a thorough investigation of sentiment analysis in social media using deep learning techniques. Understanding stoner sentiment has become essential for colourful operations like marketing, public opinion research, and recommendation algorithms due to the rapid expansion of social media networks. Deep learning approaches have emerged as crucial tools for sentiment analysis tasks because of their capacity to extract intricate patterns from massive datasets. The usefulness of deep learning models, such as convolutional neural networks (RNNs), and intermittent neural networks (RNNs), and their variations, in extracting complex sentiment information from social media textbooks is investigated in this study. Additionally, the study looks at model infrastructures, point representations, and pre-processing techniques to improve sentiment analysis performance. The results show how effective deep learning techniques are in extracting sentiment directly from various social media posts, opening the door for more sophisticated sentiment-apprehensive digital processes

articleTitle: An Advanced Autoencoder-Based Approach to Anomaly Detection for Video Surveillance Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This paper attempts to give a state-of-the-art machine learning anomaly detection in video surveillance using the application of autoencoders. The use of video surveillance ensures safety and security in places like public spaces, office buildings, and homes. However, with the multiple cameras present, monitoring various video feeds is quite demanding and, thus, predisposed to human error or inefficiency when dealing with large environments. The single critical feature that will serve to automate this process pertains to identifying unusual events or behavior. The proposed system relies on an autoencoder neural network model for learning patterns of normal behavior in video streams. The UCSD, a diverse dataset containing surveillance videos, was used to train and test the system. Preprocessing of video data includes frame extraction, resizing, and normalization, followed by feeding into the model. It mainly consists of two parts, namely an encoder that compresses the input data and a decoder that reconstructs the input from the compressed representation. The reconstruction error is then calculated by comparing the original and reconstructed frames. The frames with high reconstruction errors are flagged as containing anomalies. This system shows a high level of accuracy measured in terms of precision and recall. In addition to real-time anomaly detection, the system offers visual feedback to the user regarding which frames are anomalous and can be further inspected. The experiment results demonstrate how the model is robust against vast and complex environments. The proposed system extends a reliable, highly scalable, and flexible solution for smart surveillance, reducing constant human supervision, and improving the speed of response to security threats. More work will go into enhancing the system so that it can better deal with subtler anomalies and generalize to larger datasets for ultimate deployment.

articleTitle: Exploring the Effectiveness of Artificial Intelligence in Transforming Future of Digital Marketing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Within the scope of this exploratory research, the revolutionary impact that Artificial Intelligence (AI) will have on the future of digital marketing is thoroughly investigated. As digital marketing continues to rapidly advance, artificial intelligence technologies are playing an increasingly important role in improving marketing strategies and issues. The purpose of this study is to investigate the various AI operations that are revolutionizing how organizations interact with their target cult. These operations include machine literacy algorithms, natural language processing, and prophetic analytics. We highlight critical areas where artificial intelligence contributes to further proven, effective, and data-drivenmarketing juggernauts by doing a complete analysis of the current literature and case studies. This research also investigates the difficulties and ethical concerns that are involved with the incorporation of artificial intelligence into digital marketing strategies. The facts that we have obtained highlight the possibility that artificial intelligence can not only improve marketing procedures but also propel innovation and expansion in the digital geography. Following the conclusion of the investigation, strategic recommendations are provided for the application of artificial intelligence to future-proof marketing sweats and to keep a competitive advantage in a world that is becoming increasingly digital.

articleTitle: Machine Learning for Signal Processing in Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The traditional styles of signal processing are passing constraints in their capability to handle the different and dynamic character of ultramodern data transfers. This is because communication systems are getting increasingly complicated. The operation of machine literacy presents a potentially useful answer since it enables data-driven, adaptive approaches that have the eventuality to ameliorate signal processing performance. This composition provides a comprehensive examination of a variety of machine literacy ways and their operations in important disciplines such as modulation recognition, noise reduction, channel estimation, and signal discovery. The study demonstrates how machine literacy ways may vastly increase the effectiveness, delicacy, and robustness of signal-processing tasks in communication systems. This is fulfilled through detailed analysis and comparison. With the help of machine literacy, unborn communication systems will be suitable to attain advanced situations of robotization and intelligence, which will pave the way for further developments in areas similar to wireless dispatches, the Internet of Effects(IoT), and other areas. In light of these findings, it's clear that machine literacy can fully transfigure assiduity by furnishing new shoes and approaches to the optimization of signal processing in the unborn generation of communication networks.

articleTitle: Smart Retail Using Machine Learning for Demand Forecasting and Inventory Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Considering the fact that the current level of complexity in the retail sphere caused by demand forecasting and inventory management, the given disable due to the outdated statistical methods such as moving averages and exponential smoothing lead to the increasing number of stockouts and overstock. The given technology fails to capture complex sales patterns and uses the limited scope of real-time data to manage the inventory. The scope of stockouts and overstock continues shaping the costs and decreasing customer satisfaction. In the regard, the given paper proposes the ML-based system which uses the most innovative algorithms such as Long Short-Term Memory and XGBoost to avoid such problems. The use of the specific data and algorithms helped to improve operational efficiency and decrease MAPE to 6.8% for such forecasts as the short-term ones. As a result, the system demonstrated improved inventory turnover ratio of 6.3 and the considerable decrease in the percentage of stockouts and overstock events. As a result of the investigation, it is possible to state that the given solution is effective since it helps to avoid forecasting errors and improve customer satisfaction.

articleTitle: IoTPHM: Experimental Evaluation of Internet of Things Powered Patient Health Monitoring System using Smart Sensors
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The Internet of Things Powered Patient Health Monitoring (IoTPHM) system represents a significant advancement in remote healthcare by integrating smart sensors, microcontrollers, and IoT technology. This system continuously monitors vital health parameters such as heart rate, blood oxygen saturation (SpO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>), body temperature, blood pressure, respiratory rate, and physical activity. Utilizing an ESP32 microcontroller, the system efficiently collects, preprocesses, and transmits data to cloud servers or mobile applications using MQTT and Bluetooth protocols. Preprocessing techniques, such as noise filtering and data normalization, ensure accurate and reliable analysis. The system's sustainability is enhanced through a rechargeable battery with a solar charging option. Evaluation results demonstrate high sensor accuracy, low latency in data transmission, and robust user feedback for comfort and usability. The IoTPHM system supports edge computing for real-time alerts and cloud-based analytics for predictive insights, enabling proactive healthcare management. Its compact, wearable design ensures convenience for continuous monitoring, catering to both clinical and home environments.

articleTitle: Enhancing Glaucoma Diagnosis with a Novel Optic Disk Localization and Classification Framework Based on U-Net and ResNet-50
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Glaucoma is one of the chronic eye ailments that result in irreversible visual deterioration and is widely recognized as a significant contributor to the phenomenon of blindness on global terms. Early detection will help in drastically reducing the course of the disease. The paper proposes a three-phase novel framework for the localization of optic discs and glaucoma detection. It concentrated on early-stage identification to improve treatment outcomes. First, the median filtering and histogram equalization constitute the techniques for that process. With these techniques, different kinds of noise, such as Rayleigh, salt and pepper, Gaussian, and gamma noise, can efficiently be reduced in fundus images. At the result of this technique, the clarity of the images gets improved to a large extent and also makes the further analysis more accurate. In the next stage, location and segmentation of the optic cup and optic disc will be done accurately to obtain the desired output. To get the desired outcome, the optic disc and cup will be precisely located and segmented in the stage that comes next. For this purpose, use is made of the U-Net architecture in delineating these critical structures that lie within the eye. In the last stage, fundus images are classified to be either glaucomatous or non-glaucomatous using transfer learning-based models, prominently ResNet-50. With ResNet-50, the overall capability of the model has been highly enhanced to successfully analyze and identify complex patterns inside retinal images. Experimental results of this study, conducted using the ORIGA dataset, further testify to the effectiveness of the suggested framework. An accuracy rate of 96.78% is attained by the proposed framework, which turned out superior to the state-of-the-art approaches.

articleTitle: Experimental Evaluation of Deep Learning Based Liver Cancer Identification Scheme Using Hybrid Classification Logic
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Companies in the healthcare industry would be foolish to disregard medical analytics and decision-making tools that employ multi-modal intelligence. Liver cancer, among the most prevalent malignancies, can only be effectively treated if caught early. The contrast and brightness of liver tumours are identical to those of the surrounding tissues. Also, depending on the stage of cancer and the kind of tumour, abnormal tumour forms might be a major cause for concern. Segmenting a liver tumour entails first locating the cancer, and then cutting it into smaller pieces. However, while traditional methods of interactive segmentation require a large number of intensity levels, newer methods based on convolutional neural networks (CNN) and the Learning Scheme for Liver Cancer Identification (LSLCI) have limited presentation on images of liver tumours. This study showcases a new method for segmentation utilizing Coot Extreme Learning Model, which is based on deep learning, and it shows great efficiency in identifying tumors using accessible information of liver scans. The research process the first segmentation with minimal further user clicks in order to optimize the segmentation process. Doing so allows the suggested geodesic distance encoding method to incorporate inner boundary points. Liver cancer survival rates can be improved with early detection and treatment. The gold standard for liver tumour differential diagnosis is dynamic contrast-enhanced magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). But since MRI diagnoses are susceptible to human error, deep learning may provide a fresh approach to the diagnostic process. We trained a deep learning system using LSLCI and CNN to identify liver tumours from a variety of sources, including enhanced and unenhanced magnetic resonance images, as well as textual and numerical clinical data, as well as the results of laboratory tests.

articleTitle: Cutting-Edge AI-Driven Higher Educational and Career Advisory Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Sri Lankan students, especially those from rural and low-income backgrounds, face significant challenges in accessing higher education, including university applications, career planning, and financial aid. This research introduces an AI-powered platform designed to provide personalized assistance through university course recommendations, career guidance, financial aid information, and AI-generated mock aptitude tests. The platform employs Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) for course recommendations, Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) for career guidance, and a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) model for financial aid navigation. Additionally, AI-driven algorithms with Optical Character Recognition (OCR) technology support exam preparation. Data from students and universities informed model training, and evaluations showed high accuracy and user satisfaction across components. Results indicated that the platform effectively aligns educational resources with students' academic and career goals, promoting greater educational accessibility and support for underserved Sri Lankan students.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence-Enabled Protein-Protein Interaction Prediction: Insights into Cellular Signalling Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Investigating the use of artificial intelligence (AI) to predict protein-protein interactions (PPIs) and gain an understanding of biological signaling networks is the aim of this study. PPIs play a critical role in the activities that take place inside cells, and understanding these relationships is essential to understanding the complex signaling pathways that take place inside cells. Artificial intelligence techniques such as machine literacy and deep literacy offer useful tools for PPI prediction based on visually appealing attributes similar to the sequencing, structure, and functional characteristics of proteins. Artificial intelligence-enabled PPI vaticination models can directly identify implicit protein correlations and unearth dormant links inside biological signaling networks. Large-scale datasets and sophisticated algorithms are used to achieve this. The development of proven drugs, the modeling of complaints, and the identification of new medications are all significantly impacted by the perceptivity obtained through the use of artificial intelligence to enable PPI vaticination. This makes way for innovative corrective measures and advancements in medical care. This study aims to demonstrate the effectiveness and range of artificial intelligence in deciphering the intricate interplay between proteins in cellular signaling networks. Confirmation experiments and example studies are used to achieve this.

articleTitle: Leveraging Deep Learning Models for Machine-Generated Text Detection Using Transformer-Based Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: GPT is a large language model (LLM) derived from natural language processing that can generate a human-like text using machine learning. However, these models raise questions about authenticity and reliability of material, particularly in fields such as journalism, social media, and academia, despite their usefulness for automating text-based tasks. Detecting machine-generated text is thus an important difficulty in ensuring content integrity. This study investigates the use of huge language models as a technique for recognizing machine-generated material. The author proposes a comprehensive detection model by evaluating the language patterns, syntactic structures, and stylistic traits that separate AI-generated literature from human writing. In addition, this research investigate the possibilities of fine-tuning models designed expressly for text identification tasks and evaluate their performance using LLM - Detect AI Generated Text datasets. In digital ecosystems, LLMs are effective at detecting AI-generated text, providing a novel approach for content moderation, academic integrity checks, and synthetic media detection. An increasingly AI-powered future will require a model that can discriminate between human and machine-generated writing in real-time. According to experimental findings, the CNN architecture's design combined with the use of DistilBERT embeddings allows for the effective and efficient classification of AI generated text data, achieving an exceptional 98% accuracy rate.

articleTitle: The Ethics of Generative AI: Analyzing ChatGPT's Impact on Bias, Fairness, Privacy, and Accountability
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Pros and cons of Generative Artificial Intelligence (Intent), Many fields has its own use-case space for GAI. ChatGPT and systems like it give a sophisticated understanding of cognition along with content that is indistinguishable from humans, however these systems raise ethical issues in professional and social contexts. Challenges in the broad adoption of AI technologies including, accountability, fairness, bias and privacy arise as issues. These reforms will be critical as AI systems continue to be both developed and deployed, maintaining the crucial ethical standards and underpinning social trust. In the context of algorithmic biases, potential privacy violations, and an increased amount of risk due to automation in these critical decision areas; this paper provides a commentary regarding ethical concerns using generative AI. In addition, is the necessity of addressing these ethical challenges with tools like AI Ethics Impact Assessments, VADER Sentiment Analysis, TensorFlow's Indicators of Fairness, and continuous conversation.

articleTitle: IoT-Driven Precision Farming: Enhancing Crop Yield and Sustainability Through Real-Time Data Analytics
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Precision farmers are enhancing crop yields and crop life through the implementation of IoT-based agricultural management. This investigation investigates the methods by which precision farmers are employing Internet of Things (IoT) devices for real-time crop management through data collection, analysis, and decision-making. The impact of IoT on soil moisture, nutrient levels, and ambient conditions is investigated in this study using a sensor network, drones, and smart irrigation systems. Yield, resource efficacy, and cost-effectiveness are significantly enhanced in comparison to conventional agricultural methods. The IoT is employed in precision farming to address current agricultural issues in novel ways. It accomplishes this by precisely regulating agricultural inputs and providing data analytics insights. According to the research, IoT technology has the potential to address the increasing global demand for food in a sustainable and environmentally favorable manner. The study scales and interoperate the IoT to advance precision farming.
